````java
package com.mailflow.ai;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.MailFlowException;
import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

/**
 * Tests provider selection in {@link AiConfig} and the disabled-AI fallback.
 * No network calls are made.
 */
class AiConfigTest {

    private final WebClient.Builder webClient = WebClient.builder();
    private final ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();

    private AiContentProvider build(MailFlowProperties p) {
        AiConfig cfg = new AiConfig(p);
        return cfg.aiContentProvider(webClient, mapper);
    }

    private MailFlowProperties base() {
        MailFlowProperties p = new MailFlowProperties();
        p.setAi(new MailFlowProperties.Ai());
        return p;
    }

    @Test
    void disabled_returns_noop_and_reports_unavailable() {
        MailFlowProperties p = base();
        p.getAi().setEnabled(false);
        AiContentProvider provider = build(p);
        assertThat(provider).isInstanceOf(NoOpAiContentProvider.class);
        assertThat(provider.isAvailable()).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void gemini_selected_when_enabled_with_key() {
        MailFlowProperties p = base();
        p.getAi().setEnabled(true);
        p.getAi().setProvider("gemini");
        p.getAi().getGemini().setApiKey("a-key");
        assertThat(build(p)).isInstanceOf(GeminiContentProvider.class);
    }

    @Test
    void gemini_without_key_falls_back_to_noop() {
        MailFlowProperties p = base();
        p.getAi().setEnabled(true);
        p.getAi().setProvider("gemini");
        p.getAi().getGemini().setApiKey("");
        assertThat(build(p)).isInstanceOf(NoOpAiContentProvider.class);
    }

    @Test
    void openai_selected_when_enabled_with_key() {
        MailFlowProperties p = base();
        p.getAi().setEnabled(true);
        p.getAi().setProvider("openai");
        p.getAi().getOpenai().setApiKey("a-key");
        assertThat(build(p)).isInstanceOf(OpenAiContentProvider.class);
    }

    @Test
    void unknown_provider_falls_back_to_noop() {
        MailFlowProperties p = base();
        p.getAi().setEnabled(true);
        p.getAi().setProvider("sillicon-brain");
        assertThat(build(p)).isInstanceOf(NoOpAiContentProvider.class);
    }

    @Test
    void noop_improve_throws_service_unavailable() {
        NoOpAiContentProvider noop = new NoOpAiContentProvider();
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> noop.improve(
                new ImproveEmailRequest("s", "b", null, null, null, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(MailFlowException.class)
                .satisfies(ex -> assertThat(((MailFlowException) ex).getStatus())
                        .isEqualTo(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE));
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/ai/GeminiContentProviderTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.ai;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.MailFlowException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.ClientResponse;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.ExchangeFunction;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClientResponseException;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

/**
 * Unit tests for {@link GeminiContentProvider} using an in-memory stubbed
 * WebClient exchange — NO real network call and NO real Gemini API key is used.
 */
class GeminiContentProviderTest {

    private final ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();

    private MailFlowProperties props() {
        MailFlowProperties p = new MailFlowProperties();
        p.setAi(new MailFlowProperties.Ai());
        p.getAi().setEnabled(true);
        p.getAi().setProvider("gemini");
        p.getAi().getGemini().setApiKey("test-key-not-real");
        p.getAi().getGemini().setModel("gemini-1.5-flash");
        p.getAi().getGemini().setTimeoutSeconds(5);
        return p;
    }

    /** Builds a provider whose WebClient returns the given canned response. */
    private GeminiContentProvider providerReturning(ClientResponse response) {
        ExchangeFunction exchange = request -> Mono.just(response);
        WebClient.Builder builder = WebClient.builder().exchangeFunction(exchange);
        return new GeminiContentProvider(props(), builder, mapper);
    }

    private GeminiContentProvider providerThrowing(Throwable t) {
        ExchangeFunction exchange = request -> Mono.error(t);
        WebClient.Builder builder = WebClient.builder().exchangeFunction(exchange);
        return new GeminiContentProvider(props(), builder, mapper);
    }

    private ClientResponse okJson(String body) {
        return ClientResponse.create(HttpStatus.OK)
                .header("Content-Type", MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
                .body(body)
                .build();
    }

    private static final String GEMINI_ENVELOPE = """
            {"candidates":[{"content":{"parts":[{"text":"%s"}]}}]}
            """;

    @Test
    void improve_returns_subject_and_body_from_gemini() {
        // The candidate text is itself a JSON string (escaped) per responseMimeType=json.
        String innerJson = "{\\\"subject\\\":\\\"Improved Subject\\\",\\\"body\\\":\\\"Improved body with {{Name}}\\\"}";
        String envelope = String.format(GEMINI_ENVELOPE, innerJson);

        GeminiContentProvider provider = providerReturning(okJson(envelope));

        ImprovedEmail result = provider.improve(new ImproveEmailRequest(
                "Original subject", "Original body with {{Name}}",
                "promote workshop", "students", "professional", "date and venue"));

        assertThat(result.subject()).isEqualTo("Improved Subject");
        assertThat(result.body()).contains("Improved body").contains("{{Name}}");
    }

    @Test
    void improve_rejects_blank_subject_or_body() {
        GeminiContentProvider provider = providerReturning(okJson("{}"));
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> provider.improve(
                new ImproveEmailRequest("", "body", null, null, null, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> provider.improve(
                new ImproveEmailRequest("subject", "  ", null, null, null, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void improve_falls_back_to_original_when_model_omits_fields() {
        // Candidate returns an empty JSON object → keep originals.
        String envelope = String.format(GEMINI_ENVELOPE, "{}");
        GeminiContentProvider provider = providerReturning(okJson(envelope));

        ImprovedEmail result = provider.improve(new ImproveEmailRequest(
                "Keep me", "Keep this body", null, null, null, null));

        assertThat(result.subject()).isEqualTo("Keep me");
        assertThat(result.body()).isEqualTo("Keep this body");
    }

    @Test
    void rate_limit_maps_to_service_unavailable() {
        WebClientResponseException e429 = WebClientResponseException.create(
                429, "Too Many Requests", null, null, null);
        GeminiContentProvider provider = providerThrowing(e429);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> provider.improve(
                new ImproveEmailRequest("s", "b", null, null, null, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(MailFlowException.class)
                .satisfies(ex -> assertThat(((MailFlowException) ex).getStatus())
                        .isEqualTo(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE));
    }

    @Test
    void auth_error_maps_to_service_unavailable() {
        WebClientResponseException e403 = WebClientResponseException.create(
                403, "Forbidden", null, null, null);
        GeminiContentProvider provider = providerThrowing(e403);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> provider.improve(
                new ImproveEmailRequest("s", "b", null, null, null, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(MailFlowException.class)
                .satisfies(ex -> assertThat(((MailFlowException) ex).getErrorCode())
                        .isEqualTo("AI_AUTH_ERROR"));
    }

    @Test
    void malformed_envelope_maps_to_bad_gateway() {
        GeminiContentProvider provider = providerReturning(okJson("{\"unexpected\":true}"));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> provider.improve(
                new ImproveEmailRequest("s", "b", null, null, null, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(MailFlowException.class)
                .satisfies(ex -> assertThat(((MailFlowException) ex).getStatus())
                        .isEqualTo(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY));
    }

    @Test
    void is_available_true_for_configured_gemini() {
        GeminiContentProvider provider = providerReturning(okJson("{}"));
        assertThat(provider.isAvailable()).isTrue();
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/auth/AuthServiceTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.auth;

import com.mailflow.auth.dto.LoginRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.RegisterRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.entity.Role;
import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import com.mailflow.auth.repository.RoleRepository;
import com.mailflow.auth.repository.UserRepository;
import com.mailflow.auth.service.AuthService;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ConflictException;
import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import com.mailflow.security.JwtService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class AuthServiceTest {

    @Mock private UserRepository userRepository;
    @Mock private RoleRepository roleRepository;
    @Mock private PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;
    @Mock private JwtService jwtService;
    @Mock private AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;
    @Mock private com.mailflow.organization.repository.OrganizationRepository organizationRepository;
    @InjectMocks private AuthService authService;

    private Role viewerRole;
    private User savedUser;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        viewerRole = new Role(1L, "VIEWER", "Viewer");
        savedUser = User.builder()
                .id(1L)
                .email("test@example.com")
                .passwordHash("hash")
                .firstName("Test")
                .lastName("User")
                .roles(Set.of(viewerRole))
                .build();
    }

    @Test
    void sign_up_creates_a_company_with_the_person_as_its_admin() {
        when(userRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCase(anyString())).thenReturn(false);
        when(organizationRepository.save(any())).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            com.mailflow.organization.entity.Organization o = inv.getArgument(0);
            o.setId(42L);
            return o;
        });
        when(roleRepository.findByName(anyString())).thenAnswer(inv -> Optional.of(new Role(inv.<String>getArgument(0))));
        when(passwordEncoder.encode(anyString())).thenReturn("hashed");
        when(userRepository.save(any(User.class))).thenReturn(savedUser);
        when(jwtService.generateAccessToken(any())).thenReturn("access-token");
        when(jwtService.generateRefreshToken(any())).thenReturn("refresh-token");

        var response = authService.register(new RegisterRequest(
            "  Acme Ltd ", "Test@Example.com", "Password@123", "Test", "User"));

        assertThat(response.accessToken()).isEqualTo("access-token");
        assertThat(response.user().email()).isEqualTo("test@example.com");
        assertThat(response.user().organizationId()).isEqualTo(42L);
        assertThat(response.user().organizationName()).isEqualTo("Acme Ltd");
        assertThat(response.user().roles()).containsExactlyInAnyOrder("ADMIN", "CAMPAIGN_MANAGER", "VIEWER");
        ArgumentCaptor<User> saved = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(User.class);
        verify(userRepository).save(saved.capture());
        assertThat(saved.getValue().getOrganizationId()).isEqualTo(42L);
    }

    @Test
    void throws_conflict_for_duplicate_email() {
        when(userRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCase("test@example.com")).thenReturn(true);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> authService.register(
            new RegisterRequest("Acme", "test@example.com", "Password@123", "Test", "User")))
            .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void logs_in_existing_user() {
        when(authenticationManager.authenticate(any(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.class)))
            .thenReturn(null);
        when(userRepository.findActiveByEmail("test@example.com")).thenReturn(Optional.of(savedUser));
        when(jwtService.generateAccessToken(any())).thenReturn("access-token");
        when(jwtService.generateRefreshToken(any())).thenReturn("refresh-token");

        var response = authService.login(new LoginRequest("test@example.com", "Password@123"));

        assertThat(response.accessToken()).isEqualTo("access-token");
        assertThat(response.user().email()).isEqualTo("test@example.com");
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.auth;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

class SeedCredentialsTest {

    private final BCryptPasswordEncoder encoder = new BCryptPasswordEncoder(12);

    @Test
    void verifyAdminPassword() {
        assertThat(encoder.matches("Admin@123", "$2a$12$QAs4bs8wloGrgZh0d0Tc0ud9E6OeQij.KmbcIi8fmHtUpUGs9fd0a")).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void verifyManagerPassword() {
        assertThat(encoder.matches("Manager@123", "$2a$12$08kG7KkUDvuh1jLJqY7DOueqKxa3Ic86v7SIymxRWcV3XyLmNVlUC")).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void verifyViewerPassword() {
        assertThat(encoder.matches("Viewer@123", "$2a$12$5wz6U1uNpE65GXP/NWL2z.QtJHdMukvTUJNHUHCt9TPVOVckiSU9W")).isTrue();
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/auth/TeamServiceTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.auth;

import com.mailflow.auth.dto.CreateTeamMemberRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.dto.UpdateTeamMemberRequest;
import com.mailflow.auth.entity.Role;
import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import com.mailflow.auth.repository.UserRepository;
import com.mailflow.auth.service.AuthService;
import com.mailflow.auth.service.TeamService;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ConflictException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import com.mailflow.organization.entity.Organization;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class TeamServiceTest {

    @Mock private UserRepository userRepository;
    @Mock private AuthService authService;
    @Mock private PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;
    @InjectMocks private TeamService teamService;

    private User admin;

    private static Set<Role> roles(String level) {
        return RoleLevels.rolesFor(level).stream().map(Role::new).collect(Collectors.toCollection(HashSet::new));
    }

    private static User user(long id, long orgId, String level) {
        return User.builder().id(id).email("u" + id + "@test.local").firstName("U").lastName(String.valueOf(id))
                .enabled(true).organization(Organization.builder().id(orgId).name("Org").build())
                .roles(roles(level)).build();
    }

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        admin = user(1, 7, RoleLevels.ADMIN);
    }

    @Test
    void an_added_person_joins_the_admins_company_with_the_chosen_role() {
        when(userRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCase("new@test.local")).thenReturn(false);
        when(passwordEncoder.encode(anyString())).thenReturn("hash");
        when(authService.rolesFor(RoleLevels.CAMPAIGN_MANAGER)).thenReturn(roles(RoleLevels.CAMPAIGN_MANAGER));

        var response = teamService.add(admin, new CreateTeamMemberRequest(
                " New@Test.Local ", "New", "Person", "Password1", RoleLevels.CAMPAIGN_MANAGER));

        ArgumentCaptor<User> saved = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(User.class);
        verify(userRepository).save(saved.capture());
        assertThat(saved.getValue().getOrganizationId()).isEqualTo(7L);
        assertThat(saved.getValue().getEmail()).isEqualTo("new@test.local");
        assertThat(response.role()).isEqualTo(RoleLevels.CAMPAIGN_MANAGER);
    }

    @Test
    void an_email_that_already_has_an_account_is_refused() {
        when(userRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCase("taken@test.local")).thenReturn(true);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> teamService.add(admin, new CreateTeamMemberRequest(
                "taken@test.local", "A", "B", "Password1", RoleLevels.VIEWER)))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        verify(userRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void a_person_of_another_company_is_not_found() {
        when(userRepository.findTeamMember(7L, 99L)).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> teamService.update(admin, 99L, new UpdateTeamMemberRequest(RoleLevels.VIEWER, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(ResourceNotFoundException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void an_admin_cannot_demote_or_disable_themselves() {
        when(userRepository.findTeamMember(7L, 1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(admin));
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> teamService.update(admin, 1L, new UpdateTeamMemberRequest(RoleLevels.VIEWER, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> teamService.update(admin, 1L, new UpdateTeamMemberRequest(null, false)))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class);
        verify(userRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void an_admin_can_change_a_role_and_disable_a_teammate() {
        User teammate = user(2, 7, RoleLevels.VIEWER);
        when(userRepository.findTeamMember(7L, 2L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(teammate));
        when(authService.rolesFor(RoleLevels.ADMIN)).thenReturn(roles(RoleLevels.ADMIN));

        var response = teamService.update(admin, 2L, new UpdateTeamMemberRequest(RoleLevels.ADMIN, false));

        assertThat(response.role()).isEqualTo(RoleLevels.ADMIN);
        assertThat(response.enabled()).isFalse();
        verify(userRepository).save(teammate);
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.email.UnsubscribeService;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailMessage;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateEngineService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

/**
 * Verifies that {@link CampaignItemProcessor} exposes the full personalization
 * model — standard fields, custom fields (role/phone/location/interest), and
 * capitalized aliases ({{Name}}, {{Company}}, {{Role}}…) — to the template engine.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CampaignItemProcessorModelTest {

    @Mock private TemplateEngineService templateEngine;
    @Mock private UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;
    @Mock private CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    @Mock private CampaignRepository campaignRepository;

    @Test
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    void builds_model_with_custom_fields_and_capitalized_aliases() {
        CampaignItemProcessor processor = new CampaignItemProcessor(
                templateEngine, unsubscribeService, campaignRecipientRepository, campaignRepository);
        // The processor only renders while the campaign is RUNNING.
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(10L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(CampaignStatus.RUNNING));

        Map<String, String> custom = new HashMap<>();
        custom.put("role", "Engineer");
        custom.put("location", "London");
        custom.put("interest", "Mathematics");

        Recipient recipient = Recipient.builder()
                .id(1L)
                .email("ada@example.com")
                .name("Ada Lovelace")
                .firstName("Ada")
                .lastName("Lovelace")
                .company("Analytical Engines")
                .customFields(custom)
                .build();

        Campaign campaign = Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG)
                .id(10L)
                .subject("Hello {{Name}} from {{Company}}")
                .senderName("MailFlow")
                .senderEmail("noreply@mailflow.local")
                .build();

        CampaignRecipient cr = CampaignRecipient.builder()
                .id(100L)
                .campaign(campaign)
                .recipient(recipient)
                .idempotencyKey(CampaignRecipient.buildIdempotencyKey(10L, 1L))
                .deliveryStatus(CampaignRecipient.DeliveryStatus.PENDING)
                .retryCount(0)
                .build();

        when(unsubscribeService.isUnsubscribed(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, "ada@example.com")).thenReturn(false);
        // Echo the subject back; capture the model that was passed in.
        when(templateEngine.render(anyString(), any(Map.class)))
                .thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        EmailMessage msg = processor.process(cr);
        assertThat(msg).isNotNull();
        assertThat(msg.toAddress()).isEqualTo("ada@example.com");

        ArgumentCaptor<Map<String, Object>> modelCaptor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(Map.class);
        // The subject render call carries the model.
        org.mockito.Mockito.verify(templateEngine)
                .render(org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq("Hello {{Name}} from {{Company}}"),
                        modelCaptor.capture());
        Map<String, Object> model = modelCaptor.getValue();

        // Standard lower-camel keys
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("name", "Ada Lovelace");
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("firstName", "Ada");
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("company", "Analytical Engines");

        // Capitalized aliases
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("Name", "Ada Lovelace");
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("Company", "Analytical Engines");
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("FirstName", "Ada");

        // Custom fields + their capitalized aliases
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("role", "Engineer");
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("Role", "Engineer");
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("location", "London");
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("Location", "London");
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("interest", "Mathematics");
        assertThat(model).containsEntry("Interest", "Mathematics");
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import com.mailflow.analytics.EmailLogService;
import com.mailflow.analytics.entity.EmailLog;
import com.mailflow.analytics.repository.EmailLogRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient.DeliveryStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.email.EmailProvider;
import com.mailflow.email.EmailRequest;
import com.mailflow.email.RateLimiterService;
import com.mailflow.email.UnsubscribeService;
import com.mailflow.email.entity.UnsubscribeEntry;
import com.mailflow.email.repository.UnsubscribeRepository;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailConsumer;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailMessage;
import com.mailflow.recipient.repository.RecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.template.entity.EmailTemplate;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateEngineService;
import freemarker.cache.StringTemplateLoader;
import freemarker.template.TemplateExceptionHandler;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.ValueOperations;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyLong;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.lenient;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verifyNoInteractions;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

/**
 * Null-safety of the send pipeline for campaign-only addresses: delivery rows and
 * queue messages without a saved contact (recipient / recipientId null).
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CampaignOnlyAddressPipelineTest {

    private static final String ADA_KEY = CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(7L, "ada@test.local");

    @Mock private UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;
    @Mock private CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    @Mock private CampaignRepository runningCampaign;

    private CampaignItemProcessor processor;
    private Campaign campaign;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        StringTemplateLoader loader = new StringTemplateLoader();
        freemarker.template.Configuration config =
                new freemarker.template.Configuration(freemarker.template.Configuration.VERSION_2_3_32);
        config.setTemplateLoader(loader);
        config.setDefaultEncoding("UTF-8");
        config.setTemplateExceptionHandler(TemplateExceptionHandler.RETHROW_HANDLER);
        processor = new CampaignItemProcessor(
                new TemplateEngineService(config, loader), unsubscribeService, campaignRecipientRepository,
                runningCampaign);
        // The processor only renders while the campaign is RUNNING (not every test processes a row).
        lenient().when(runningCampaign.findStatusById(7L))
                .thenReturn(Optional.of(com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus.RUNNING));

        campaign = Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG)
                .id(7L)
                .subject("Hi {{FirstName}} ({{Team}})")
                .senderName("MailFlow")
                .senderEmail("noreply@mailflow.local")
                .replyTo("replies@test.local")
                .template(EmailTemplate.builder()
                        .htmlBody("<p>{{Name}} at {{Company}}, {{Email}}, role: {{Role}}</p>")
                        .plainBody("Dear {{name}} {{LastName}}")
                        .build())
                .build();
    }

    private CampaignRecipient adaRow() {
        return CampaignRecipient.builder()
                .id(100L)
                .campaign(campaign)
                .idempotencyKey(ADA_KEY)
                .deliveryStatus(DeliveryStatus.PENDING)
                .snapshotEmail("ada@test.local")
                .snapshotName("Ada Lovelace")
                .snapshotFirstName("Ada")
                .snapshotLastName("Lovelace")
                .snapshotCompany("Acme")
                .snapshotCustomFields(Map.of("Team", "Platform"))
                .build();
    }

    private static EmailMessage messageWithoutContact() {
        return EmailMessage.builder()
                .idempotencyKey(ADA_KEY)
                .campaignId(7L)
                .recipientId(null)
                .toAddress("ada@test.local")
                .senderEmail("noreply@mailflow.local")
                .subject("Hi Ada")
                .htmlBody("<p>Hi Ada</p>")
                .plainBody("Hi Ada")
                .attemptNumber(1)
                .createdAt(Instant.now())
                .build();
    }

    // ── Processor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void processor_personalises_from_the_snapshot_and_sends_to_the_snapshot_address() {
        CampaignRecipient row = adaRow();

        EmailMessage msg = processor.process(row);

        assertThat(msg).isNotNull();
        assertThat(msg.toAddress()).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(msg.recipientId()).isNull();
        assertThat(msg.idempotencyKey()).isEqualTo(ADA_KEY);
        assertThat(msg.campaignId()).isEqualTo(7L);
        assertThat(msg.replyTo()).isEqualTo("replies@test.local");
        assertThat(msg.subject()).isEqualTo("Hi Ada (Platform)");
        assertThat(msg.htmlBody()).isEqualTo("<p>Ada Lovelace at Acme, ada@test.local, role: </p>");
        assertThat(msg.plainBody()).isEqualTo("Dear Ada Lovelace Lovelace");
        // The transient Recipient used for the model is never attached to the row.
        assertThat(row.getRecipient()).isNull();
        verify(unsubscribeService).isUnsubscribed(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, "ada@test.local");
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).markFailed(any(), any(), any(), any());
    }

    @Test
    void processor_skips_an_unsubscribed_campaign_only_address() {
        when(unsubscribeService.isUnsubscribed(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, "ada@test.local")).thenReturn(true);

        assertThat(processor.process(adaRow())).isNull();
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).markFailed(
                eq(ADA_KEY), eq(DeliveryStatus.SKIPPED), any(Instant.class), eq("Unsubscribed"));
    }

    @Test
    void processor_marks_a_row_without_any_address_skipped_instead_of_failing() {
        CampaignRecipient broken = CampaignRecipient.builder()
                .id(101L).campaign(campaign).idempotencyKey("campaign_7_addr_broken")
                .deliveryStatus(DeliveryStatus.PENDING).build();

        assertThat(processor.process(broken)).isNull();
        // Marked so the row leaves the reader's PENDING/FAILED result set.
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).markFailed(
                eq("campaign_7_addr_broken"), eq(DeliveryStatus.SKIPPED), any(Instant.class), eq("No email address"));
        verifyNoInteractions(unsubscribeService);
    }

    @Test
    void skip_listener_handles_a_row_without_a_contact() {
        CampaignRecipient row = adaRow();

        assertThatCode(() -> new CampaignSkipListener()
                .onSkipInProcess(row, new IllegalArgumentException("bad template")))
                .doesNotThrowAnyException();
        assertThat(row.targetEmail()).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
    }

    // ── Consumer, delivery log, unsubscribe ─────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void consumer_sends_a_message_without_recipient_id_and_records_it() {
        EmailProvider emailProvider = org.mockito.Mockito.mock(EmailProvider.class);
        CampaignRepository campaignRepository = org.mockito.Mockito.mock(CampaignRepository.class);
        RateLimiterService rateLimiter = org.mockito.Mockito.mock(RateLimiterService.class);
        EmailLogService emailLogService = org.mockito.Mockito.mock(EmailLogService.class);
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate = org.mockito.Mockito.mock(RedisTemplate.class);
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        ValueOperations<String, Object> valueOps = org.mockito.Mockito.mock(ValueOperations.class);
        when(redisTemplate.hasKey("email:sent:" + ADA_KEY)).thenReturn(false);
        when(redisTemplate.opsForValue()).thenReturn(valueOps);
        when(rateLimiter.tryAcquire(7L)).thenReturn(true);
        // The consumer re-checks the campaign status before sending.
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(7L))
                .thenReturn(Optional.of(com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus.RUNNING));
        EmailMessage message = messageWithoutContact();

        new EmailConsumer(emailProvider, campaignRecipientRepository, campaignRepository,
                rateLimiter, emailLogService, redisTemplate).consume(message);

        ArgumentCaptor<EmailRequest> sent = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(EmailRequest.class);
        verify(emailProvider).send(sent.capture());
        assertThat(sent.getValue().to()).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).markSent(eq(ADA_KEY), any(Instant.class));
        verify(campaignRepository).incrementCounters(eq(7L), eq(1L), eq(0L), eq(0L), eq(0L), any(Instant.class));
        verify(emailLogService).logSuccess(message);
    }

    @Test
    void delivery_log_accepts_a_message_without_recipient_id() {
        EmailLogRepository emailLogRepository = org.mockito.Mockito.mock(EmailLogRepository.class);

        new EmailLogService(emailLogRepository).logSuccess(messageWithoutContact());

        ArgumentCaptor<EmailLog> saved = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(EmailLog.class);
        verify(emailLogRepository).save(saved.capture());
        assertThat(saved.getValue().getRecipientId()).isNull();
        assertThat(saved.getValue().getToAddress()).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(saved.getValue().getCampaignId()).isEqualTo(7L);
        assertThat(saved.getValue().getStatus()).isEqualTo("SENT");
    }

    @Test
    void unsubscribing_a_campaign_only_address_adds_it_to_the_unsubscribe_list() {
        UnsubscribeRepository unsubscribeRepository = org.mockito.Mockito.mock(UnsubscribeRepository.class);
        RecipientRepository recipientRepository = org.mockito.Mockito.mock(RecipientRepository.class);
        // The address is normalised before it is looked up and stored, so a later send to
        // "ada@test.local" finds the entry.
        when(unsubscribeRepository.findByOrganizationIdAndEmailIgnoreCase(7L, "ada@test.local")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
        when(recipientRepository.findByOrganizationIdAndEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull(7L, "ada@test.local")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        String token = new UnsubscribeService(unsubscribeRepository, recipientRepository)
                .unsubscribe(7L, " Ada@Test.Local\u00A0", "No thanks", 7L);

        ArgumentCaptor<UnsubscribeEntry> entry = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(UnsubscribeEntry.class);
        verify(unsubscribeRepository).save(entry.capture());
        assertThat(entry.getValue().getEmail()).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(entry.getValue().getCampaignId()).isEqualTo(7L);
        assertThat(entry.getValue().getToken()).isEqualTo(token).isNotBlank();
        // No saved contact exists for the address, so none is changed or created.
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).save(any());
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).findById(anyLong());
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/batch/CampaignOnlyReaderQueryTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import com.mailflow.auth.entity.Role;
import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignTargetAddress;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignTargetAddressRepository;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import com.mailflow.template.entity.EmailTemplate;
import org.hibernate.Session;
import org.hibernate.SessionFactory;
import org.hibernate.boot.MetadataSources;
import org.hibernate.boot.registry.StandardServiceRegistry;
import org.hibernate.boot.registry.StandardServiceRegistryBuilder;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.entry;

/**
 * Runs the batch reader query and the new repository queries through Hibernate
 * against the real entity mappings, on an in-memory H2 database with hand-written
 * tables. PostgreSQL itself is not used here; the live schema is checked by
 * Hibernate's {@code ddl-auto: validate} at application start.
 */
class CampaignOnlyReaderQueryTest {

    private static final String URL = "jdbc:h2:mem:campaign_only_reader;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1";

    private static StandardServiceRegistry registry;
    private static SessionFactory sessionFactory;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setUp() throws Exception {
        try (Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, "sa", "");
             Statement s = c.createStatement()) {
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE recipients (organization_id BIGINT, 
                        id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255),
                        first_name VARCHAR(100), last_name VARCHAR(100), company VARCHAR(255),
                        course VARCHAR(255), custom_fields JSON, status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
                        import_source VARCHAR(100), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        version BIGINT NOT NULL)""");
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE campaign_recipients (
                        id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL, recipient_id BIGINT,
                        delivery_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
                        queued_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, sent_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        failed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, retry_count INT NOT NULL,
                        last_error VARCHAR(1000), personalized_subject VARCHAR(1000),
                        email VARCHAR(255), name VARCHAR(255), first_name VARCHAR(100),
                        last_name VARCHAR(100), company VARCHAR(255), custom_fields JSON)""");
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE campaign_target_addresses (
                        id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                        name VARCHAR(255), first_name VARCHAR(100), last_name VARCHAR(100),
                        company VARCHAR(255), custom_fields JSON, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)""");

            s.execute("""
                    INSERT INTO recipients (id, email, name, custom_fields, status, deleted_at, version) VALUES
                        (1, 'active@test.local', 'Active Contact', JSON '{"code":"A1"}', 'ACTIVE', NULL, 0),
                        (2, 'optout@test.local', NULL, JSON '{}', 'UNSUBSCRIBED', NULL, 0),
                        (3, 'Gone@Test.Local', NULL, JSON '{}', 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0)""");
            s.execute("""
                    INSERT INTO campaign_recipients
                        (id, campaign_id, recipient_id, delivery_status, idempotency_key, retry_count,
                         email, name, first_name, custom_fields) VALUES
                        (10, 7, 1,    'PENDING', 'campaign_7_recipient_1', 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL),
                        (11, 7, NULL, 'PENDING', 'campaign_7_addr_only', 0,
                             'only@test.local', 'Only Address', 'Only', JSON '{"Team":"Platform"}'),
                        (12, 7, 2,    'PENDING', 'campaign_7_recipient_2', 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL),
                        (13, 7, 3,    'PENDING', 'campaign_7_recipient_3', 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL),
                        (14, 7, NULL, 'QUEUED',  'campaign_7_addr_queued', 0, 'queued@test.local', NULL, NULL, JSON '{}'),
                        (15, 7, NULL, 'FAILED',  'campaign_7_addr_retry', 1, 'retry@test.local', NULL, NULL, JSON '{}'),
                        (16, 7, NULL, 'SENT',    'campaign_7_addr_sent', 0, 'sent@test.local', NULL, NULL, JSON '{}'),
                        (17, 8, NULL, 'PENDING', 'campaign_8_addr_other', 0, 'other@test.local', NULL, NULL, JSON '{}')""");
            s.execute("""
                    INSERT INTO campaign_target_addresses (id, campaign_id, email, custom_fields) VALUES
                        (1, 7, 'only@test.local', JSON '{}'),
                        (2, 7, 'retry@test.local', JSON '{}'),
                        (3, 8, 'other@test.local', JSON '{}')""");
        }

        registry = new StandardServiceRegistryBuilder()
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.url", URL)
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.username", "sa")
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.password", "")
                .applySetting("hibernate.hbm2ddl.auto", "none")
                .applySetting("hibernate.tenant_identifier_resolver", new com.mailflow.tenant.TenantIdentifierResolver())
                .build();
        sessionFactory = new MetadataSources(registry)
                .addAnnotatedClasses(Campaign.class, CampaignRecipient.class, CampaignTargetAddress.class,
                        Recipient.class, EmailTemplate.class, User.class, Role.class, com.mailflow.organization.entity.Organization.class)
                .buildMetadata()
                .buildSessionFactory();
    }

    @AfterAll
    static void tearDown() {
        if (sessionFactory != null) sessionFactory.close();
        if (registry != null) StandardServiceRegistryBuilder.destroy(registry);
    }

    private static String queryOf(Class<?> repository, String method, Class<?>... params) throws Exception {
        return repository.getMethod(method, params).getAnnotation(Query.class).value();
    }

    @Test
    void reader_reads_campaign_only_rows_and_active_contacts_only() {
        try (Session session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            List<CampaignRecipient> rows = session
                    .createQuery(CampaignBatchConfig.READER_QUERY, CampaignRecipient.class)
                    .setParameter("campaignId", 7L)
                    .getResultList();

            // PENDING/FAILED rows of campaign 7 whose contact is ACTIVE and not deleted,
            // plus rows without a contact. Not: UNSUBSCRIBED (12) or deleted (13)
            // contacts, QUEUED (14) / SENT (16) rows, or another campaign's row (17).
            assertThat(rows).extracting(CampaignRecipient::getId).containsExactly(10L, 11L, 15L);
            assertThat(rows.get(0).getRecipient().getEmail()).isEqualTo("active@test.local");

            CampaignRecipient only = rows.get(1);
            assertThat(only.getRecipient()).isNull();
            assertThat(only.targetEmail()).isEqualTo("only@test.local");
            assertThat(only.getSnapshotName()).isEqualTo("Only Address");
            assertThat(only.getSnapshotFirstName()).isEqualTo("Only");
            assertThat(only.getSnapshotCustomFields()).containsExactly(entry("Team", "Platform"));
        }
    }

    @Test
    void reader_pages_with_the_left_join() {
        try (Session session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            List<CampaignRecipient> firstPage = session
                    .createQuery(CampaignBatchConfig.READER_QUERY, CampaignRecipient.class)
                    .setParameter("campaignId", 7L)
                    .setFirstResult(0)
                    .setMaxResults(2)
                    .getResultList();

            assertThat(firstPage).extracting(CampaignRecipient::getId).containsExactly(10L, 11L);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void targeted_emails_cover_contact_and_campaign_only_rows_in_lower_case() throws Exception {
        String hql = queryOf(CampaignRecipientRepository.class, "findTargetedEmails", Long.class);
        try (Session session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            List<String> emails = session.createQuery(hql, String.class)
                    .setParameter("campaignId", 7L)
                    .getResultList();

            assertThat(emails).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(
                    "active@test.local", "only@test.local", "optout@test.local", "gone@test.local",
                    "queued@test.local", "retry@test.local", "sent@test.local");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void target_address_counts_are_grouped_per_campaign() throws Exception {
        String hql = queryOf(CampaignTargetAddressRepository.class, "countByCampaignIds", Collection.class);
        try (Session session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            Map<Long, Long> counts = session.createQuery(hql, Object[].class)
                    .setParameter("campaignIds", List.of(7L, 8L, 9L))
                    .getResultList().stream()
                    .collect(Collectors.toMap(r -> (Long) r[0], r -> ((Number) r[1]).longValue()));

            assertThat(counts).containsOnly(entry(7L, 2L), entry(8L, 1L));
        }
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/batch/CampaignPauseResumeQueriesTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import org.hibernate.SessionFactory;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.batch.item.ExecutionContext;
import org.springframework.batch.item.database.JpaPagingItemReader;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Lock;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;

import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.sql.Connection;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

/**
 * Runs the pause/resume pieces against the real entity mappings on an in-memory H2
 * database with hand-written tables: the batch reader (stops after a pause, a resume
 * reads only unsent rows), the conditional status update used by the job listener,
 * the consumer's held/skipped row updates and row lock, and {@code @DynamicUpdate} on
 * Campaign. PostgreSQL itself is not used.
 */
class CampaignPauseResumeQueriesTest {

    private static final String URL = "jdbc:h2:mem:campaign_pause_resume;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1";

    private static StandardServiceRegistry registry;
    private static SessionFactory sessionFactory;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setUp() throws Exception {
        try (Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, "sa", "");
             Statement s = c.createStatement()) {
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE campaigns (organization_id BIGINT, 
                        id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(1000),
                        subject VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, template_id BIGINT, sender_name VARCHAR(255),
                        sender_email VARCHAR(255), reply_to VARCHAR(255), status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
                        scheduled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, created_by BIGINT,
                        created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        total_recipients BIGINT NOT NULL, sent_count BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        failed_count BIGINT NOT NULL, skipped_count BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        bounced_count BIGINT NOT NULL, retry_count BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        batch_job_id VARCHAR(255), version BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, deleted_by BIGINT,
                        custom_body VARCHAR(100000))""");
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE recipients (organization_id BIGINT, 
                        id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255),
                        first_name VARCHAR(100), last_name VARCHAR(100), company VARCHAR(255),
                        course VARCHAR(255), custom_fields JSON, status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
                        import_source VARCHAR(100), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        version BIGINT NOT NULL)""");
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE campaign_recipients (
                        id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL, recipient_id BIGINT,
                        delivery_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
                        queued_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, sent_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        failed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, retry_count INT NOT NULL,
                        last_error VARCHAR(1000), personalized_subject VARCHAR(1000),
                        email VARCHAR(255), name VARCHAR(255), first_name VARCHAR(100),
                        last_name VARCHAR(100), company VARCHAR(255), custom_fields JSON)""");
        }

        registry = new StandardServiceRegistryBuilder()
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.url", URL)
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.username", "sa")
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.password", "")
                .applySetting("hibernate.hbm2ddl.auto", "none")
                .applySetting("hibernate.tenant_identifier_resolver", new com.mailflow.tenant.TenantIdentifierResolver())
                .build();
        sessionFactory = new MetadataSources(registry)
                .addAnnotatedClasses(Campaign.class, CampaignRecipient.class, CampaignTargetAddress.class,
                        Recipient.class, EmailTemplate.class, User.class, Role.class, com.mailflow.organization.entity.Organization.class)
                .buildMetadata()
                .buildSessionFactory();
    }

    @AfterAll
    static void tearDown() {
        if (sessionFactory != null) sessionFactory.close();
        if (registry != null) StandardServiceRegistryBuilder.destroy(registry);
    }

    // ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static int jdbc(String sql) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, "sa", "");
             Statement s = c.createStatement()) {
            return s.executeUpdate(sql);
        }
    }

    private static String jdbcString(String sql) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, "sa", "");
             Statement s = c.createStatement();
             ResultSet rs = s.executeQuery(sql)) {
            return rs.next() ? rs.getString(1) : null;
        }
    }

    private static long jdbcLong(String sql) throws SQLException {
        return Long.parseLong(jdbcString(sql));
    }

    private static void insertCampaign(long id, String status, long sentCount) throws SQLException {
        jdbc("INSERT INTO campaigns (id, name, subject, status, total_recipients, sent_count, failed_count,"
                + " skipped_count, bounced_count, retry_count, version) VALUES ("
                + id + ", 'Campaign " + id + "', 'Hello', '" + status + "', 0, " + sentCount + ", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)");
    }

    private static void insertRow(long id, long campaignId, String status, String key) throws SQLException {
        jdbc("INSERT INTO campaign_recipients (id, campaign_id, recipient_id, delivery_status, idempotency_key,"
                + " queued_at, retry_count, email) VALUES (" + id + ", " + campaignId + ", NULL, '" + status + "', '"
                + key + "', " + ("QUEUED".equals(status) ? "CURRENT_TIMESTAMP" : "NULL") + ", 0, '" + key + "@test.local')");
    }

    private static String rowStatus(String key) throws SQLException {
        return jdbcString("SELECT delivery_status FROM campaign_recipients WHERE idempotency_key = '" + key + "'");
    }

    private static void setRows(List<String> keys, String status) throws SQLException {
        jdbc("UPDATE campaign_recipients SET delivery_status = '" + status + "' WHERE idempotency_key IN ('"
                + String.join("', '", keys) + "')");
    }

    private static String queryOf(Class<?> repository, String method, Class<?>... params) throws Exception {
        return repository.getMethod(method, params).getAnnotation(Query.class).value();
    }

    private static int execute(String hql, Object... nameValuePairs) {
        try (Session session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            Transaction tx = session.beginTransaction();
            var query = session.createMutationQuery(hql);
            for (int i = 0; i < nameValuePairs.length; i += 2) {
                query.setParameter((String) nameValuePairs[i], nameValuePairs[i + 1]);
            }
            int changed = query.executeUpdate();
            tx.commit();
            return changed;
        }
    }

    /** The real step-scoped reader, with its status check reading the campaigns table. */
    private static JpaPagingItemReader<CampaignRecipient> openReader(long campaignId) throws Exception {
        CampaignRepository statusSource = mock(CampaignRepository.class);
        when(statusSource.findStatusById(campaignId)).thenAnswer(inv -> Optional.ofNullable(
                jdbcString("SELECT status FROM campaigns WHERE id = " + campaignId)).map(CampaignStatus::valueOf));
        MailFlowProperties properties = new MailFlowProperties(); // chunk (page) size 50
        CampaignBatchConfig config = new CampaignBatchConfig(null, null, properties, sessionFactory,
                null, null, null, null, null, null, statusSource);

        JpaPagingItemReader<CampaignRecipient> reader = config.campaignItemReader(campaignId);
        reader.afterPropertiesSet();
        reader.open(new ExecutionContext());
        return reader;
    }

    /** Reads at most {@code max} rows (one chunk) and returns their keys. */
    private static List<String> readChunk(JpaPagingItemReader<CampaignRecipient> reader, int max) throws Exception {
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>();
        CampaignRecipient row;
        while (keys.size() < max && (row = reader.read()) != null) {
            keys.add(row.getIdempotencyKey());
        }
        return keys;
    }

    // ── Reader ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void reader_stops_at_the_next_page_after_a_pause_and_a_resume_reads_only_unsent_rows() throws Exception {
        insertCampaign(70, "RUNNING", 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 120; i++) insertRow(7000 + i, 70, "PENDING", "campaign_70_addr_" + i);

        JpaPagingItemReader<CampaignRecipient> firstRun = openReader(70);
        List<String> firstChunk = readChunk(firstRun, 50);
        assertThat(firstChunk).hasSize(50);
        setRows(firstChunk, "QUEUED"); // what the writer does for the chunk

        jdbc("UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'PAUSED' WHERE id = 70");
        // The next page is not read: end of input, so the step (and the job) ends.
        assertThat(firstRun.read()).isNull();
        firstRun.close();
        assertThat(jdbcLong("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = 70"
                + " AND delivery_status = 'PENDING'")).isEqualTo(70);

        // While paused, the consumer held 10 queued messages (back to PENDING through the
        // real query) and had already sent the other 40.
        String toPending = queryOf(CampaignRecipientRepository.class, "returnQueuedToPending", String.class);
        for (String key : firstChunk.subList(0, 10)) {
            assertThat(execute(toPending, "key", key)).isOne();
        }
        setRows(firstChunk.subList(10, 50), "SENT");

        // Resume: a new run reads the 80 unsent rows, never the 40 sent ones.
        jdbc("UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'RUNNING' WHERE id = 70");
        JpaPagingItemReader<CampaignRecipient> resumed = openReader(70);
        List<String> readOnResume = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> chunk;
        while (!(chunk = readChunk(resumed, 50)).isEmpty()) {
            readOnResume.addAll(chunk);
            setRows(chunk, "QUEUED");
        }
        resumed.close();

        assertThat(readOnResume).hasSize(80).doesNotHaveDuplicates()
                .containsAll(firstChunk.subList(0, 10))
                .doesNotContainAnyElementsOf(firstChunk.subList(10, 50));
    }

    @Test
    void reader_reads_nothing_for_a_campaign_cancelled_before_its_job_started() throws Exception {
        insertCampaign(77, "CANCELLED", 0);
        insertRow(7701, 77, "PENDING", "campaign_77_addr_1");

        JpaPagingItemReader<CampaignRecipient> reader = openReader(77);
        assertThat(reader.read()).isNull();
        reader.close();
        assertThat(rowStatus("campaign_77_addr_1")).isEqualTo("PENDING");
    }

    // ── Job listener's conditional status update ────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void conditional_status_update_changes_only_a_campaign_in_the_expected_status() throws Exception {
        insertCampaign(71, "PAUSED", 3);
        insertCampaign(72, "RUNNING", 3);
        insertCampaign(73, "CANCELLED", 3);
        String hql = queryOf(CampaignRepository.class, "updateStatusIfIn",
                Long.class, CampaignStatus.class, Collection.class, Instant.class);

        // A job finishing after a pause, a normal finish, and a job starting after a cancel.
        assertThat(execute(hql, "id", 71L, "status", CampaignStatus.COMPLETED,
                "expected", List.of(CampaignStatus.RUNNING), "now", Instant.now())).isZero();
        assertThat(execute(hql, "id", 72L, "status", CampaignStatus.COMPLETED,
                "expected", List.of(CampaignStatus.RUNNING), "now", Instant.now())).isOne();
        assertThat(execute(hql, "id", 73L, "status", CampaignStatus.RUNNING,
                "expected", List.of(CampaignStatus.QUEUED), "now", Instant.now())).isZero();

        assertThat(jdbcString("SELECT status FROM campaigns WHERE id = 71")).isEqualTo("PAUSED");
        assertThat(jdbcString("SELECT status FROM campaigns WHERE id = 72")).isEqualTo("COMPLETED");
        assertThat(jdbcString("SELECT status FROM campaigns WHERE id = 73")).isEqualTo("CANCELLED");
        assertThat(jdbcLong("SELECT sent_count FROM campaigns WHERE id = 72")).isEqualTo(3);
    }

    // ── Consumer: held and skipped rows, row lock ───────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void held_and_cancelled_messages_change_only_queued_rows() throws Exception {
        insertCampaign(76, "PAUSED", 0);
        insertRow(7601, 76, "QUEUED", "k76_held");
        insertRow(7602, 76, "SENT", "k76_sent_a");
        insertRow(7603, 76, "QUEUED", "k76_cancelled");
        insertRow(7604, 76, "SENT", "k76_sent_b");
        String toPending = queryOf(CampaignRecipientRepository.class, "returnQueuedToPending", String.class);
        String skip = queryOf(CampaignRecipientRepository.class, "skipQueued", String.class, Instant.class, String.class);

        assertThat(execute(toPending, "key", "k76_held")).isOne();
        assertThat(execute(toPending, "key", "k76_sent_a")).isZero();
        assertThat(execute(skip, "key", "k76_cancelled", "now", Instant.now(), "reason", "Campaign cancelled")).isOne();
        assertThat(execute(skip, "key", "k76_sent_b", "now", Instant.now(), "reason", "Campaign cancelled")).isZero();

        assertThat(rowStatus("k76_held")).isEqualTo("PENDING");
        assertThat(jdbcString("SELECT queued_at FROM campaign_recipients WHERE idempotency_key = 'k76_held'")).isNull();
        assertThat(rowStatus("k76_sent_a")).isEqualTo("SENT");
        assertThat(rowStatus("k76_cancelled")).isEqualTo("SKIPPED");
        assertThat(jdbcString("SELECT last_error FROM campaign_recipients WHERE idempotency_key = 'k76_cancelled'"))
                .isEqualTo("Campaign cancelled");
        assertThat(rowStatus("k76_sent_b")).isEqualTo("SENT");
    }

    @Test
    void the_consumers_campaign_lock_makes_a_concurrent_status_change_wait() throws Exception {
        insertCampaign(75, "PAUSED", 0);
        Method method = CampaignRepository.class.getMethod("findByIdForUpdate", Long.class);
        String hql = method.getAnnotation(Query.class).value();
        LockModeType mode = method.getAnnotation(Lock.class).value();

        try (Session consumer = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            Transaction tx = consumer.beginTransaction();
            Campaign locked = consumer.createQuery(hql, Campaign.class)
                    .setParameter("id", 75L).setLockMode(mode).getSingleResult();
            assertThat(locked.getStatus()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.PAUSED);

            // A resume updating the same row must wait; H2 gives up after the lock timeout.
            try (Connection resume = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, "sa", "");
                 Statement st = resume.createStatement()) {
                st.execute("SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 300");
                assertThatThrownBy(() -> st.executeUpdate("UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'QUEUED' WHERE id = 75"))
                        .isInstanceOf(SQLException.class);
            }
            tx.commit();
        }
        // Once the consumer's transaction has ended, the resume goes through.
        assertThat(jdbc("UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'QUEUED' WHERE id = 75")).isOne();
    }

    // ── @DynamicUpdate ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void saving_a_status_change_keeps_counter_increments_made_after_the_campaign_was_loaded() throws Exception {
        insertCampaign(74, "RUNNING", 5);
        String increment = queryOf(CampaignRepository.class, "incrementCounters",
                Long.class, long.class, long.class, long.class, long.class, Instant.class);

        try (Session pause = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            Transaction tx = pause.beginTransaction();
            Campaign campaign = pause.get(Campaign.class, 74L); // what pause() loads
            assertThat(campaign.getSentCount()).isEqualTo(5);

            // Meanwhile the email consumer records a sent email (a bulk update that
            // doesn't change the version, so the optimistic lock can't catch it).
            assertThat(execute(increment, "id", 74L, "sent", 1L, "failed", 0L, "skipped", 0L,
                    "retries", 0L, "now", Instant.now())).isOne();

            campaign.setStatus(CampaignStatus.PAUSED);
            tx.commit();
        }

        assertThat(jdbcString("SELECT status FROM campaigns WHERE id = 74")).isEqualTo("PAUSED");
        // A full-row update would have written back the sent count loaded above (5).
        assertThat(jdbcLong("SELECT sent_count FROM campaigns WHERE id = 74")).isEqualTo(6);
        assertThat(jdbcLong("SELECT version FROM campaigns WHERE id = 74")).isEqualTo(1);
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/batch/CampaignPauseResumeTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.batch;

import com.mailflow.analytics.EmailLogService;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.config.RabbitMQConfig;
import com.mailflow.email.EmailProvider;
import com.mailflow.email.RateLimiterService;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailConsumer;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailMessage;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.EnumSource;
import org.mockito.InOrder;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.amqp.AmqpException;
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate;
import org.springframework.batch.core.BatchStatus;
import org.springframework.batch.core.JobExecution;
import org.springframework.batch.core.JobParametersBuilder;
import org.springframework.batch.item.Chunk;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.ValueOperations;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyLong;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.doThrow;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.inOrder;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verifyNoInteractions;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verifyNoMoreInteractions;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

/**
 * Pause, resume and cancel through the send pipeline: the job listener never
 * overwrites PAUSED or CANCELLED, the writer never publishes a row twice, and the
 * email consumer re-checks the campaign status before sending.
 *
 * <p>The JPQL behind the repository calls is run on H2 in
 * {@link CampaignPauseResumeQueriesTest}.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CampaignPauseResumeTest {

    private static final long CAMPAIGN_ID = 7L;
    private static final String KEY = "campaign_7_recipient_10";

    @Mock private CampaignRepository campaignRepository;
    @Mock private CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;

    // ── Job listener ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static JobExecution execution(BatchStatus status) {
        JobExecution e = new JobExecution(1L,
                new JobParametersBuilder().addLong("campaignId", CAMPAIGN_ID).toJobParameters());
        e.setStatus(status);
        return e;
    }

    @Test
    void job_start_marks_only_a_queued_campaign_running() {
        when(campaignRepository.updateStatusIfIn(eq(CAMPAIGN_ID), eq(CampaignStatus.RUNNING),
                eq(List.of(CampaignStatus.QUEUED)), any(Instant.class))).thenReturn(0);

        // 0 rows: for example cancelled while queued. Nothing else is written.
        new CampaignJobListener(campaignRepository).beforeJob(execution(BatchStatus.STARTED));

        verify(campaignRepository).updateStatusIfIn(eq(CAMPAIGN_ID), eq(CampaignStatus.RUNNING),
                eq(List.of(CampaignStatus.QUEUED)), any(Instant.class));
        verifyNoMoreInteractions(campaignRepository);
    }

    @Test
    void job_end_changes_only_a_running_campaign_so_paused_and_cancelled_are_kept() {
        CampaignJobListener listener = new CampaignJobListener(campaignRepository);

        listener.afterJob(execution(BatchStatus.COMPLETED));
        listener.afterJob(execution(BatchStatus.FAILED));
        listener.afterJob(execution(BatchStatus.STOPPED));

        verify(campaignRepository).updateStatusIfIn(eq(CAMPAIGN_ID), eq(CampaignStatus.COMPLETED),
                eq(List.of(CampaignStatus.RUNNING)), any(Instant.class));
        verify(campaignRepository).updateStatusIfIn(eq(CAMPAIGN_ID), eq(CampaignStatus.FAILED),
                eq(List.of(CampaignStatus.RUNNING)), any(Instant.class));
        verify(campaignRepository).updateStatusIfIn(eq(CAMPAIGN_ID), eq(CampaignStatus.PAUSED),
                eq(List.of(CampaignStatus.RUNNING)), any(Instant.class));
        // The unconditional update that used to overwrite PAUSED with COMPLETED is gone.
        verify(campaignRepository, never()).updateStatus(anyLong(), any(), any());
        verifyNoMoreInteractions(campaignRepository);
    }

    // ── Writer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Mock private RabbitTemplate rabbitTemplate;

    private static EmailMessage message(String key) {
        return EmailMessage.builder()
                .idempotencyKey(key)
                .campaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)
                .recipientId(10L)
                .toAddress("ada@test.local")
                .senderEmail("noreply@mailflow.local")
                .subject("Hi Ada")
                .htmlBody("<p>Hi Ada</p>")
                .plainBody("Hi Ada")
                .attemptNumber(1)
                .createdAt(Instant.now())
                .build();
    }

    private CampaignItemWriter writerOfARunningCampaign() {
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(CampaignStatus.RUNNING));
        return new CampaignItemWriter(rabbitTemplate, campaignRecipientRepository, campaignRepository);
    }

    @Test
    void writer_marks_a_row_queued_before_publishing_it() {
        EmailMessage m = message(KEY);
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.markQueued(eq(KEY), any(Instant.class))).thenReturn(1);

        writerOfARunningCampaign().write(Chunk.of(m));

        InOrder order = inOrder(campaignRecipientRepository, rabbitTemplate);
        order.verify(campaignRecipientRepository).markQueued(eq(KEY), any(Instant.class));
        order.verify(rabbitTemplate).convertAndSend(RabbitMQConfig.EMAIL_EXCHANGE, RabbitMQConfig.EMAIL_ROUTING_KEY, m);
    }

    @Test
    void writer_does_not_publish_a_row_that_another_run_already_queued_or_sent() {
        // A pause followed quickly by a resume can briefly overlap two runs that read the
        // same PENDING rows; the second claim finds the row QUEUED and gets 0.
        EmailMessage first = message(KEY);
        EmailMessage second = message("campaign_7_recipient_11");
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.markQueued(eq(KEY), any(Instant.class))).thenReturn(0);
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.markQueued(eq("campaign_7_recipient_11"), any(Instant.class))).thenReturn(1);

        writerOfARunningCampaign().write(Chunk.of(first, second));

        verify(rabbitTemplate, never()).convertAndSend(anyString(), anyString(), eq(first));
        verify(rabbitTemplate).convertAndSend(RabbitMQConfig.EMAIL_EXCHANGE, RabbitMQConfig.EMAIL_ROUTING_KEY, second);
    }

    @Test
    void writer_rethrows_a_publish_failure_so_the_chunk_and_its_marks_roll_back() {
        EmailMessage m = message(KEY);
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.markQueued(eq(KEY), any(Instant.class))).thenReturn(1);
        doThrow(new AmqpException("broker down")).when(rabbitTemplate)
                .convertAndSend(RabbitMQConfig.EMAIL_EXCHANGE, RabbitMQConfig.EMAIL_ROUTING_KEY, m);

        CampaignItemWriter writer = writerOfARunningCampaign();
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> writer.write(Chunk.of(m)))
                .isInstanceOf(AmqpException.class);
    }

    // ── Consumer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Mock private EmailProvider emailProvider;
    @Mock private RateLimiterService rateLimiter;
    @Mock private EmailLogService emailLogService;
    @Mock private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    @Mock private ValueOperations<String, Object> valueOps;

    private EmailConsumer consumer() {
        return new EmailConsumer(emailProvider, campaignRecipientRepository, campaignRepository,
                rateLimiter, emailLogService, redisTemplate);
    }

    private static Campaign campaignIn(CampaignStatus status) {
        return Campaign.builder().id(CAMPAIGN_ID).name("c").subject("s").status(status).build();
    }

    private void notSentBefore() {
        when(redisTemplate.hasKey("email:sent:" + KEY)).thenReturn(false);
    }

    private void sendingSucceeds() {
        when(rateLimiter.tryAcquire(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(true);
        when(redisTemplate.opsForValue()).thenReturn(valueOps);
    }

    @Test
    void message_of_a_paused_campaign_is_not_sent_and_its_row_goes_back_to_pending() {
        notSentBefore();
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(CampaignStatus.PAUSED));
        when(campaignRepository.findByIdForUpdate(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(campaignIn(CampaignStatus.PAUSED)));
        EmailMessage m = message(KEY);

        consumer().consume(m);

        // Back to PENDING so the resumed job publishes it again; the rate-limit token is
        // not used and no counter or log entry is written.
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).returnQueuedToPending(KEY);
        verifyNoInteractions(emailProvider, rateLimiter, emailLogService);
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).markSent(anyString(), any());
        verify(campaignRepository, never()).incrementCounters(anyLong(), anyLong(), anyLong(), anyLong(), anyLong(), any());
    }

    @Test
    void message_is_sent_when_the_campaign_was_resumed_between_the_two_status_reads() {
        notSentBefore();
        sendingSucceeds();
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(CampaignStatus.PAUSED));
        // Re-read under the row lock: the resume committed first.
        when(campaignRepository.findByIdForUpdate(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(campaignIn(CampaignStatus.QUEUED)));

        consumer().consume(message(KEY));

        verify(emailProvider).send(any());
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).markSent(eq(KEY), any(Instant.class));
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).returnQueuedToPending(anyString());
    }

    @Test
    void message_of_a_cancelled_campaign_is_skipped_not_sent() {
        notSentBefore();
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(CampaignStatus.CANCELLED));

        consumer().consume(message(KEY));

        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).skipQueued(eq(KEY), any(Instant.class), eq("Campaign cancelled"));
        verifyNoInteractions(emailProvider, rateLimiter, emailLogService);
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).markSent(anyString(), any());
    }

    @Test
    void message_of_a_campaign_that_no_longer_exists_is_not_sent() {
        notSentBefore();
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        consumer().consume(message(KEY));

        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).skipQueued(eq(KEY), any(Instant.class), eq("Campaign no longer exists"));
        verifyNoInteractions(emailProvider, rateLimiter, emailLogService);
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @EnumSource(value = CampaignStatus.class, names = {"QUEUED", "RUNNING", "COMPLETED", "FAILED"})
    void message_is_sent_while_the_campaign_is_sending_or_its_job_has_ended(CampaignStatus status) {
        // COMPLETED and FAILED: the job has finished publishing, but messages it already
        // published are still delivered.
        notSentBefore();
        sendingSucceeds();
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(status));

        consumer().consume(message(KEY));

        verify(emailProvider).send(any());
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).markSent(eq(KEY), any(Instant.class));
        verify(campaignRepository).incrementCounters(eq(CAMPAIGN_ID), eq(1L), eq(0L), eq(0L), eq(0L), any(Instant.class));
        verify(campaignRepository, never()).findByIdForUpdate(anyLong());
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).returnQueuedToPending(anyString());
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).skipQueued(anyString(), any(), anyString());
    }

    @Test
    void an_already_sent_message_is_suppressed_before_the_status_is_read() {
        when(redisTemplate.hasKey("email:sent:" + KEY)).thenReturn(true);

        consumer().consume(message(KEY));

        verifyNoInteractions(campaignRepository, emailProvider, rateLimiter);
    }
}
````

````java
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CampaignContentTest {

        return Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG)
                .id(CAMPAIGN_ID)
                .name("Welcome")
                .subject("Hello {{FirstName}}")
                .customBody(BODY)
                .senderEmail("sender@test.local")
                .status(CampaignStatus.DRAFT)
                .recipientIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(10L)))

    private static CampaignRecipient contactRow(Campaign campaign, Recipient r) {

                .deliveryStatus(CampaignRecipient.DeliveryStatus.PENDING)
                .snapshotEmail("ada@test.local").snapshotName("Ada Lovelace").snapshotFirstName("Ada")
                .snapshotLastName("Lovelace").snapshotCompany("Acme")

    private void assertLaunchRejected(String message) {
````
