````java
package com.mailflow.campaign;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.mailflow.batch.CampaignJobLauncher;
import com.mailflow.campaign.dto.CampaignRequest;
import com.mailflow.campaign.dto.CampaignResponse;
import com.mailflow.campaign.dto.TargetAddress;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignTargetAddress;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignTargetAddressRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.service.CampaignService;
import com.mailflow.email.UnsubscribeService;
import com.mailflow.recipient.repository.RecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.template.entity.EmailTemplate;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyIterable;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyList;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.lenient;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.times;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

/**
 * Editing a draft never silently clears data. PUT replaces the scalar fields, but
 * {@code templateId}, {@code recipientIds}, {@code recipientGroupIds} and
 * {@code targetAddresses} change only when the request sends them: {@code null}
 * (or omitted) keeps the stored value and {@code []} clears it.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CampaignDraftUpdateTest {

    private static final long CAMPAIGN_ID = 9L;

    private static final TargetAddress ADA = new TargetAddress(
            "ada@test.local", "Ada Lovelace", "Ada", "Lovelace", "Acme", Map.of("Team", "Platform"));
    private static final TargetAddress BOB = new TargetAddress(
            "bob@test.local", null, null, null, null, Map.of());

    @Mock private CampaignRepository campaignRepository;
    @Mock private TemplateService templateService;
    @Mock private CampaignJobLauncher jobLauncher;
    @Mock private RecipientRepository recipientRepository;
    @Mock private CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    @Mock private UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;
    @Mock private CampaignTargetAddressRepository targetAddressRepository;

    private CampaignService campaignService;
    private EmailTemplate template;

    /** The stored campaign: JPA hands out the same managed entity on every read. */
    private Campaign stored;
    /** In-memory campaign_target_addresses rows of the campaign, in ID order. */
    private final List<CampaignTargetAddress> addresses = new ArrayList<>();
    private long nextAddressId = 1;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        campaignService = new CampaignService(
                campaignRepository, templateService, jobLauncher,
                recipientRepository, campaignRecipientRepository, unsubscribeService,
                targetAddressRepository);

        template = new EmailTemplate();
        template.setId(1L);
        template.setName("Welcome");
        template.setSubject("Hello");

        lenient().when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenAnswer(inv -> Optional.ofNullable(stored));
        lenient().when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            Campaign c = inv.getArgument(0);
            if (c.getId() == null) c.setId(CAMPAIGN_ID);
            stored = c;
            return c;
        });
        lenient().when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_ID))
                .thenAnswer(inv -> new ArrayList<>(addresses));
        lenient().when(targetAddressRepository.saveAll(anyList())).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            List<CampaignTargetAddress> rows = inv.getArgument(0);
            for (CampaignTargetAddress t : rows) {
                if (t.getId() == null) {
                    t.setId(nextAddressId++);
                    addresses.add(t);
                }
            }
            return rows;
        });
        lenient().doAnswer(inv -> {
            Iterable<CampaignTargetAddress> gone = inv.getArgument(0);
            gone.forEach(addresses::remove);
            return null;
        }).when(targetAddressRepository).deleteAll(anyIterable());
    }

    /** A saved draft with every field set: template, contacts, a group and two campaign-only addresses. */
    private void seedDraft() {
        stored = Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG)
                .id(CAMPAIGN_ID)
                .name("Spring launch")
                .description("Internal note")
                .subject("Hello {{FirstName}}")
                .template(template)
                .senderName("MailFlow Team")
                .senderEmail("sender@test.local")
                .replyTo("replies@test.local")
                .status(CampaignStatus.DRAFT)
                .recipientIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(10L, 11L)))
                .recipientGroupIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(3L)))
                .build();
        addresses.add(CampaignTargetAddress.builder()
                .id(nextAddressId++).campaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID).email(ADA.email()).name(ADA.name())
                .firstName(ADA.firstName()).lastName(ADA.lastName()).company(ADA.company())
                .customFields(new HashMap<>(ADA.fields())).build());
        addresses.add(CampaignTargetAddress.builder()
                .id(nextAddressId++).campaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID).email(BOB.email()).build());
    }

    private void assertTargetsKept(CampaignResponse response) {
        assertThat(response.templateId()).isEqualTo(1L);
        assertThat(response.recipientIds()).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(10L, 11L);
        assertThat(response.recipientGroupIds()).containsExactly(3L);
        assertThat(response.targetAddresses()).containsExactly(ADA, BOB);
        assertThat(response.targetAddressCount()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(stored.getTemplate()).isSameAs(template);
        assertThat(stored.getRecipientIds()).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(10L, 11L);
        assertThat(stored.getRecipientGroupIds()).containsExactly(3L);
    }

    // ── null keeps ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void update_with_template_and_lists_omitted_or_null_keeps_them() throws Exception {
        seedDraft();
        // Bound by Jackson as for PUT /api/campaigns/9: templateId and recipientIds are
        // omitted, recipientGroupIds and targetAddresses are explicitly null.
        CampaignRequest request = new ObjectMapper().findAndRegisterModules().readValue("""
                {"name": "Renamed", "description": "Internal note", "subject": "New subject",
                 "senderName": "MailFlow Team", "senderEmail": "sender@test.local",
                 "replyTo": "replies@test.local", "recipientGroupIds": null, "targetAddresses": null}
                """, CampaignRequest.class);
        assertThat(request.templateId()).isNull();
        assertThat(request.recipientIds()).isNull();

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.update(CAMPAIGN_ID, request);

        assertThat(response.name()).isEqualTo("Renamed");
        assertThat(response.subject()).isEqualTo("New subject");
        assertTargetsKept(response);
        verify(templateService, never()).getOrThrow(any());
        verify(targetAddressRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
        verify(targetAddressRepository, never()).deleteAll(anyIterable());
    }

    // ── [] clears ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void update_with_empty_lists_clears_recipients_groups_and_campaign_only_addresses() {
        seedDraft();

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.update(CAMPAIGN_ID, new CampaignRequest(
                "Spring launch", null, "Hello {{FirstName}}", null, null, "sender@test.local", null, null,
                List.of(), List.of(), List.of(), null));

        assertThat(response.recipientIds()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(response.recipientGroupIds()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(response.targetAddresses()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(response.targetAddressCount()).isZero();
        assertThat(stored.getRecipientIds()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(stored.getRecipientGroupIds()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(addresses).isEmpty();
        // templateId null still keeps the template: it can be replaced, never removed.
        assertThat(response.templateId()).isEqualTo(1L);
    }

    // ── Scalar fields: PUT semantics ────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void scalar_fields_are_replaced_and_a_null_optional_field_is_cleared() {
        seedDraft();
        Instant at = Instant.parse("2030-01-01T09:00:00Z");

        CampaignResponse replaced = campaignService.update(CAMPAIGN_ID, new CampaignRequest(
                "Renamed", "New note", "New subject", null, "New Team", "new.sender@test.local",
                "new.replies@test.local", at, null, null, null, null));

        assertThat(replaced.name()).isEqualTo("Renamed");
        assertThat(replaced.description()).isEqualTo("New note");
        assertThat(replaced.subject()).isEqualTo("New subject");
        assertThat(replaced.senderName()).isEqualTo("New Team");
        assertThat(replaced.senderEmail()).isEqualTo("new.sender@test.local");
        assertThat(replaced.replyTo()).isEqualTo("new.replies@test.local");
        assertThat(replaced.scheduledAt()).isEqualTo(at);
        // Saving never changes the status, so a scheduledAt on a draft doesn't schedule it.
        assertThat(replaced.status()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);

        CampaignResponse cleared = campaignService.update(CAMPAIGN_ID, new CampaignRequest(
                "Renamed", null, "New subject", null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null));

        assertThat(cleared.description()).isNull();
        assertThat(cleared.senderName()).isNull();
        assertThat(cleared.senderEmail()).isNull();
        assertThat(cleared.replyTo()).isNull();
        assertThat(cleared.scheduledAt()).isNull();
        assertThat(cleared.status()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);
        // The template and the recipient lists are not scalar fields: null keeps them.
        assertTargetsKept(cleared);
    }

    // ── Round trip: save, reopen, edit, reopen ──────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void round_trip_edit_keeps_template_recipients_campaign_only_addresses_sender_and_reply_to() {
        when(templateService.getOrThrow(1L)).thenReturn(template);

        // Save a new draft, then reopen it (GET) as the campaign form does.
        campaignService.create(new CampaignRequest(
                "Spring launch", "Internal note", "Hello {{FirstName}}", 1L,
                "MailFlow Team", "sender@test.local", "replies@test.local", null,
                List.of(3L), List.of(10L, 11L), List.of(ADA, BOB), "Dear {{FirstName}},\nsee you soon."));
        CampaignResponse opened = campaignService.findById(CAMPAIGN_ID);

        // Change the subject and save the full payload: every other field comes from
        // the reopened draft, including scheduledAt, the groups and the body.
        campaignService.update(CAMPAIGN_ID, new CampaignRequest(
                opened.name(), opened.description(), "Hi {{FirstName}}, it's here", opened.templateId(),
                opened.senderName(), opened.senderEmail(), opened.replyTo(), opened.scheduledAt(),
                opened.recipientGroupIds(), opened.recipientIds(), opened.targetAddresses(), opened.customBody()));
        CampaignResponse reopened = campaignService.findById(CAMPAIGN_ID);

        assertThat(reopened.subject()).isEqualTo("Hi {{FirstName}}, it's here");
        assertThat(reopened.status()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);
        assertThat(reopened.name()).isEqualTo("Spring launch");
        assertThat(reopened.description()).isEqualTo("Internal note");
        assertThat(reopened.templateName()).isEqualTo("Welcome");
        assertThat(reopened.senderName()).isEqualTo("MailFlow Team");
        assertThat(reopened.senderEmail()).isEqualTo("sender@test.local");
        assertThat(reopened.replyTo()).isEqualTo("replies@test.local");
        assertThat(reopened.scheduledAt()).isNull();
        assertThat(reopened.customBody()).isEqualTo("Dear {{FirstName}},\nsee you soon.");
        assertTargetsKept(reopened);
        // The unchanged campaign-only addresses keep their rows: only create() wrote them.
        verify(targetAddressRepository, times(1)).saveAll(anyList());
        verify(targetAddressRepository, never()).deleteAll(anyIterable());
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

/**
 * Campaign-only addresses: typed or uploaded addresses that a campaign emails
 * without saving them as contacts. Covers storage (create/update validation and the
 * null-keeps / []-clears rule) and launch resolution against saved contacts.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CampaignOnlyAddressesTest {

    private static final long CAMPAIGN_ID = 7L;

    @Mock private CampaignRepository campaignRepository;
    @Mock private TemplateService templateService;
    @Mock private CampaignJobLauncher jobLauncher;
    @Mock private RecipientRepository recipientRepository;
    @Mock private CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    @Mock private UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;
    @Mock private CampaignTargetAddressRepository targetAddressRepository;

    private CampaignService campaignService;
    private Campaign campaign;

    /** In-memory stand-in for the campaign_target_addresses rows of CAMPAIGN_ID. */
    private final List<CampaignTargetAddress> store = new ArrayList<>();
    private long nextStoredId = 1;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        campaignService = new CampaignService(
                campaignRepository, templateService, jobLauncher,
                recipientRepository, campaignRecipientRepository, unsubscribeService,
                targetAddressRepository);

        EmailTemplate template = new EmailTemplate();
        template.setId(1L);
        template.setName("Welcome");
        template.setSubject("Hello");
        template.setPlainBody("Hello {{FirstName}}");

        campaign = Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG)
                .id(CAMPAIGN_ID)
                .name("Campaign-only test")
                .subject("Hello {{FirstName}}")
                .senderEmail("sender@test.local")
                .status(CampaignStatus.DRAFT)
                .template(template)
                .build();
    }

    // ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static CampaignTargetAddress stored(String email, String name) {
        return CampaignTargetAddress.builder().campaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID).email(email).name(name).build();
    }

    private static Recipient contact(long id, String email, RecipientStatus status) {
        return Recipient.builder().id(id).email(email).status(status).build();
    }

    private static TargetAddress address(String email) {
        return new TargetAddress(email, null, null, null, null, null);
    }

    private static CampaignRequest request(List<TargetAddress> targetAddresses) {
        return new CampaignRequest("Campaign-only test", null, "Hello {{FirstName}}", null,
                null, "sender@test.local", null, null, null, null, targetAddresses, null);
    }

    private void useInMemoryTargetStore() {
        lenient().when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_ID))
                .thenAnswer(inv -> new ArrayList<>(store));
        lenient().when(targetAddressRepository.saveAll(anyList())).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            List<CampaignTargetAddress> rows = inv.getArgument(0);
            for (CampaignTargetAddress t : rows) {
                if (t.getId() == null) {
                    t.setId(nextStoredId++);
                    store.add(t);
                }
            }
            return rows;
        });
        lenient().doAnswer(inv -> {
            Iterable<CampaignTargetAddress> gone = inv.getArgument(0);
            gone.forEach(store::remove);
            return null;
        }).when(targetAddressRepository).deleteAll(anyIterable());
    }

    private void prepareLaunch() {
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(campaign));
        lenient().when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private List<CampaignRecipient> savedRows() {
        ArgumentCaptor<List<CampaignRecipient>> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(List.class);
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).saveAll(captor.capture());
        return captor.getValue();
    }

    private void verifyNoContactWasCreated() {
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).save(any());
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
    }

    // ── Launch ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void launch_with_only_campaign_only_addresses_creates_rows_without_a_contact() {
        prepareLaunch();
        CampaignTargetAddress ada = CampaignTargetAddress.builder()
                .campaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID).email("ada@test.local").name("Ada Lovelace")
                .firstName("Ada").lastName("Lovelace").company("Acme")
                .customFields(Map.of("Team", "Platform")).build();
        CampaignTargetAddress bob = stored("bob@test.local", null);
        when(targetAddressRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(2L);
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(List.of(ada, bob));
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("ada@test.local", "bob@test.local"))).thenReturn(List.of());
        when(recipientRepository.findDeletedEmails(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("ada@test.local", "bob@test.local"))).thenReturn(List.of());
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(2L);

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_ID);

        List<CampaignRecipient> rows = savedRows();
        assertThat(rows).hasSize(2).allSatisfy(row -> {
            assertThat(row.getRecipient()).isNull();
            assertThat(row.getCampaign()).isSameAs(campaign);
            assertThat(row.getDeliveryStatus()).isEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.DeliveryStatus.PENDING);
            assertThat(row.getIdempotencyKey())
                    .startsWith("campaign_7_addr_").hasSizeLessThanOrEqualTo(100).doesNotContain("@");
        });
        assertThat(rows).extracting(CampaignRecipient::getIdempotencyKey).doesNotHaveDuplicates();

        CampaignRecipient adaRow = rows.get(0);
        assertThat(adaRow.getSnapshotEmail()).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(adaRow.getSnapshotName()).isEqualTo("Ada Lovelace");
        assertThat(adaRow.getSnapshotFirstName()).isEqualTo("Ada");
        assertThat(adaRow.getSnapshotLastName()).isEqualTo("Lovelace");
        assertThat(adaRow.getSnapshotCompany()).isEqualTo("Acme");
        assertThat(adaRow.getSnapshotCustomFields()).containsExactly(entry("Team", "Platform"));
        assertThat(adaRow.getIdempotencyKey())
                .isEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(CAMPAIGN_ID, "ada@test.local"));
        assertThat(rows.get(1).targetEmail()).isEqualTo("bob@test.local");

        assertThat(response.status()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.QUEUED);
        assertThat(response.totalRecipients()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(response.targetAddressCount()).isEqualTo(2);
        verify(jobLauncher).launchCampaignJob(CAMPAIGN_ID);
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).findAllActiveRecipients();
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).findByIdsIn(any(), any());
        verifyNoContactWasCreated();
    }

    @Test
    void address_that_is_also_a_selected_saved_contact_gets_one_row_for_the_contact() {
        prepareLaunch();
        Recipient ada = contact(10L, "ada@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);
        campaign.setRecipientIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(10L)));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, Set.of(10L))).thenReturn(List.of(ada));
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_ID))
                .thenReturn(List.of(stored("ada@test.local", "Typed Ada"), stored("new@test.local", null)));
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("ada@test.local", "new@test.local"))).thenReturn(List.of(ada));
        when(recipientRepository.findDeletedEmails(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of());
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(2L);

        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_ID);

        List<CampaignRecipient> rows = savedRows();
        assertThat(rows).extracting(CampaignRecipient::targetEmail)
                .containsExactly("ada@test.local", "new@test.local");
        CampaignRecipient adaRow = rows.get(0);
        assertThat(adaRow.getRecipient()).isSameAs(ada);
        assertThat(adaRow.getSnapshotEmail()).isNull();
        assertThat(adaRow.getIdempotencyKey()).isEqualTo("campaign_7_recipient_10");
        assertThat(rows.get(1).getRecipient()).isNull();
        assertThat(rows.get(1).getSnapshotEmail()).isEqualTo("new@test.local");
    }

    @Test
    void address_that_has_since_become_a_contact_uses_the_contact_and_respects_its_status() {
        prepareLaunch();
        when(targetAddressRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(3L);
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(List.of(
                stored("now.active@test.local", "Snapshot name"),
                stored("now.unsubscribed@test.local", null),
                stored("now.bounced@test.local", null)));
        Recipient active = contact(20L, "now.active@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of(
                active,
                contact(21L, "now.unsubscribed@test.local", RecipientStatus.UNSUBSCRIBED),
                contact(22L, "now.bounced@test.local", RecipientStatus.BOUNCED)));
        when(recipientRepository.findDeletedEmails(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of());
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(1L);

        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_ID);

        List<CampaignRecipient> rows = savedRows();
        assertThat(rows).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(rows.get(0).getRecipient()).isSameAs(active);
        assertThat(rows.get(0).getSnapshotEmail()).isNull();
        assertThat(rows.get(0).getIdempotencyKey()).isEqualTo("campaign_7_recipient_20");
        verifyNoContactWasCreated();
    }

    @Test
    void addresses_of_deleted_contacts_and_unsubscribed_addresses_are_skipped() {
        prepareLaunch();
        when(targetAddressRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(3L);
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(List.of(
                stored("gone@test.local", null), stored("optout@test.local", null), stored("ok@test.local", null)));
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of());

        assertThat(savedRows()).extracting(CampaignRecipient::getSnapshotEmail).containsExactly("ok@test.local");
    }

    @Test
    void launch_fails_without_sending_when_every_campaign_only_address_is_skipped() {
        prepareLaunch();
        when(targetAddressRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(2L);
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_ID))
                .thenReturn(List.of(stored("gone@test.local", null), stored("optout@test.local", null)));
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of());
        when(recipientRepository.findDeletedEmails(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of("gone@test.local"));

    @Test
    void relaunch_from_failed_does_not_duplicate_existing_rows() {
        prepareLaunch();
        campaign.setStatus(CampaignStatus.FAILED);
        Recipient ada = contact(10L, "ada@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);

        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, Set.of(10L))).thenReturn(List.of(ada));
        // First launch: a contact row for ada and a campaign-only row for bob.
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.findTargetedEmails(CAMPAIGN_ID))
                .thenReturn(List.of("ada@test.local", "bob@test.local"));
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_ID))
                .thenReturn(List.of(stored("ada@test.local", null), stored("bob@test.local", null)));
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of(ada));

    @Test
    void relaunch_from_paused_does_not_add_a_contact_row_for_an_address_that_became_a_contact() {
        prepareLaunch();
        campaign.setStatus(CampaignStatus.PAUSED);
        when(targetAddressRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(1L);
        // bob already has a campaign-only row from the first launch ...
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.findTargetedEmails(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(List.of("bob@test.local"));
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_ID))
                .thenReturn(List.of(stored("bob@test.local", null)));
        // ... and has been saved as a contact since then.
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList()))
                .thenReturn(List.of(contact(30L, "bob@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)));
        when(recipientRepository.findDeletedEmails(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of());
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(1L);

        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_ID);

        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).existsByCampaignIdAndRecipientId(any(), any());
    }

    @Test
    void address_idempotency_key_is_unique_per_campaign_and_address_and_fits_the_column() {
        String longAddress = "x".repeat(240) + "@test.local";
        String key = CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(Long.MAX_VALUE, longAddress);

        assertThat(key).startsWith("campaign_" + Long.MAX_VALUE + "_addr_")
                .hasSizeLessThanOrEqualTo(100).doesNotContain("@");
        assertThat(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(7L, " Ada@Test.Local "))
                .isEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(7L, "ada@test.local"));
        assertThat(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(7L, "ada@test.local"))
                .isNotEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(7L, "bob@test.local"))
                .isNotEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(8L, "ada@test.local"))
                .isNotEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.buildIdempotencyKey(7L, 1L));
    }

    // ── Create / update ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void create_stores_normalised_unique_addresses_without_creating_contacts() {
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            Campaign c = inv.getArgument(0);
            c.setId(CAMPAIGN_ID);
            return c;
        });
        useInMemoryTargetStore();
        Map<String, String> fields = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        fields.put(" Team ", " Platform ");
        fields.put("email", "shadow@test.local"); // would shadow {{email}}: ignored
        fields.put("Blank", "  ");                 // blank values are dropped

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.create(request(List.of(
                new TargetAddress(" Ada@Test.Local ", " Ada Lovelace ", "Ada", " ", "Acme", fields),
                new TargetAddress("ada@test.local", "Second copy", null, null, null, null),
                address("BOB@test.local"))));

        assertThat(response.status()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);
        assertThat(response.targetAddressCount()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(response.targetAddresses()).extracting(TargetAddress::email)
                .containsExactly("ada@test.local", "bob@test.local");
        TargetAddress ada = response.targetAddresses().get(0);
        assertThat(ada.name()).isEqualTo("Ada Lovelace");
        assertThat(ada.firstName()).isEqualTo("Ada");
        assertThat(ada.lastName()).isNull();
        assertThat(ada.company()).isEqualTo("Acme");
        assertThat(ada.fields()).containsExactly(entry("Team", "Platform"));
        assertThat(store).extracting(CampaignTargetAddress::getCampaignId).containsOnly(CAMPAIGN_ID);
        verifyNoContactWasCreated();
    }

    @Test
    void create_rejects_invalid_addresses_and_names_them() {
        CampaignRequest request = request(List.of(
                address("good@test.local"), address("not-an-email"), address("   "), address("bad@@test.local")));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.create(request))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("(3)")
                .hasMessageContaining("not-an-email")
                .hasMessageContaining("(blank)")
                .hasMessageContaining("bad@@test.local")
                .satisfies(e -> assertThat(e.getMessage()).doesNotContain("good@test.local"));
        verify(campaignRepository, never()).save(any());
        verify(targetAddressRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
    }

    @Test
    void create_rejects_more_than_ten_thousand_addresses() {
        List<TargetAddress> tooMany = IntStream.rangeClosed(1, CampaignService.MAX_TARGET_ADDRESSES + 1)
                .mapToObj(i -> address("user" + i + "@test.local"))
                .toList();

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.create(request(tooMany)))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("at most 10,000");
        verify(campaignRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void update_rejects_invalid_addresses_before_changing_the_draft() {
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(campaign));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.update(CAMPAIGN_ID, new CampaignRequest(
                "Renamed", null, "Hello", null, null, "sender@test.local", null, null, null, null,
                List.of(address("broken.address")), null)))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessage("Invalid campaign-only email address: broken.address");
        assertThat(campaign.getName()).isEqualTo("Campaign-only test");
        verify(campaignRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void update_with_null_target_addresses_keeps_the_stored_ones() {
        store.add(stored("ada@test.local", "Ada"));
        useInMemoryTargetStore();
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(campaign));
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.update(CAMPAIGN_ID, request(null));

        assertThat(response.targetAddresses()).extracting(TargetAddress::email).containsExactly("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(response.targetAddressCount()).isEqualTo(1);
        verify(targetAddressRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
        verify(targetAddressRepository, never()).deleteAll(anyIterable());
    }

    @Test
    void update_with_an_empty_list_removes_all_stored_addresses() {
        store.add(stored("ada@test.local", "Ada"));
        store.add(stored("bob@test.local", "Bob"));
        useInMemoryTargetStore();
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(campaign));
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.update(CAMPAIGN_ID, request(List.of()));

        assertThat(store).isEmpty();
        assertThat(response.targetAddresses()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(response.targetAddressCount()).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void update_with_a_list_replaces_the_addresses_and_keeps_unchanged_rows() {
        CampaignTargetAddress ada = stored("ada@test.local", "Ada");
        ada.setId(nextStoredId++);
        CampaignTargetAddress bob = stored("bob@test.local", "Bob");
        bob.setId(nextStoredId++);
        CampaignTargetAddress carol = stored("carol@test.local", "Carol");
        carol.setId(nextStoredId++);
        store.addAll(List.of(ada, bob, carol));
        useInMemoryTargetStore();
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(campaign));
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.update(CAMPAIGN_ID, request(List.of(
                new TargetAddress("ada@test.local", "Ada", null, null, null, Map.of()),       // unchanged
                new TargetAddress("carol@test.local", "Carol King", null, null, null, null),  // changed
                address("dave@test.local"))));                                                 // new

        assertThat(response.targetAddresses()).extracting(TargetAddress::email)
                .containsExactly("ada@test.local", "carol@test.local", "dave@test.local");
        assertThat(store).contains(ada, carol).doesNotContain(bob);
        assertThat(ada.getId()).isEqualTo(1L);
        assertThat(carol.getName()).isEqualTo("Carol King");

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        ArgumentCaptor<List<CampaignTargetAddress>> saved = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(List.class);
        verify(targetAddressRepository).saveAll(saved.capture());
        assertThat(saved.getValue()).extracting(CampaignTargetAddress::getEmail)
                .containsExactly("carol@test.local", "dave@test.local");
    }

    // ── Responses ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void list_responses_carry_the_count_but_not_the_addresses() throws Exception {
        Campaign other = Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG).id(8L).name("Other").subject("S").build();
        PageRequest pageable = PageRequest.of(0, 20);
        when(campaignRepository.findAll(null, null, pageable)).thenReturn(new PageImpl<>(List.of(campaign, other)));
        when(targetAddressRepository.countByCampaignIds(List.of(CAMPAIGN_ID, 8L)))
                .thenReturn(List.<Object[]>of(new Object[]{CAMPAIGN_ID, 3L}));

        PageResponse<CampaignResponse> page = campaignService.findAll(null, null, pageable);

        assertThat(page.content()).extracting(CampaignResponse::targetAddressCount).containsExactly(3L, 0L);
        assertThat(page.content()).allSatisfy(r -> assertThat(r.targetAddresses()).isNull());
        verify(targetAddressRepository, never()).findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(any());

        String json = new ObjectMapper().findAndRegisterModules().writeValueAsString(page.content().get(0));
        assertThat(json).contains("\"targetAddressCount\":3").doesNotContain("\"targetAddresses\"");
    }

    @Test
    void request_limits_match_the_database_columns() {
        Validator validator = Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory().getValidator();
        Map<String, String> fields = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        fields.put("k".repeat(41), "value");
        fields.put("Team", "v".repeat(1001));
        TargetAddress tooLong = new TargetAddress("ada@test.local", "n".repeat(256), "f".repeat(101),
                "l".repeat(100), "c".repeat(255), fields);

        Set<ConstraintViolation<CampaignRequest>> violations = validator.validate(request(List.of(tooLong)));

        assertThat(violations).extracting(v -> v.getPropertyPath().toString())
                .hasSize(4)
                .anyMatch(p -> p.equals("targetAddresses[0].name"))
                .anyMatch(p -> p.equals("targetAddresses[0].firstName"))
                .filteredOn(p -> p.startsWith("targetAddresses[0].fields")).hasSize(2);
        assertThat(validator.validate(request(List.of(
                new TargetAddress("ada@test.local", "n".repeat(255), "f".repeat(100), null, null,
                        Map.of("Team", "Platform")))))).isEmpty();
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/campaign/CampaignServiceTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.campaign;

import com.mailflow.batch.CampaignJobLauncher;
import com.mailflow.campaign.dto.CampaignRequest;
import com.mailflow.campaign.dto.CampaignResponse;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.service.CampaignService;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ConflictException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import com.mailflow.template.entity.EmailTemplate;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;

import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyList;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

/**
 * Unit tests for CampaignService.
 *
 * CampaignService uses a manual constructor (not @RequiredArgsConstructor)
 * so we build it manually from mocks instead of using @InjectMocks.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CampaignServiceTest {

    @Mock private CampaignRepository campaignRepository;
    @Mock private TemplateService templateService;
    @Mock private CampaignJobLauncher jobLauncher;
    @Mock private com.mailflow.recipient.repository.RecipientRepository recipientRepository;
    @Mock private com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    @Mock private com.mailflow.email.UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;
    @Mock private com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignTargetAddressRepository targetAddressRepository;

    private CampaignService campaignService;

    private Campaign draftCampaign;
    private EmailTemplate template;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        campaignService = new CampaignService(
                campaignRepository, templateService, jobLauncher,
                recipientRepository, campaignRecipientRepository, unsubscribeService,
                targetAddressRepository);

        template = new EmailTemplate();
        template.setId(1L);
        template.setName("Test Template");
        template.setSubject("Test Subject");
        template.setHtmlBody("<p>Hello {{FirstName}}</p>");

        draftCampaign = Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG)
                .id(1L)
                .name("Test Campaign")
                .subject("Test Subject")
                .senderEmail("sender@example.com")
                .status(CampaignStatus.DRAFT)
                .template(template)
                .recipientIds(new java.util.HashSet<>(java.util.Set.of(10L)))
                .build();
    }

    private com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient activeRecipient(long id, String email) {
        com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient r = new com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient();
        r.setId(id);
        r.setEmail(email);
        r.setStatus(com.mailflow.recipient.entity.RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);
        return r;
    }

    @Test
    void creates_campaign_as_draft() {
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            Campaign c = inv.getArgument(0);
            return Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG)
                    .id(1L).name(c.getName()).subject(c.getSubject())
                    .senderEmail(c.getSenderEmail()).status(CampaignStatus.DRAFT)
                    .build();
        });

        CampaignRequest request = new CampaignRequest(
                "Test Campaign", null, "Test Subject", null,
                null, "sender@example.com", null, null, null, null, null, null);

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.create(request);
        assertThat(response.status()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);
        assertThat(response.name()).isEqualTo("Test Campaign");
    }

    @Test
    void launches_valid_campaign() {
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, java.util.Set.of(10L)))
                .thenReturn(java.util.List.of(activeRecipient(10L, "user@example.com")));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(1L)).thenReturn(1L);
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenReturn(draftCampaign);
        doNothing().when(jobLauncher).launchCampaignJob(any());

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.launch(1L);

        assertThat(response).isNotNull();
        assertThat(response.status()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.QUEUED);
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository).saveAll(anyList());
        verify(jobLauncher).launchCampaignJob(1L);
        // Only the selected recipients are resolved; there is no "all contacts" fallback.
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).findAllActiveRecipients();
    }

    @Test
    void throws_conflict_when_launching_completed_campaign() {
        draftCampaign.setStatus(CampaignStatus.COMPLETED);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void throws_validation_error_when_no_template() {
        draftCampaign.setTemplate(null);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("template");
    }

    // ── Part 1 regression tests: template-less drafts vs launch validation ──────

    @Test
    void launch_without_template_reports_exact_actionable_message() {
        // No template and no body of its own. Before campaigns could carry their own
        // body this message was "Campaign has no template assigned".
        draftCampaign.setTemplate(null);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessage("Campaign has no email content: choose a template or write the email");
        // Launch must NOT proceed: no recipients resolved, no job launched.
        verify(jobLauncher, never()).launchCampaignJob(any());
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
    }

    @Test
    void create_allows_draft_without_template() {
        // A campaign may be SAVED as a draft with no template (template only
        // required at launch). create() must not call the template service.
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        CampaignRequest request = new CampaignRequest(
                "Draft no template", null, "Subject", /* templateId */ null,
                null, "sender@example.com", null, null, null, null, null, null);

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.create(request);

        assertThat(response.status()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);
        assertThat(response.templateId()).isNull();
        verify(templateService, never()).getOrThrow(any());
    }

    @Test
    void update_allows_draft_to_remain_without_template() {
        draftCampaign.setTemplate(null);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        CampaignRequest request = new CampaignRequest(
                "Edited draft", "desc", "New subject", /* templateId */ null,
                null, "sender@example.com", null, null, null, null, null, null);

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.update(1L, request);

        assertThat(response.subject()).isEqualTo("New subject");
        assertThat(response.templateId()).isNull();
        verify(templateService, never()).getOrThrow(any());
    }

    @Test
    void repeated_launch_after_queued_is_rejected_as_conflict() {
        // First launch succeeds and moves the campaign to QUEUED (not runnable again).
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, java.util.Set.of(10L)))
                .thenReturn(java.util.List.of(activeRecipient(10L, "user@example.com")));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(1L)).thenReturn(1L);
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenReturn(draftCampaign);
        doNothing().when(jobLauncher).launchCampaignJob(any());

        campaignService.launch(1L);              // draftCampaign.status becomes QUEUED
        assertThat(draftCampaign.getStatus()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.QUEUED);

        // A second launch attempt on the now-QUEUED campaign must be rejected,
        // and must not launch the job a second time.
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        verify(jobLauncher, times(1)).launchCampaignJob(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void cancels_running_campaign() {
        draftCampaign.setStatus(CampaignStatus.RUNNING);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenReturn(draftCampaign);

        campaignService.cancel(1L);

        verify(campaignRepository).save(argThat(c -> c.getStatus() == CampaignStatus.CANCELLED));
    }

    @Test
    void pauses_running_campaign() {
        draftCampaign.setStatus(CampaignStatus.RUNNING);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenReturn(draftCampaign);

        campaignService.pause(1L);

        verify(campaignRepository).save(argThat(c -> c.getStatus() == CampaignStatus.PAUSED));
    }

    @Test
    void resume_paused_campaign_re_launches_job() {
        draftCampaign.setStatus(CampaignStatus.PAUSED);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenReturn(draftCampaign);
        doNothing().when(jobLauncher).launchCampaignJob(any());

        campaignService.resume(1L);

        verify(jobLauncher).launchCampaignJob(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void throws_conflict_when_pausing_non_running_campaign() {
        // DRAFT is not pauseable
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.pause(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    // ── Launch requires recipients and a live template ─────────────────────────

    @Test
    void launch_without_recipients_is_rejected_and_never_targets_all_contacts() {
        draftCampaign.setRecipientIds(new java.util.HashSet<>());
        draftCampaign.setRecipientGroupIds(new java.util.HashSet<>());
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessage("Campaign has no recipients selected");
        // The old behaviour silently fell back to every active contact.
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).findAllActiveRecipients();
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
        verify(jobLauncher, never()).launchCampaignJob(any());
        assertThat(draftCampaign.getStatus()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);
    }

    @Test
    void launch_with_deleted_template_is_rejected() {
        template.setDeletedAt(java.time.Instant.now());
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("template assigned to this campaign has been deleted");
        verify(jobLauncher, never()).launchCampaignJob(any());
    }

    @Test
    void launch_with_a_template_without_any_body_is_rejected() {
        // Neither an HTML nor a plain-text body: every email would carry only a subject.
        template.setHtmlBody(null);
        template.setPlainBody("   ");
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessage("Campaign has no email content: choose a template or write the email. "
                        + "The template assigned to this campaign has no body.");
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
        verify(jobLauncher, never()).launchCampaignJob(any());
        assertThat(draftCampaign.getStatus()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);
    }

    @Test
    void launch_accepts_a_template_with_only_a_plain_text_body() {
        template.setHtmlBody(null);
        template.setPlainBody("Hello {{FirstName}}");
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, java.util.Set.of(10L)))
                .thenReturn(java.util.List.of(activeRecipient(10L, "user@example.com")));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(1L)).thenReturn(1L);
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenReturn(draftCampaign);

        assertThat(campaignService.launch(1L).status()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.QUEUED);
        verify(jobLauncher).launchCampaignJob(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void resume_starts_the_batch_job_only_after_the_transaction_commits() {
        draftCampaign.setStatus(CampaignStatus.PAUSED);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenReturn(draftCampaign);

        TransactionSynchronizationManager.initSynchronization();
        try {
            campaignService.resume(1L);
            assertThat(draftCampaign.getStatus()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.QUEUED);
            verify(jobLauncher, never()).launchCampaignJob(any());

            TransactionSynchronizationManager.getSynchronizations()
                    .forEach(s -> s.afterCompletion(TransactionSynchronization.STATUS_ROLLED_BACK));
            verify(jobLauncher, never()).launchCampaignJob(any());

            TransactionSynchronizationManager.getSynchronizations()
                    .forEach(TransactionSynchronization::afterCommit);
            verify(jobLauncher, times(1)).launchCampaignJob(1L);
        } finally {
            TransactionSynchronizationManager.clearSynchronization();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void reply_to_must_be_an_email_address() {
        jakarta.validation.Validator validator =
                jakarta.validation.Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory().getValidator();

        CampaignRequest invalid = new CampaignRequest(
                "Campaign", null, "Subject", null,
                null, "sender@example.com", "not an email", null, null, null, null, null);
        assertThat(validator.validate(invalid))
                .extracting(v -> v.getPropertyPath().toString())
                .containsExactly("replyTo");

        CampaignRequest valid = new CampaignRequest(
                "Campaign", null, "Subject", null,
                null, "sender@example.com", "replies@example.com", null, null, null, null, null);
        assertThat(validator.validate(valid)).isEmpty();
        // Optional: no reply-to at all is still allowed.
        assertThat(validator.validate(new CampaignRequest(
                "Campaign", null, "Subject", null,
                null, "sender@example.com", null, null, null, null, null, null))).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void launch_is_rejected_when_no_selected_recipient_can_be_emailed() {
        com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient unsubscribed = activeRecipient(10L, "user@example.com");
        unsubscribed.setStatus(com.mailflow.recipient.entity.RecipientStatus.UNSUBSCRIBED);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, java.util.Set.of(10L)))
                .thenReturn(java.util.List.of(unsubscribed));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(1L)).thenReturn(0L);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("None of the selected recipients can be emailed");
        verify(jobLauncher, never()).launchCampaignJob(any());
    }

    @Test
    void launch_starts_batch_job_only_after_the_transaction_commits() {
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, java.util.Set.of(10L)))
                .thenReturn(java.util.List.of(activeRecipient(10L, "user@example.com")));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(1L)).thenReturn(1L);
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenReturn(draftCampaign);

        TransactionSynchronizationManager.initSynchronization();
        try {
            campaignService.launch(1L);
            // Still inside the (simulated) transaction: the job must not have started,
            // otherwise it could read uncommitted rows or survive a rollback.
            verify(jobLauncher, never()).launchCampaignJob(any());

            // A rollback must not start it either.
            TransactionSynchronizationManager.getSynchronizations()
                    .forEach(s -> s.afterCompletion(TransactionSynchronization.STATUS_ROLLED_BACK));
            verify(jobLauncher, never()).launchCampaignJob(any());

            // Commit: the job starts exactly once.
            TransactionSynchronizationManager.getSynchronizations()
                    .forEach(TransactionSynchronization::afterCommit);
            verify(jobLauncher, times(1)).launchCampaignJob(1L);
        } finally {
            TransactionSynchronizationManager.clearSynchronization();
        }
    }

    // ── Draft edit round-trip (template, recipients, reply-to persist) ─────────

    @Test
    void update_persists_template_recipients_and_reply_to() {
        EmailTemplate other = new EmailTemplate();
        other.setId(2L);
        other.setName("Other template");
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(draftCampaign));
        when(templateService.getOrThrow(2L)).thenReturn(other);
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        CampaignRequest request = new CampaignRequest(
                "Edited", "desc", "Hello {{FirstName}}", 2L,
                "Sender", "sender@example.com", "replies@example.com", null,
                java.util.List.of(), java.util.List.of(10L, 11L), null, null);

        CampaignResponse response = campaignService.update(1L, request);

        assertThat(response.templateId()).isEqualTo(2L);
        assertThat(response.templateName()).isEqualTo("Other template");
        assertThat(response.replyTo()).isEqualTo("replies@example.com");
        assertThat(response.recipientIds()).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(10L, 11L);
        assertThat(response.recipientGroupIds()).isEmpty();
    }
}
````
