````java
/**
 * Feature 1, "reuse saved contacts across campaigns": one test per acceptance item.
 *
 * <p>The user's own numbering of the "Recipient reuse" list was not available to this
 * step; the items are the acceptance checks of FEATURES_REUSE_DELETE_BRIEF.md, numbered
 * so that item 7 (two campaigns keep independent histories) and item 10 (retries and
 * repeated launches don't send twice) match the numbers the workflow gave.
 *
 * <p>Repositories are mocked. Items 7 and 10 also run the delivery-row unique constraints
 * on an in-memory H2 table with the same constraints as migrations V1 and V5, and check
 * that those constraints are in the migration files. PostgreSQL itself is not used.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class RecipientReuseTest {

    @org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
    void signInTestOrganization() {
        com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.signIn();
    }

    @org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach
    void signOutTestOrganization() {
        com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.signOut();
    }

    private static final long CAMPAIGN_A = 31L;
    private static final long CAMPAIGN_B = 32L;

    @Mock private CampaignRepository campaignRepository;
    @Mock private TemplateService templateService;
    @Mock private CampaignJobLauncher jobLauncher;
    @Mock private RecipientRepository recipientRepository;
    @Mock private CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    @Mock private UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;
    @Mock private CampaignTargetAddressRepository targetAddressRepository;
    @Mock private UnsubscribeRepository unsubscribeRepository;

    private CampaignService campaignService;
    private RecipientImportService importService;
    private RecipientService recipientService;
    private EmailTemplate template;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        campaignService = new CampaignService(campaignRepository, templateService, jobLauncher,
                recipientRepository, campaignRecipientRepository, unsubscribeService, targetAddressRepository);
        // The upload preview, /bulk and /lookup are built from the contact and unsubscribe
        // repositories only: no campaign history (campaign_recipients, email_logs) is reachable.
        importService = new RecipientImportService(recipientRepository, unsubscribeRepository);
        recipientService = new RecipientService(recipientRepository, unsubscribeRepository);

        template = new EmailTemplate();
        template.setId(1L);
        template.setName("Welcome");
        template.setSubject("Hello");
        template.setPlainBody("Hello {{FirstName}}");
    }

    // ── Item 1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item01_a_contact_emailed_by_an_earlier_campaign_is_eligible_again_and_gets_its_own_row() {
        Recipient ada = contact(10L, "ada@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);
        // Campaign A already emailed ada. These stubs stand for A's history; nothing may read them.
        lenient().when(campaignRecipientRepository.findTargetedEmails(CAMPAIGN_A)).thenReturn(List.of("ada@test.local"));
        lenient().when(campaignRecipientRepository.existsByCampaignIdAndRecipientId(CAMPAIGN_A, 10L)).thenReturn(true);

        // Upload for campaign B: ada is Valid (a saved contact), not Duplicate.
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("ada@test.local"))).thenReturn(List.of(ada));
        ExcelPreviewResponse preview = importService.previewExcel(xlsx(new String[] {"Email"}, new String[][] {{"ada@test.local"}}));
        assertThat(preview.validRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(preview.existingRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(preview.duplicateRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(preview.rows().get(0).status()).isEqualTo(ExcelRowPreview.EXISTING);
        assertThat(preview.rows().get(0).recipientId()).isEqualTo(10L);

        // Lookup (used by typed addresses and the Review step) finds her too.
        RecipientLookupResponse lookup = recipientService.lookup(new RecipientLookupRequest(null, List.of("ada@test.local")));
        assertThat(lookup.recipients()).extracting(RecipientResponse::id).containsExactly(10L);

        // Launching B gives ada a row of B's own; only B's rows are consulted.
        Campaign b = draft(CAMPAIGN_B);
        b.setRecipientIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(10L)));
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_B)).thenReturn(Optional.of(b));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, Set.of(10L))).thenReturn(List.of(ada));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_B)).thenReturn(1L);

        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_B);

        assertThat(savedRows(1).get(0)).singleElement().satisfies(row -> {
            assertThat(row.getRecipient()).isSameAs(ada);
            assertThat(row.getCampaign()).isSameAs(b);
            assertThat(row.getIdempotencyKey()).isEqualTo("campaign_32_recipient_10");
        });
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).findTargetedEmails(CAMPAIGN_A);
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).existsByCampaignIdAndRecipientId(eq(CAMPAIGN_A), any());
        assertThat(b.getStatus()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.QUEUED);
    }

    // ── Item 2 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item02_a_file_of_three_saved_contacts_shows_valid_3_and_duplicate_0() {
        // Same columns as the user's mailflow11.xlsx (3 rows, all saved contacts); test.local data.
        String[] headers = {"Email", "Name", "FirstName", "LastName", "Company", "Role", "Phone", "Location", "Interest"};
        String[][] rows = {
                {"reuse.one@test.local", "Reuse One", "Reuse", "One", "Test Co", "Engineer", "+1-555-0101", "Pune", "Email"},
                {"reuse.two@test.local", "Reuse Two", "Reuse", "Two", "Test Co", "Analyst", "+1-555-0102", "Delhi", "Data"},
                {"reuse.three@test.local", "Reuse Three", "Reuse", "Three", "Test Co", "Manager", "+1-555-0103", "Goa", "Ops"},
        };
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("reuse.one@test.local", "reuse.two@test.local", "reuse.three@test.local")))
                .thenReturn(List.of(
                        contact(1L, "reuse.one@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE),
                        contact(2L, "reuse.two@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE),
                        contact(3L, "reuse.three@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)));

        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewExcel(xlsx(headers, rows));

        assertThat(res.totalRows()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(res.validRows()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(res.existingRows()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(res.newRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(res.duplicateRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(res.invalidRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(res.skippedRows()).isZero();
        // The eligible rows are in the preview, with their contact IDs and mapped columns.
        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::status).containsOnly(ExcelRowPreview.EXISTING);
        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::recipientId).containsExactly(1L, 2L, 3L);
        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::reason)
                .noneMatch(r -> r.toLowerCase().contains("duplicate") || r.toLowerCase().contains("exists"));
        assertThat(res.rows().get(0).fields()).containsEntry("firstName", "Reuse").containsEntry("role", "Engineer");
        verifyNoWrites();
    }

    // ── Item 3 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item03_duplicate_means_only_a_repeat_inside_the_same_file_and_names_the_first_row() {
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("saved@test.local", "new@test.local", "other@test.local")))
                .thenReturn(List.of(
                        contact(1L, "saved@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE),
                        contact(2L, "other@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)));

        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewExcel(xlsx(new String[] {"Email"}, new String[][] {
                {"saved@test.local"},      // row 2
                {" SAVED@Test.Local "},    // row 3: same address, other spelling
                {"new@test.local"},        // row 4
                {"new@test.local"},        // row 5
                {"other@test.local"},      // row 6: a saved contact, not a repeat
        }));

        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::status).containsExactly(
                ExcelRowPreview.EXISTING, ExcelRowPreview.DUPLICATE, ExcelRowPreview.VALID,
                ExcelRowPreview.DUPLICATE, ExcelRowPreview.EXISTING);
        assertThat(res.rows().get(1).reason()).isEqualTo("Duplicate email within file (first on row 2)");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(3).reason()).isEqualTo("Duplicate email within file (first on row 4)");
        assertThat(res.duplicateRows()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(res.validRows()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(res.newRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.existingRows()).isEqualTo(2);
    }

    // ── Item 4 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item04_every_invalid_row_has_its_own_reason_and_the_counts_add_up() {
        when(recipientRepository.findDeletedEmails(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of("gone@test.local"));

        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewExcel(xlsx(new String[] {"Email", "Name"}, new String[][] {
                {"not-an-email", "Bad"},
                {null, "No address"},
                {"gone@test.local", "Deleted contact"},
                {"ok@test.local", "Fine"},
        }));

        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::reason).containsExactly(
                "Not a valid email address",
                "No email address in this row",
                "Belongs to a deleted contact, so it can't be added",
                null);
        assertThat(res.invalidRows()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(res.validRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.totalRows())
                .isEqualTo(res.validRows() + res.invalidRows() + res.duplicateRows() + res.skippedRows());

        ExcelPreviewResponse noEmailColumn = importService.previewExcel(
                xlsx(new String[] {"Name"}, new String[][] {{"Ada"}}));
        assertThat(noEmailColumn.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::reason)
                .containsExactly("No email column detected in file");
    }

    // ── Item 5 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item05_one_normalisation_rule_matches_the_same_address_everywhere() {
        String nbsp = " Ada@Test.Local\u00A0";
        String zeroWidth = "\u200BADA@test.local\uFEFF";
        String wordJoiner = "ada@test.local\u2060";
        Recipient ada = contact(10L, "ada@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("ada@test.local"))).thenReturn(List.of(ada));

        // Upload preview: all three spellings are one address, the saved contact.
        ExcelPreviewResponse preview = importService.previewExcel(
                xlsx(new String[] {"Email"}, new String[][] {{nbsp}, {zeroWidth}, {wordJoiner}}));
        assertThat(preview.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::status).containsExactly(
                ExcelRowPreview.EXISTING, ExcelRowPreview.DUPLICATE, ExcelRowPreview.DUPLICATE);
        assertThat(preview.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::email).containsOnly("ada@test.local");

        // Lookup and /bulk find the same contact.
        assertThat(recipientService.lookup(new RecipientLookupRequest(null, List.of(zeroWidth))).recipients())
                .extracting(RecipientResponse::id).containsExactly(10L);
        BulkRecipientResponse bulk = importService.bulkCreateOrReuse(new BulkRecipientRequest(List.of(
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row(wordJoiner, null, null, null, null, null)), "MANUAL"));
        assertThat(bulk.reused()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(bulk.created()).isZero();
        assertThat(bulk.recipientIds()).containsExactly(10L);

        // Contact create: the normalised address is checked, so no second contact is made.
        when(recipientRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull("ada@test.local")).thenReturn(true);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> recipientService.create(
                new RecipientRequest(zeroWidth, null, null, null, null, null, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class)
                .hasMessage("Recipient already exists: ada@test.local");

        // Campaign-only addresses: stored once, normalised.
        when(campaignRepository.save(any(Campaign.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            Campaign c = inv.getArgument(0);
            c.setId(CAMPAIGN_A);
            return c;
        });
        campaignService.create(new CampaignRequest("Normalised", null, "Hello", null, null,
                "sender@test.local", null, null, null, null,
                List.of(address(nbsp), address(zeroWidth), address(wordJoiner)), null));
        verify(targetAddressRepository).saveAll(argThat((List<CampaignTargetAddress> list) ->
                list.size() == 1 && list.get(0).getEmail().equals("ada@test.local")));

        // Delivery keys and the unsubscribe list use the same form.
        assertThat(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(CAMPAIGN_A, nbsp))
                .isEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(CAMPAIGN_A, zeroWidth))
                .isEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(CAMPAIGN_A, "ada@test.local"));
        new UnsubscribeService(unsubscribeRepository, recipientRepository).isUnsubscribed(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, zeroWidth);
        verify(unsubscribeRepository).existsByOrganizationIdAndEmailIgnoreCase(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, "ada@test.local");

        verify(recipientRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    // ── Item 6 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item06_reusing_an_address_never_creates_a_second_contact() {
        Recipient grace = contact(42L, "grace@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("grace@test.local", "new@test.local"))).thenReturn(List.of(grace));
        when(recipientRepository.saveAll(anyList())).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            List<Recipient> created = inv.getArgument(0);
            created.forEach(r -> r.setId(500L));
            return created;
        });

        // /bulk reuses grace by address and creates only the new one.
        BulkRecipientResponse bulk = importService.bulkCreateOrReuse(new BulkRecipientRequest(List.of(
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("GRACE@test.local ", "Grace", null, null, null, null),
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("new@test.local", "New", null, null, null, null)), "UPLOAD"));
        assertThat(bulk.reused()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(bulk.created()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(bulk.recipientIds()).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(42L, 500L);
        verify(recipientRepository).saveAll(argThat((List<Recipient> list) ->
                list.size() == 1 && list.get(0).getEmail().equals("new@test.local")));

        // A campaign-only address that matches a contact resolves to that contact at launch.
        Campaign a = draft(CAMPAIGN_A);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_A)).thenReturn(Optional.of(a));
        when(targetAddressRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_A)).thenReturn(1L);
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_A))
                .thenReturn(List.of(stored(CAMPAIGN_A, "grace@test.local")));
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("grace@test.local"))).thenReturn(List.of(grace));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_A)).thenReturn(1L);

        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_A);

        assertThat(savedRows(1).get(0)).singleElement().satisfies(row -> {
            assertThat(row.getRecipient()).isSameAs(grace);
            assertThat(row.getSnapshotEmail()).isNull();
            assertThat(row.getIdempotencyKey()).isEqualTo("campaign_31_recipient_42");
        });
        // Only the one contact /bulk created for "new@test.local" was ever inserted.
        verify(recipientRepository, times(1)).saveAll(any());
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    // ── Item 7 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item07_two_campaigns_keep_independent_histories() throws Exception {
        // A and B both target contact ada and the campaign-only address bob.
        Recipient ada = contact(10L, "ada@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);
        Campaign a = draft(CAMPAIGN_A);
        Campaign b = draft(CAMPAIGN_B);
        for (Campaign c : List.of(a, b)) {
            c.setRecipientIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(10L)));
            when(campaignRepository.findOneById(c.getId())).thenReturn(Optional.of(c));
            when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(c.getId()))
                    .thenReturn(List.of(stored(c.getId(), "bob@test.local")));
            when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(c.getId())).thenReturn(2L);
        }
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, Set.of(10L))).thenReturn(List.of(ada));

        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_A);
        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_B);

        List<List<CampaignRecipient>> launches = savedRows(2);
        List<CampaignRecipient> rowsA = launches.get(0);
        List<CampaignRecipient> rowsB = launches.get(1);
        assertThat(rowsA).extracting(CampaignRecipient::getIdempotencyKey).containsExactly(
                "campaign_31_recipient_10", CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(CAMPAIGN_A, "bob@test.local"));
        assertThat(rowsB).extracting(CampaignRecipient::getIdempotencyKey).containsExactly(
                "campaign_32_recipient_10", CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(CAMPAIGN_B, "bob@test.local"));
        assertThat(rowsA).allSatisfy(r -> assertThat(r.getCampaign()).isSameAs(a));
        assertThat(rowsB).allSatisfy(r -> assertThat(r.getCampaign()).isSameAs(b));

        // Launching B read only B's rows and changed nothing of A's: these are all the calls.
        for (long id : new long[] {CAMPAIGN_A, CAMPAIGN_B}) {
            verify(campaignRecipientRepository).findTargetedEmails(id);
            verify(campaignRecipientRepository).existsByCampaignIdAndRecipientId(id, 10L);
            verify(campaignRecipientRepository).countByCampaignId(id);
        }
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, times(2)).saveAll(anyList());
        verifyNoMoreInteractions(campaignRecipientRepository);

        // The database accepts both histories side by side and keeps each one unique.
        assertDeliveryRowConstraintsAreInTheMigrations();
        try (Connection db = deliveryRowTable("reuse_item07")) {
            for (CampaignRecipient row : rowsA) insert(db, row);
            for (CampaignRecipient row : rowsB) insert(db, row);
            assertThat(count(db)).isEqualTo(4);

            // A second row for ada in A, even under another key, is rejected ...
            assertThatThrownBy(() -> insert(db, CAMPAIGN_A, 10L, "campaign_31_recipient_10_again", null))
                    .isInstanceOf(SQLIntegrityConstraintViolationException.class);
            // ... and so is a second row with one of A's keys.
            assertThatThrownBy(() -> insert(db, CAMPAIGN_A, null, rowsA.get(1).getIdempotencyKey(), "bob@test.local"))
                    .isInstanceOf(SQLIntegrityConstraintViolationException.class);
            assertThat(count(db)).isEqualTo(4);
        }
    }

    // ── Item 8 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item08_unsubscribed_and_inactive_contacts_are_skipped_and_the_reason_says_so() {
        Recipient unsubscribed = contact(1L, "unsub@test.local", RecipientStatus.UNSUBSCRIBED);
        Recipient bounced = contact(2L, "bounced@test.local", RecipientStatus.BOUNCED);
        Recipient fine = contact(4L, "fine@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);
        List<String> fileAddresses = List.of("unsub@test.local", "bounced@test.local", "listed@test.local", "fine@test.local");
        List<Recipient> contacts = List.of(unsubscribed, bounced, fine);
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList())).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            List<String> wanted = inv.getArgument(1);
            return contacts.stream().filter(c -> wanted.contains(c.getEmail())).toList();
        });
        when(unsubscribeRepository.findEmailsIn(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of("listed@test.local"));

        // Upload: each skipped row says why; none is called a duplicate or "used before".
        ExcelPreviewResponse preview = importService.previewExcel(xlsx(new String[] {"Email"},
                fileAddresses.stream().map(e -> new String[] {e}).toArray(String[][]::new)));
        assertThat(preview.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::status).containsExactly(
                ExcelRowPreview.SKIPPED, ExcelRowPreview.SKIPPED, ExcelRowPreview.SKIPPED, ExcelRowPreview.EXISTING);
        assertThat(preview.rows().get(0).reason()).isEqualTo("Unsubscribed: this saved contact won't be emailed");
        assertThat(preview.rows().get(1).reason()).startsWith("Bounced");
        assertThat(preview.rows().get(2).reason()).isEqualTo("Unsubscribed: this address won't be emailed");
        assertThat(preview.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::reason).noneMatch(r -> r.toLowerCase().contains("duplicate")
                || r.toLowerCase().contains("used before") || r.toLowerCase().contains("already"));
        assertThat(preview.duplicateRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(preview.skippedRows()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(preview.validRows()).isEqualTo(1);

        // Lookup reports the unsubscribe list too, so typed addresses can say why.
        RecipientLookupResponse lookup = recipientService.lookup(new RecipientLookupRequest(null, fileAddresses));
        assertThat(lookup.unsubscribedEmails()).containsExactly("listed@test.local");

        // Launch still skips them for compliance; only the ACTIVE contact gets a row.
        Campaign a = draft(CAMPAIGN_A);
        a.setRecipientIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(1L, 2L, 4L)));
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_A)).thenReturn(Optional.of(a));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, Set.of(1L, 2L, 4L))).thenReturn(List.of(unsubscribed, bounced, fine));
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_A))
                .thenReturn(List.of(stored(CAMPAIGN_A, "listed@test.local")));
        when(unsubscribeService.isUnsubscribed(any(), anyString()))
                .thenAnswer(inv -> "listed@test.local".equals(inv.getArgument(1)));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_A)).thenReturn(1L);

        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_A);

        assertThat(savedRows(1).get(0)).extracting(CampaignRecipient::targetEmail).containsExactly("fine@test.local");
    }

    // ── Item 9 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item09_launch_sends_only_to_explicit_targets_and_never_to_all_contacts() {
        // Any call to these fails the test: launch must never load "every active contact".
        lenient().when(recipientRepository.findAllActiveRecipients())
                .thenThrow(new AssertionError("launch called findAllActiveRecipients"));
        lenient().when(recipientRepository.findEligibleRecipients(any(), any()))
                .thenThrow(new AssertionError("launch called findEligibleRecipients"));

        // No targets at all: 400.
        Campaign none = draft(41L);
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(41L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(none));
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(41L))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessage("Campaign has no recipients selected")
                .satisfies(e -> assertThat(((MailFlowException) e).getStatus()).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST));
        assertThat(none.getStatus()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);

        // Targets, but none can be emailed: 400 as well.
        Campaign unsendable = draft(42L);
        unsendable.setRecipientIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(1L)));
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(42L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(unsendable));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, Set.of(1L)))
                .thenReturn(List.of(contact(1L, "unsub@test.local", RecipientStatus.UNSUBSCRIBED)));
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(42L))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("None of the selected recipients can be emailed")
                .satisfies(e -> assertThat(((MailFlowException) e).getStatus()).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST));
        assertThat(unsendable.getStatus()).isEqualTo(CampaignStatus.DRAFT);
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
        verifyNoInteractions(jobLauncher);

        // Contact IDs, a group and a campaign-only address: exactly those are emailed.
        Campaign explicit = draft(43L);
        explicit.setRecipientIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(10L)));
        explicit.setRecipientGroupIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(5L)));
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(43L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(explicit));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, Set.of(10L)))
                .thenReturn(List.of(contact(10L, "picked@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)));
        when(recipientRepository.findByGroupIds(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, Set.of(5L)))
                .thenReturn(List.of(contact(11L, "member@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)));
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(43L))
                .thenReturn(List.of(stored(43L, "typed@test.local")));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(43L)).thenReturn(3L);

        campaignService.launch(43L);

        assertThat(savedRows(1).get(0)).extracting(CampaignRecipient::targetEmail)
                .containsExactly("picked@test.local", "member@test.local", "typed@test.local");
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).findAllActiveRecipients();
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).findEligibleRecipients(any(), any());
        verify(jobLauncher).launchCampaignJob(43L);
    }

    // ── Item 10 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void item10_retries_and_repeated_launches_do_not_send_twice() throws Exception {
        Recipient ada = contact(10L, "ada@test.local", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE);
        Campaign a = draft(CAMPAIGN_A);
        a.setRecipientIds(new HashSet<>(Set.of(10L)));
        when(campaignRepository.findOneById(CAMPAIGN_A)).thenReturn(Optional.of(a));
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, Set.of(10L))).thenReturn(List.of(ada));
        when(targetAddressRepository.findByCampaignIdOrderByIdAsc(CAMPAIGN_A))
                .thenReturn(List.of(stored(CAMPAIGN_A, "bob@test.local")));
        // First launch: no rows yet. Relaunch: both addresses already have their row.
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.findTargetedEmails(CAMPAIGN_A))
                .thenReturn(List.of(), List.of("ada@test.local", "BOB@test.local"));
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.countByCampaignId(CAMPAIGN_A)).thenReturn(2L);

        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_A);
        List<CampaignRecipient> rows = savedRows(1).get(0);
        String adaKey = rows.get(0).getIdempotencyKey();
        String bobKey = rows.get(1).getIdempotencyKey();
        assertThat(adaKey).isEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.buildIdempotencyKey(CAMPAIGN_A, 10L));
        // Every spelling of the address gives the same key, so it can't sneak in twice.
        assertThat(bobKey).isEqualTo(CampaignRecipient.buildAddressIdempotencyKey(CAMPAIGN_A, " BOB@test.local\u200B"));

        // A repeated launch while queued (a double click, a second tab) is refused with 409.
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_A))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class)
                .satisfies(e -> assertThat(((MailFlowException) e).getStatus()).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.CONFLICT));

        // A relaunch after a failure adds no row for an address that already has one.
        a.setStatus(CampaignStatus.FAILED);
        campaignService.launch(CAMPAIGN_A);
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, times(1)).saveAll(anyList());
        verify(jobLauncher, times(2)).launchCampaignJob(CAMPAIGN_A);

        // Batch retry: a row that is already QUEUED or SENT is not published again.
        RabbitTemplate rabbitTemplate = mock(RabbitTemplate.class);
        when(campaignRecipientRepository.markQueued(eq(adaKey), any(Instant.class))).thenReturn(0);
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(CAMPAIGN_A)).thenReturn(Optional.of(CampaignStatus.RUNNING));
        new CampaignItemWriter(rabbitTemplate, campaignRecipientRepository, campaignRepository)
                .write(Chunk.of(message(adaKey)));
        verifyNoInteractions(rabbitTemplate);

        // RabbitMQ redelivery: a message whose key was already sent is dropped without sending.
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        RedisTemplate<String, Object> redis = mock(RedisTemplate.class);
        EmailProvider emailProvider = mock(EmailProvider.class);
        when(redis.hasKey("email:sent:" + bobKey)).thenReturn(true);
        new EmailConsumer(emailProvider, campaignRecipientRepository, campaignRepository,
                mock(RateLimiterService.class), mock(EmailLogService.class), redis).consume(message(bobKey));
        verifyNoInteractions(emailProvider);
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, never()).markSent(anyString(), any());

        // And the database refuses a second delivery row for either key.
        assertDeliveryRowConstraintsAreInTheMigrations();
        try (Connection db = deliveryRowTable("reuse_item10")) {
            for (CampaignRecipient row : rows) insert(db, row);
            assertThatThrownBy(() -> insert(db, CAMPAIGN_A, 10L, adaKey, null))
                    .isInstanceOf(SQLIntegrityConstraintViolationException.class);
            assertThatThrownBy(() -> insert(db, CAMPAIGN_A, null, bobKey, "bob@test.local"))
                    .isInstanceOf(SQLIntegrityConstraintViolationException.class);
            assertThat(count(db)).isEqualTo(2);
        }
    }

    // ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private Campaign draft(long id) {
        return Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG)
                .id(id)
                .name("[test] campaign " + id)
                .subject("Hello {{FirstName}}")
                .senderEmail("sender@test.local")
                .status(CampaignStatus.DRAFT)
                .template(template)
                .build();
    }

    private static Recipient contact(long id, String email, RecipientStatus status) {
        return Recipient.builder().id(id).email(email).status(status).build();
    }

    private static CampaignTargetAddress stored(long campaignId, String email) {
        return CampaignTargetAddress.builder().campaignId(campaignId).email(email).build();
    }

    private static TargetAddress address(String email) {
        return new TargetAddress(email, null, null, null, null, null);
    }

    private static EmailMessage message(String key) {
        return EmailMessage.builder()
                .idempotencyKey(key)
                .campaignId(CAMPAIGN_A)
                .toAddress("ada@test.local")
                .senderEmail("sender@test.local")
                .subject("Hello")
                .plainBody("Hello")
                .attemptNumber(2)
                .createdAt(Instant.now())
                .build();
    }

    /** The lists of delivery rows passed to saveAll, one per launch that created rows. */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private List<List<CampaignRecipient>> savedRows(int launches) {
        ArgumentCaptor<List<CampaignRecipient>> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(List.class);
        verify(campaignRecipientRepository, times(launches)).saveAll(captor.capture());
        return new ArrayList<>(captor.getAllValues());
    }

    private void verifyNoWrites() {
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).save(any());
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
        verifyNoInteractions(campaignRecipientRepository);
    }

    private static MockMultipartFile xlsx(String[] headers, String[][] rows) {
        try (Workbook wb = new XSSFWorkbook(); ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
            Sheet sheet = wb.createSheet("Sheet1");
            Row header = sheet.createRow(0);
            for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) header.createCell(i).setCellValue(headers[i]);
            for (int r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
                Row row = sheet.createRow(r + 1);
                for (int c = 0; c < rows[r].length; c++) {
                    if (rows[r][c] != null) row.createCell(c).setCellValue(rows[r][c]);
                }
            }
            wb.write(out);
            return new MockMultipartFile("file", "recipients.xlsx",
                    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", out.toByteArray());
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * The constraints that make delivery idempotent, as declared by the real migrations:
     * V1's campaign_recipients has a unique idempotency key and UNIQUE (campaign_id,
     * recipient_id); V5 adds a unique index per campaign and lower-cased address for rows
     * without a contact.
     */
    private static void assertDeliveryRowConstraintsAreInTheMigrations() throws IOException {
        String v1 = migration("V1__init_schema.sql");
        int start = v1.indexOf("CREATE TABLE campaign_recipients (");
        assertThat(start).isNotNegative();
        String table = v1.substring(start, v1.indexOf(");", start));
        assertThat(table).contains("idempotency_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE")
                .contains("UNIQUE (campaign_id, recipient_id)");
        assertThat(migration("V5__campaign_only_addresses.sql")).contains(
                "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_campaign_recipients_address ON campaign_recipients "
                        + "(campaign_id, lower(email)) WHERE recipient_id IS NULL");
    }

    private static String migration(String name) throws IOException {
        String sql = new ClassPathResource("db/migration/" + name).getContentAsString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        return sql.replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
    }

    /**
     * An in-memory H2 table with the same unique constraints as campaign_recipients. H2
     * has no partial or expression indexes, so V5's per-address index is checked as text
     * above; the unique idempotency key covers address rows here.
     */
    private static Connection deliveryRowTable(String name) throws SQLException {
        Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:h2:mem:" + name, "sa", "");
        try (Statement s = c.createStatement()) {
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE campaign_recipients (
                        id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                        campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        recipient_id BIGINT,
                        idempotency_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                        email VARCHAR(255),
                        UNIQUE (campaign_id, recipient_id),
                        CHECK (recipient_id IS NOT NULL OR email IS NOT NULL))""");
        }
        return c;
    }

    private static void insert(Connection db, CampaignRecipient row) throws SQLException {
        insert(db, row.getCampaign().getId(), row.getRecipient() != null ? row.getRecipient().getId() : null,
                row.getIdempotencyKey(), row.getSnapshotEmail());
    }

    private static void insert(Connection db, long campaignId, Long recipientId, String key, String email)
            throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = db.prepareStatement(
                "INSERT INTO campaign_recipients (campaign_id, recipient_id, idempotency_key, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)")) {
            ps.setLong(1, campaignId);
            if (recipientId != null) ps.setLong(2, recipientId); else ps.setNull(2, Types.BIGINT);
            ps.setString(3, key);
            if (email != null) ps.setString(4, email); else ps.setNull(4, Types.VARCHAR);
            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    private static long count(Connection db) throws SQLException {
        try (Statement s = db.createStatement(); var rs = s.executeQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_recipients")) {
            rs.next();
            return rs.getLong(1);
        }
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/common/util/EmailValidatorTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.common.util;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTimeoutPreemptively;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue;

/**
 * The one normalisation rule for addresses: trim (including the characters Java's
 * trim()/strip() miss), then lower-case with Locale.ROOT, then validate.
 */
class EmailValidatorTest {

    /** The characters String.trim() and String.strip() leave in place, which the rule must remove. */
    private static final char[] INVISIBLE = {'\u00A0', '\u2007', '\u202F', '\u200B', '\u200C', '\u200D', '\u2060', '\uFEFF'};

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "U+{0}")
    @ValueSource(strings = {"00A0", "2007", "202F", "200B", "200C", "200D", "2060", "FEFF"})
    void each_invisible_character_is_trimmed_from_both_ends(String hex) {
        char c = (char) Integer.parseInt(hex, 16);
        // Java's own trimming leaves the character in place ...
        assertThat((c + "ada@test.local").trim()).isNotEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat((c + "ada@test.local").strip()).isNotEqualTo("ada@test.local");

        // ... the rule removes it at the start, at the end, repeated, and mixed with whitespace.
        for (String raw : new String[] {
                c + "ada@test.local",
                "ada@test.local" + c,
                "" + c + c + "Ada@Test.Local" + c,
                " \t" + c + " ADA@TEST.LOCAL \n" + c + "\r\n"}) {
            assertThat(EmailValidator.normalize(raw)).as("normalize(%s)", escape(raw)).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
            assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid(raw)).as("isValid(%s)", escape(raw)).isTrue();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void the_trimmed_characters_are_exactly_what_trim_and_strip_remove_plus_the_invisible_ones() {
        Set<Character> extra = new HashSet<>();
        for (char c : INVISIBLE) extra.add(c);

        for (int i = 0; i <= 0xFFFF; i++) {
            char c = (char) i;
            boolean javaTrims = c <= ' ' || Character.isWhitespace(c);   // trim() and strip()
            boolean unicodeSpace = Character.isSpaceChar(c);             // Zs, Zl, Zp
            boolean expected = javaTrims || unicodeSpace || extra.contains(c);
            assertThat(EmailValidator.isTrimmable(c)).as("U+%04X", i).isEqualTo(expected);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void characters_inside_an_address_are_kept_so_it_stays_invalid() {
        assertThat(EmailValidator.normalize("ada\u200B@test.local")).isEqualTo("ada\u200B@test.local");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid("ada\u200B@test.local")).isFalse();
        assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid("ada@test\u00A0.local")).isFalse();
        assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid("ada lovelace@test.local")).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void lower_cases_with_the_root_locale_whatever_the_default_locale() {
        Locale previous = Locale.getDefault();
        try {
            // In Turkish "I".toLowerCase() is a dotless ı, which would break matching.
            Locale.setDefault(Locale.forLanguageTag("tr-TR"));
            assertThat(EmailValidator.normalize("ADMIN@TEST.LOCAL")).isEqualTo("admin@test.local");
            assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid("ADMIN@TEST.LOCAL")).isTrue();
        } finally {
            Locale.setDefault(previous);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void null_blank_and_invisible_only_values_are_not_valid() {
        assertThat(EmailValidator.normalize(null)).isNull();
        assertThat(EmailValidator.trim(null)).isNull();
        assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid(null)).isFalse();
        assertThat(EmailValidator.normalize(" \u200B\uFEFF ")).isEmpty();
        assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid(" \u200B\uFEFF ")).isFalse();
        assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid("not-an-email")).isFalse();
        assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid("a@b")).isFalse();
        assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid("a.b+c_d%e-f@sub.example.co")).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void trim_keeps_the_case() {
        assertThat(EmailValidator.trim("\u00A0Ada@Test.Local\uFEFF")).isEqualTo("Ada@Test.Local");
    }

    @Test
    void cells_with_a_display_name_or_mailto_give_the_address() {
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress("Ada Lovelace <Ada@Test.Local>")).isEqualTo("Ada@Test.Local");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress("\"Lovelace, Ada\" <ada@test.local>")).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress("<ada@test.local>")).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress("\u00A0Ada <\u200Bada@test.local > ")).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress("mailto:ada@test.local")).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress("MAILTO:Ada@Test.Local?subject=Hi")).isEqualTo("Ada@Test.Local");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress("Ada <mailto:ada@test.local>")).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress("  ada@test.local ")).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress(null)).isNull();
        // Anything else is left as it is (and then fails validation).
        assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress("Ada <ada@test.local> extra")).isEqualTo("Ada <ada@test.local> extra");
        assertThat(EmailValidator.isValid(EmailValidator.extractAddress("Ada <ada@test.local> extra"))).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void extracting_from_a_long_untrusted_cell_stays_fast() {
        // A long run of spaces inside a cell must not make the display-name pattern backtrack.
        String cell = "a" + " ".repeat(200_000) + "b";
        String quoted = "\"" + " ".repeat(200_000) + "x";
        assertTimeoutPreemptively(Duration.ofSeconds(2), () -> {
            assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress(cell)).isEqualTo(cell);
            assertThat(EmailValidator.extractAddress(quoted)).isEqualTo(quoted);
        });
    }

    @Test
    void the_frontend_uses_the_same_pattern_and_the_same_trimmed_characters() throws IOException {
        Path source = Path.of("frontend", "src", "lib", "recipientSelection.ts");
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(source), "frontend sources are not checked out next to the backend");
        String ts = Files.readString(source, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        Matcher regex = Pattern.compile("const EMAIL_RE = /(.+)/;").matcher(ts);
        assertThat(regex.find()).as("EMAIL_RE in %s", source).isTrue();
        assertThat(regex.group(1)).isEqualTo(EmailValidator.PATTERN_SOURCE);

        int start = ts.indexOf("function isEdgeChar(code: number): boolean {");
        assertThat(start).as("isEdgeChar in %s", source).isNotNegative();
        String body = ts.substring(start, ts.indexOf("\n}", start));
        Set<Integer> frontend = new HashSet<>();
        Matcher range = Pattern.compile("\\(code >= 0x([0-9a-fA-F]+) && code <= 0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)\\)").matcher(body);
        while (range.find()) {
            for (int i = Integer.parseInt(range.group(1), 16); i <= Integer.parseInt(range.group(2), 16); i++) frontend.add(i);
        }
        String rest = range.replaceAll("");
        Matcher upTo = Pattern.compile("code <= 0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)").matcher(rest);
        while (upTo.find()) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= Integer.parseInt(upTo.group(1), 16); i++) frontend.add(i);
        }
        Matcher single = Pattern.compile("code === 0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)").matcher(rest);
        while (single.find()) frontend.add(Integer.parseInt(single.group(1), 16));

        for (int i = 0; i <= 0xFFFF; i++) {
            assertThat(frontend.contains(i)).as("U+%04X", i).isEqualTo(EmailValidator.isTrimmable((char) i));
        }
    }

    private static String escape(String s) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            if (c < 0x20 || c > 0x7E) sb.append(String.format("\\u%04X", (int) c));
            else sb.append(c);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.config;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.connection.CachingConnectionFactory;
import org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

class RabbitConnectionConfigTest {

    @Test
    void pasted_whitespace_around_the_connection_settings_is_removed() {
        // A tab before the host broke the first hosted deploy: "UnknownHostException: \tshark...".
        RabbitConnectionConfig config = new RabbitConnectionConfig();
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(config, "host", "\tshark.rmq.cloudamqp.com \n");
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(config, "port", 5671);
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(config, "username", " user\t");
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(config, "password", "secret\n");
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(config, "virtualHost", "\tuser");
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(config, "ssl", false);

        CachingConnectionFactory ccf = config.cachingConnectionFactory();

        assertThat(ccf.getHost()).isEqualTo("shark.rmq.cloudamqp.com");
        assertThat(ccf.getUsername()).isEqualTo("user");
        assertThat(ccf.getVirtualHost()).isEqualTo("user");
        assertThat(ccf.getRabbitConnectionFactory().getPassword()).isEqualTo("secret");
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/email/RateLimiterServiceTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.ValueOperations;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.script.DefaultRedisScript;

import java.util.List;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

/**
 * Unit tests for the Redis token-bucket rate limiter.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class RateLimiterServiceTest {

    @Mock private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
    @Mock private ValueOperations<String, Object> valueOps;

    private RateLimiterService rateLimiter;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        MailFlowProperties props = new MailFlowProperties();
        props.setEmail(new MailFlowProperties.Email());
        props.getEmail().setRateLimitPerMinute(100);

        rateLimiter = new RateLimiterService(redisTemplate, props);
    }

    @Test
    void allows_request_when_within_limit() {
        when(redisTemplate.execute(any(DefaultRedisScript.class), anyList())).thenReturn(50L);
        assertThat(rateLimiter.tryAcquire(1L)).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void blocks_request_when_limit_exceeded() {
        when(redisTemplate.execute(any(DefaultRedisScript.class), anyList())).thenReturn(101L);
        assertThat(rateLimiter.tryAcquire(1L)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void allows_request_exactly_at_limit() {
        when(redisTemplate.execute(any(DefaultRedisScript.class), anyList())).thenReturn(100L);
        assertThat(rateLimiter.tryAcquire(1L)).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void fails_open_when_redis_throws() {
        when(redisTemplate.execute(any(DefaultRedisScript.class), anyList()))
            .thenThrow(new RuntimeException("Redis down"));
        // Should fail open (allow) to avoid blocking campaigns
        assertThat(rateLimiter.tryAcquire(1L)).isTrue();
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/email/SmtpConfigValidatorTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.mail.MailProperties;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

/**
 * Unit tests for {@link SmtpConfigValidator}. These validate configuration
 * only — no SMTP connection is opened and no email is sent.
 */
class SmtpConfigValidatorTest {

    private MailFlowProperties mailFlowProps(String mode) {
        MailFlowProperties p = new MailFlowProperties();
        p.setEmail(new MailFlowProperties.Email());
        p.getEmail().setMode(mode);
        return p;
    }

    private MailProperties mailProps(String host, Integer port, String user, String pass, Boolean auth) {
        MailProperties m = new MailProperties();
        m.setHost(host);
        if (port != null) m.setPort(port);
        m.setUsername(user);
        m.setPassword(pass);
        if (auth != null) m.getProperties().put("mail.smtp.auth", String.valueOf(auth));
        return m;
    }

    @Test
    void skips_validation_in_development_mode() {
        // Development mode: even with no credentials, must not throw.
        SmtpConfigValidator v = new SmtpConfigValidator(
                mailFlowProps("development"),
                mailProps("localhost", 1025, "", "", false));
        assertThatCode(v::validate).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void passes_mailhog_production_without_auth() {
        // Production + MailHog (auth disabled) needs no credentials.
        SmtpConfigValidator v = new SmtpConfigValidator(
                mailFlowProps("production"),
                mailProps("localhost", 1025, "", "", false));
        assertThatCode(v::validate).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void passes_gmail_production_with_full_credentials() {
        SmtpConfigValidator v = new SmtpConfigValidator(
                mailFlowProps("production"),
                mailProps("smtp.gmail.com", 587, "sender@gmail.com", "app-password-xyz", true));
        assertThatCode(v::validate).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void fails_when_production_auth_but_username_missing() {
        SmtpConfigValidator v = new SmtpConfigValidator(
                mailFlowProps("production"),
                mailProps("smtp.gmail.com", 587, "", "app-password-xyz", true));
        assertThatThrownBy(v::validate)
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("SMTP_USERNAME")
                .hasMessageContaining("production");
    }

    @Test
    void fails_when_production_auth_but_password_missing() {
        SmtpConfigValidator v = new SmtpConfigValidator(
                mailFlowProps("production"),
                mailProps("smtp.gmail.com", 587, "sender@gmail.com", "", true));
        assertThatThrownBy(v::validate)
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("SMTP_PASSWORD");
    }

    @Test
    void fails_lists_all_missing_vars() {
        SmtpConfigValidator v = new SmtpConfigValidator(
                mailFlowProps("production"),
                mailProps("", 587, "", "", true));
        assertThatThrownBy(v::validate)
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class)
                .satisfies(ex -> {
                    String msg = ex.getMessage();
                    assertThat(msg).contains("SMTP_HOST");
                    assertThat(msg).contains("SMTP_USERNAME");
                    assertThat(msg).contains("SMTP_PASSWORD");
                });
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/email/SmtpEmailProviderTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import jakarta.mail.Session;
import jakarta.mail.internet.MimeMessage;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSender;

import java.util.Properties;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

/**
 * Unit tests for {@link SmtpEmailProvider} From-address resolution.
 *
 * <p>No real SMTP connection is made: {@link JavaMailSender} is mocked and the
 * built {@link MimeMessage} is captured and inspected. {@code mailSender.send}
 * is a no-op mock, so no email is transmitted.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class SmtpEmailProviderTest {

    @Mock private JavaMailSender mailSender;

    private MimeMessage newMimeMessage() {
        // A detached MimeMessage backed by an empty session — never sent.
        return new MimeMessage(Session.getInstance(new Properties()));
    }

    private EmailRequest sampleRequest() {
        return EmailRequest.builder()
                .to("recipient@example.com")
                .from("campaign-sender@mycompany.com")
                .fromName("My Company")
                .subject("Hello")
                .htmlBody("<p>Hi</p>")
                .build();
    }

    @Test
    void gmail_mode_forces_from_to_authenticated_username() throws Exception {
        when(mailSender.createMimeMessage()).thenReturn(newMimeMessage());

        // Authenticated account configured (Gmail-style).
        SmtpEmailProvider provider = new SmtpEmailProvider(mailSender, "me@gmail.com");
        provider.send(sampleRequest());

        ArgumentCaptor<MimeMessage> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(MimeMessage.class);
        verify(mailSender).send(captor.capture());
        MimeMessage sent = captor.getValue();

        // From must be the authenticated Gmail account (display name preserved).
        String from = sent.getFrom()[0].toString();
        assertThat(from).contains("me@gmail.com");
        assertThat(from).contains("My Company");

        // The original campaign sender is preserved as Reply-To.
        assertThat(sent.getReplyTo()[0].toString()).contains("campaign-sender@mycompany.com");
    }

    @Test
    void gmail_mode_keeps_explicit_reply_to() throws Exception {
        when(mailSender.createMimeMessage()).thenReturn(newMimeMessage());

        EmailRequest req = EmailRequest.builder()
                .to("recipient@example.com")
                .from("campaign-sender@mycompany.com")
                .fromName("My Company")
                .replyTo("support@mycompany.com")
                .subject("Hello")
                .htmlBody("<p>Hi</p>")
                .build();

        SmtpEmailProvider provider = new SmtpEmailProvider(mailSender, "me@gmail.com");
        provider.send(req);

        ArgumentCaptor<MimeMessage> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(MimeMessage.class);
        verify(mailSender).send(captor.capture());
        MimeMessage sent = captor.getValue();

        assertThat(sent.getFrom()[0].toString()).contains("me@gmail.com");
        // An explicit reply-to wins over the fallback.
        assertThat(sent.getReplyTo()[0].toString()).contains("support@mycompany.com");
    }

    @Test
    void mailhog_mode_keeps_campaign_sender_as_from() throws Exception {
        when(mailSender.createMimeMessage()).thenReturn(newMimeMessage());

        // No authenticated username (MailHog / un-authenticated relay).
        SmtpEmailProvider provider = new SmtpEmailProvider(mailSender, "");
        provider.send(sampleRequest());

        ArgumentCaptor<MimeMessage> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(MimeMessage.class);
        verify(mailSender).send(captor.capture());
        MimeMessage sent = captor.getValue();

        // From is the campaign's own sender, unchanged.
        assertThat(sent.getFrom()[0].toString()).contains("campaign-sender@mycompany.com");
        // No reply-to override was added: Jakarta Mail's getReplyTo() falls back
        // to the From address when none was explicitly set, so it must equal From
        // (i.e. still the campaign sender, not any injected override).
        assertThat(sent.getReplyTo()[0].toString()).contains("campaign-sender@mycompany.com");
    }

    @Test
    void null_username_is_treated_as_unauthenticated() throws Exception {
        when(mailSender.createMimeMessage()).thenReturn(newMimeMessage());

        SmtpEmailProvider provider = new SmtpEmailProvider(mailSender, null);
        provider.send(sampleRequest());

        ArgumentCaptor<MimeMessage> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(MimeMessage.class);
        verify(mailSender).send(captor.capture());
        assertThat(captor.getValue().getFrom()[0].toString())
                .contains("campaign-sender@mycompany.com");
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/email/SmtpSslTrustConfigTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSenderImpl;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

class SmtpSslTrustConfigTest {

    @Test
    void no_trust_property_without_a_value_so_normal_certificate_checks_apply() {
        for (String blank : new String[] {null, "", "  "}) {
            JavaMailSenderImpl sender = new JavaMailSenderImpl();
            sender.getJavaMailProperties().setProperty(SmtpSslTrustConfig.PROPERTY, "");
            SmtpSslTrustConfig.apply(sender, blank);
            assertThat(sender.getJavaMailProperties()).doesNotContainKey(SmtpSslTrustConfig.PROPERTY);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void a_configured_trust_host_is_set() {
        JavaMailSenderImpl sender = new JavaMailSenderImpl();
        SmtpSslTrustConfig.apply(sender, " smtp.gmail.com ");
        assertThat(sender.getJavaMailProperties().getProperty(SmtpSslTrustConfig.PROPERTY)).isEqualTo("smtp.gmail.com");
    }

    @Test
    void application_yml_no_longer_sets_an_empty_trust_property() throws Exception {
        String yml = Files.readString(Path.of("src/main/resources/application.yml"));
        assertThat(yml).doesNotContain("trust: ${SMTP_SSL_TRUST");
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/email/UnsubscribeListQueryTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.email;

import com.mailflow.email.entity.UnsubscribeEntry;
import com.mailflow.email.repository.UnsubscribeRepository;
import org.hibernate.Session;
import org.hibernate.SessionFactory;
import org.hibernate.boot.MetadataSources;
import org.hibernate.boot.registry.StandardServiceRegistry;
import org.hibernate.boot.registry.StandardServiceRegistryBuilder;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.expression.spel.standard.SpelExpressionParser;
import org.springframework.expression.spel.support.StandardEvaluationContext;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

/**
 * Runs the unsubscribe-list lookup used by the upload preview and /lookup through
 * Hibernate against the real UnsubscribeEntry mapping, on an in-memory H2 database
 * with a hand-written table, and evaluates UnsubscribeService's cache-key expressions.
 * PostgreSQL and the Spring cache itself are not used.
 *
 * <p>The list is per organization: an opt-out from one company must not hide the
 * address from another company.
 */
class UnsubscribeListQueryTest {

    private static final String URL = "jdbc:h2:mem:unsubscribe_list_query;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1";

    private static StandardServiceRegistry registry;
    private static SessionFactory sessionFactory;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setUp() throws Exception {
        try (Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, "sa", "");
             Statement s = c.createStatement()) {
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE unsubscribe_list (
                        id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, organization_id BIGINT NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                        token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, reason VARCHAR(1000),
                        unsubscribed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, campaign_id BIGINT,
                        UNIQUE (organization_id, email))""");
            s.execute("""
                    INSERT INTO unsubscribe_list (id, organization_id, email, token, unsubscribed_at, campaign_id) VALUES
                        (1, 1, 'ada@test.local', 't1', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL),
                        (2, 1, 'bob@test.local', 't2', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 7),
                        (3, 2, 'carol@test.local', 't3', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL)""");
        }
        registry = new StandardServiceRegistryBuilder()
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.url", URL)
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.username", "sa")
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.password", "")
                .applySetting("hibernate.hbm2ddl.auto", "none")
                .build();
        sessionFactory = new MetadataSources(registry)
                .addAnnotatedClass(UnsubscribeEntry.class)
                .buildMetadata()
                .buildSessionFactory();
    }

    @AfterAll
    static void tearDown() {
        if (sessionFactory != null) sessionFactory.close();
        if (registry != null) StandardServiceRegistryBuilder.destroy(registry);
    }

    private static List<String> findEmailsIn(Session session, long orgId, List<String> emails) throws Exception {
        String jpql = UnsubscribeRepository.class.getMethod("findEmailsIn", Long.class, Collection.class)
                .getAnnotation(Query.class).value();
        return session.createQuery(jpql, String.class)
                .setParameter("orgId", orgId)
                .setParameter("emails", emails)
                .getResultList();
    }

    @Test
    void find_emails_in_returns_only_the_listed_addresses_of_the_organization() throws Exception {
        try (Session session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            assertThat(findEmailsIn(session, 1, List.of("ada@test.local", "bob@test.local", "nobody@test.local")))
                    .containsExactlyInAnyOrder("ada@test.local", "bob@test.local");
            assertThat(findEmailsIn(session, 1, List.of("nobody@test.local"))).isEmpty();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void an_opt_out_from_one_company_does_not_apply_to_another() throws Exception {
        try (Session session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            // carol opted out of company 2 only; ada and bob of company 1 only.
            assertThat(findEmailsIn(session, 1, List.of("carol@test.local"))).isEmpty();
            assertThat(findEmailsIn(session, 2, List.of("ada@test.local", "bob@test.local", "carol@test.local")))
                    .containsExactly("carol@test.local");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void the_cache_keys_are_the_organization_and_the_normalised_address() throws Exception {
        // The "unsubscribed" cache is read when sending and evicted on unsubscribe; both
        // keys must be the same, whatever spelling each caller uses, and must differ
        // between organizations.
        String readKey = UnsubscribeService.class.getMethod("isUnsubscribed", Long.class, String.class)
                .getAnnotation(Cacheable.class).key();
        String evictKey = UnsubscribeService.class
                .getMethod("unsubscribe", Long.class, String.class, String.class, Long.class)
                .getAnnotation(CacheEvict.class).key();
        assertThat(evictKey).isEqualTo(readKey);

        SpelExpressionParser parser = new SpelExpressionParser();
        for (String spelling : List.of("ada@test.local", " Ada@Test.Local\u00A0", "\u200BADA@TEST.LOCAL\uFEFF")) {
            StandardEvaluationContext context = new StandardEvaluationContext();
            context.setVariable("organizationId", 1L);
            context.setVariable("email", spelling);
            assertThat(parser.parseExpression(readKey).getValue(context)).isEqualTo("1:ada@test.local");
        }
        StandardEvaluationContext other = new StandardEvaluationContext();
        other.setVariable("organizationId", 2L);
        other.setVariable("email", "ada@test.local");
        assertThat(parser.parseExpression(readKey).getValue(other)).isEqualTo("2:ada@test.local");
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/recipient/RecipientImportPreviewTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient;

import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import com.mailflow.email.repository.UnsubscribeRepository;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.BulkRecipientRequest;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.BulkRecipientResponse;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.ExcelPreviewResponse;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.ExcelRowPreview;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.ImportResult;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.RecipientStatus;
import com.mailflow.recipient.repository.RecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.recipient.service.RecipientImportService;
import org.apache.poi.hssf.usermodel.HSSFWorkbook;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Row;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Sheet;
import org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.Workbook;
import org.apache.poi.xssf.usermodel.XSSFWorkbook;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockMultipartFile;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.Charset;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyList;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

/**
 * Tests the validate-only preview, bulk create/reuse, and template generation
 * added for the "bulk email from Excel" feature. No emails are sent and
 * nothing touches a real database (the repository is mocked).
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class RecipientImportPreviewTest {

    @org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
    void signInTestOrganization() {
        com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.signIn();
    }

    @org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach
    void signOutTestOrganization() {
        com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.signOut();
    }

    @Mock private RecipientRepository recipientRepository;
    @Mock private UnsubscribeRepository unsubscribeRepository;
    @InjectMocks private RecipientImportService importService;

    // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** Builds an in-memory .xlsx with the given header row and data rows. */
    private MockMultipartFile excel(String name, String[] headers, String[][] rows) throws IOException {
        return workbookFile(new XSSFWorkbook(), name,
                "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", headers, rows);
    }

    private MockMultipartFile workbookFile(Workbook wb, String name, String contentType,
                                           String[] headers, String[][] rows) throws IOException {
        try (wb; ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
            Sheet sheet = wb.createSheet("Sheet1");
            Row header = sheet.createRow(0);
            for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
                header.createCell(i).setCellValue(headers[i]);
            }
            for (int r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
                Row row = sheet.createRow(r + 1);
                for (int c = 0; c < rows[r].length; c++) {
                    if (rows[r][c] != null) row.createCell(c).setCellValue(rows[r][c]);
                }
            }
            wb.write(out);
            return new MockMultipartFile("file", name, contentType, out.toByteArray());
        }
    }

    private MockMultipartFile csv(String name, byte[] content) {
        return new MockMultipartFile("file", name, "text/csv", content);
    }

    private Recipient saved(long id, String email, RecipientStatus status) {
        return Recipient.builder().id(id).email(email).status(status).build();
    }

    // ── Preview: valid / invalid / duplicate / existing detection ──────────────

    @Test
    void preview_flags_valid_invalid_and_in_file_duplicates() throws IOException {
        MockMultipartFile file = excel(
                "contacts.xlsx",
                new String[] {"Email", "Name", "Company"},
                new String[][] {
                        {"ada@example.com",  "Ada",  "Acme"},   // valid
                        {"not-an-email",     "Bob",  "Beta"},    // invalid
                        {"ada@example.com",  "Ada2", "Acme"},    // duplicate (in file)
                        {"grace@example.com","Grace","Gamma"},   // valid
                });

        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewExcel(file);

        assertThat(res.totalRows()).isEqualTo(4);
        assertThat(res.validRows()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(res.newRows()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(res.invalidRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.duplicateRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.existingRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(res.skippedRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(res.hasEmailColumn()).isTrue();
        assertThat(res.columns()).containsExactly("Email", "Name", "Company");
        assertThat(res.rows()).hasSize(4);

        assertThat(res.rows().get(1).status()).isEqualTo(ExcelRowPreview.INVALID);
        assertThat(res.rows().get(1).reason()).isEqualTo("Not a valid email address");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(2).status()).isEqualTo(ExcelRowPreview.DUPLICATE);
        assertThat(res.rows().get(2).reason()).contains("first on row 2");
    }

    @Test
    void preview_marks_saved_contacts_as_existing_with_their_id() throws IOException {
        // grace is already a saved contact: she is reused, not reported as a problem
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList()))
                .thenReturn(List.of(saved(42L, "grace@example.com", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)));

        MockMultipartFile file = excel(
                "contacts.xlsx",
                new String[] {"Email", "Name"},
                new String[][] {
                        {"ada@example.com",   "Ada"},
                        {"GRACE@example.com", "Grace"},
                });

        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewExcel(file);

        // Valid counts every address that can be emailed: the new one and the saved contact.
        assertThat(res.validRows()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(res.newRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.existingRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.duplicateRows()).isZero();
        ExcelRowPreview graceRow = res.rows().get(1);
        assertThat(graceRow.status()).isEqualTo(ExcelRowPreview.EXISTING);
        assertThat(graceRow.recipientId()).isEqualTo(42L);
        assertThat(graceRow.email()).isEqualTo("grace@example.com");
        assertThat(graceRow.reason()).containsIgnoringCase("saved contact");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(0).recipientId()).isNull();
    }

    @Test
    void preview_skips_saved_contacts_that_are_not_active_and_says_why() throws IOException {
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of(
                saved(7L, "gone@example.com", RecipientStatus.UNSUBSCRIBED),
                saved(8L, "bounced@example.com", RecipientStatus.BOUNCED),
                saved(9L, "bad@example.com", RecipientStatus.INVALID)));

        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewExcel(excel(
                "contacts.xlsx", new String[] {"Email"},
                new String[][] {{"gone@example.com"}, {"bounced@example.com"}, {"bad@example.com"}}));

        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::status).containsOnly(ExcelRowPreview.SKIPPED);
        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::recipientId).containsExactly(7L, 8L, 9L);
        assertThat(res.rows().get(0).reason()).startsWith("Unsubscribed");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(1).reason()).startsWith("Bounced");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(2).reason()).startsWith("Marked invalid");
        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::reason)
                .noneMatch(r -> r.toLowerCase().contains("duplicate") || r.toLowerCase().contains("used before"));
        assertThat(res.skippedRows()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(res.validRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(res.existingRows()).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void preview_skips_addresses_on_the_unsubscribe_list_and_says_why() throws IOException {
        // A saved ACTIVE contact whose address is on the unsubscribe list, and an address
        // that is only on the list. Both are skipped when sending, so neither is Valid.
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList()))
                .thenReturn(List.of(saved(5L, "listed@example.com", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)));
        when(unsubscribeRepository.findEmailsIn(any(), anyList()))
                .thenReturn(List.of("listed@example.com", "optout@example.com"));

        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewExcel(excel(
                "contacts.xlsx", new String[] {"Email"},
                new String[][] {{"listed@example.com"}, {"optout@example.com"}, {"fine@example.com"}}));

        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::status)
                .containsExactly(ExcelRowPreview.SKIPPED, ExcelRowPreview.SKIPPED, ExcelRowPreview.VALID);
        assertThat(res.rows().get(0).recipientId()).isEqualTo(5L);
        assertThat(res.rows().get(0).reason()).startsWith("Unsubscribed");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(1).recipientId()).isNull();
        assertThat(res.rows().get(1).reason()).isEqualTo("Unsubscribed: this address won't be emailed");
        assertThat(res.skippedRows()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(res.validRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.totalRows())
                .isEqualTo(res.validRows() + res.invalidRows() + res.duplicateRows() + res.skippedRows());
    }

    @Test
    void preview_normalises_addresses_before_matching_and_returns_the_normalised_address() throws IOException {
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("grace@example.com", "ada@example.com")))
                .thenReturn(List.of(saved(42L, "grace@example.com", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)));

        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewExcel(excel(
                "contacts.xlsx", new String[] {"Email"},
                new String[][] {
                        {" GRACE@Example.com\u00A0"},     // saved contact, NBSP after it
                        {"\u200Bgrace@example.com\uFEFF"}, // same address with invisible characters
                        {"\u2060Ada@Example.com\u200D"},   // new address
                }));

        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::status)
                .containsExactly(ExcelRowPreview.EXISTING, ExcelRowPreview.DUPLICATE, ExcelRowPreview.VALID);
        assertThat(res.rows().get(1).reason()).contains("first on row 2");
        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::email)
                .containsExactly("grace@example.com", "grace@example.com", "ada@example.com");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(2).fields()).containsEntry("email", "ada@example.com");
        verify(unsubscribeRepository).findEmailsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("grace@example.com", "ada@example.com"));
    }

    @Test
    void preview_accepts_display_name_and_mailto_cells() throws IOException {
        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewUpload(csv("pasted.csv",
                ("Email,Name\n"
                        + "\"Ada Lovelace <Ada@Example.com>\",Ada\n"
                        + "mailto:grace@example.com?subject=Hello,Grace\n"
                        + "\"Alan <not an address>\",Alan\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)), null);

        assertThat(res.rows()).extracting(ExcelRowPreview::status)
                .containsExactly(ExcelRowPreview.VALID, ExcelRowPreview.VALID, ExcelRowPreview.INVALID);
        assertThat(res.rows().get(0).email()).isEqualTo("ada@example.com");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(0).name()).isEqualTo("Ada");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(1).email()).isEqualTo("grace@example.com");
        assertThat(res.rows().get(2).email()).isEqualTo("Alan <not an address>");
````
