````java
    // ── Column mapping overrides ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void preview_applies_column_mapping_overrides() {
        MockMultipartFile file = csv("crm-export.csv",
                "Contact,Org,Team,Notes\nada@example.com,Acme,Platform,call back\n"
                        .getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        // Without a mapping, "Contact" is not recognised as the email column.
        assertThat(importService.previewUpload(file, null).hasEmailColumn()).isFalse();

        ExcelPreviewResponse res = importService.previewUpload(file, Map.of(
                "Contact", "email",
                "Org", "company",
                "Team", "custom:Team",
                "Notes", "ignore"));

        assertThat(res.hasEmailColumn()).isTrue();
        assertThat(res.detectedColumns())
                .containsEntry("Contact", "email")
                .containsEntry("Org", "company")
                .containsEntry("Team", "custom:Team")
                .doesNotContainKey("Notes");
        assertThat(res.unmappedColumns()).containsExactly("Notes");
        ExcelRowPreview row = res.rows().get(0);
        assertThat(row.status()).isEqualTo(ExcelRowPreview.VALID);
        assertThat(row.fields())
                .containsEntry("email", "ada@example.com")
                .containsEntry("company", "Acme")
                .containsEntry("Team", "Platform")
                .doesNotContainKey("Notes");
    }

        assertThat(res.unmappedColumns()).containsExactly("Email");

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> importService.previewUpload(file, Map.of("A", "email", "B", "email")))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)

                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class);

    @Test
    void files_over_5_mb_are_rejected_before_parsing_and_5_mb_is_accepted() {
        // One row whose unused Notes cell pads the file to exactly 5 MB.
        byte[] atLimit = new byte[(int) RecipientImportService.MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES];
        java.util.Arrays.fill(atLimit, (byte) 'x');
        byte[] start = "Email,Notes\nada@example.com,".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        System.arraycopy(start, 0, atLimit, 0, start.length);

        ExcelPreviewResponse preview = importService.previewUpload(csv("five-mb.csv", atLimit), null);
        assertThat(preview.totalRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(preview.validRows()).isEqualTo(1);

        byte[] overLimit = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(atLimit, atLimit.length + 1);
        overLimit[overLimit.length - 1] = 'x';
        clearInvocations(recipientRepository);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> importService.previewUpload(csv("too-big.csv", overLimit), null))
                .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("larger than 5 MB");
        verifyNoInteractions(recipientRepository);
    }

    @Test
    void the_multipart_limit_lets_files_over_5_mb_reach_the_400_check() {
        // Spring rejects a request above its multipart limits before the controller runs
        // (413 FILE_TOO_LARGE). The limits must stay above 5 MB, or the preview's clear
        // 400 message for a 5-25 MB file would never be returned.
        org.springframework.beans.factory.config.YamlPropertiesFactoryBean yaml =
                new org.springframework.beans.factory.config.YamlPropertiesFactoryBean();
        yaml.setResources(new org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource("application.yml"));
        java.util.Properties props = yaml.getObject();
        assertThat(props).isNotNull();

        long maxFile = org.springframework.util.unit.DataSize
                .parse(props.getProperty("spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size")).toBytes();
        long maxRequest = org.springframework.util.unit.DataSize
                .parse(props.getProperty("spring.servlet.multipart.max-request-size")).toBytes();
        assertThat(maxFile).isEqualTo(25L * 1024 * 1024).isGreaterThan(RecipientImportService.MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES);
        assertThat(maxRequest).isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(maxFile);

        // Above the multipart limit the API answers 413 with the standard error body.
        jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request =
                new org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletRequest("POST", "/api/recipients/import/excel/preview");
        var response = new com.mailflow.common.exception.GlobalExceptionHandler().handleMaxUploadSize(
                new org.springframework.web.multipart.MaxUploadSizeExceededException(maxFile), request);
        assertThat(response.getStatusCode().value()).isEqualTo(413);
        assertThat(response.getBody()).isNotNull();
        assertThat(response.getBody().error()).isEqualTo("FILE_TOO_LARGE");
    }

    // ── Bulk create / reuse ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void bulk_creates_new_and_reuses_existing_by_email() {
        Recipient existing = Recipient.builder()
                .id(42L).email("grace@example.com").name("Grace").build();
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of(existing));
        // saveAll returns the created recipients with assigned IDs
        when(recipientRepository.saveAll(anyList())).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            List<Recipient> arg = inv.getArgument(0);
            List<Recipient> saved = new ArrayList<>();
            long id = 100;
            for (Recipient r : arg) { r.setId(id++); saved.add(r); }
            return saved;
        });

        BulkRecipientRequest req = new BulkRecipientRequest(List.of(
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("ada@example.com", "Ada", "Ada", "Lovelace", "Acme",
                        java.util.Map.of("role", "Engineer")),
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("grace@example.com", "Grace", null, null, null, null),
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("not-an-email", "Bad", null, null, null, null)
        ), null);

        BulkRecipientResponse res = importService.bulkCreateOrReuse(req);

        assertThat(res.created()).isEqualTo(1);          // ada
        assertThat(res.reused()).isEqualTo(1);           // grace
        assertThat(res.skippedInvalid()).isEqualTo(1);   // not-an-email
        assertThat(res.skippedDeleted()).isZero();
        assertThat(res.recipientIds()).contains(42L);    // reused id
        assertThat(res.recipientIds()).hasSize(2);
    }

    @Test
    void bulk_deduplicates_within_request() {
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of());
        when(recipientRepository.saveAll(anyList())).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            List<Recipient> arg = inv.getArgument(0);
            long id = 1;
            for (Recipient r : arg) r.setId(id++);
            return arg;
        });

        BulkRecipientRequest req = new BulkRecipientRequest(List.of(
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("ADA@example.com", "Ada", null, null, null, null),
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("ada@example.com", "Ada again", null, null, null, null)
        ), null);

        BulkRecipientResponse res = importService.bulkCreateOrReuse(req);

        // Same email (case-insensitive) collapses to one created recipient
        assertThat(res.created()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.recipientIds()).hasSize(1);
    }

    @Test
    void bulk_skips_deleted_contacts_instead_of_failing_or_reactivating_them() {
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of());
        when(recipientRepository.findDeletedEmails(any(), anyList())).thenReturn(List.of("old@example.com"));
        when(recipientRepository.saveAll(anyList())).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            List<Recipient> arg = inv.getArgument(0);
            long id = 500;
            for (Recipient r : arg) r.setId(id++);
            return arg;
        });

        BulkRecipientResponse res = importService.bulkCreateOrReuse(new BulkRecipientRequest(List.of(
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("old@example.com", null, null, null, null, null),
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("new@example.com", null, null, null, null, null)
        ), "MANUAL"));

        assertThat(res.created()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.skippedDeleted()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.recipientIds()).containsExactly(500L);
        // Only the new address was inserted, tagged as entered manually in a campaign.
        verify(recipientRepository).saveAll(argThat((List<Recipient> list) ->
                list.size() == 1
                        && list.get(0).getEmail().equals("new@example.com")
                        && "CAMPAIGN_MANUAL".equals(list.get(0).getImportSource())));
    }

    @Test
    void bulk_normalises_invisible_characters_and_reuses_the_saved_contact() {
        Recipient grace = Recipient.builder().id(42L).email("grace@example.com").build();
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, List.of("grace@example.com"))).thenReturn(List.of(grace));
        when(recipientRepository.saveAll(anyList())).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        BulkRecipientResponse res = importService.bulkCreateOrReuse(new BulkRecipientRequest(List.of(
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("\u00A0Grace@Example.com\u200B", null, null, null, null, null),
                new BulkRecipientRequest.Row("\uFEFFgrace@example.com ", null, null, null, null, null)
        ), "UPLOAD"));

        assertThat(res.created()).isZero();
        assertThat(res.reused()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(res.skippedInvalid()).isZero();
        assertThat(res.recipientIds()).containsExactly(42L);
        verify(recipientRepository).saveAll(argThat((List<Recipient> list) -> list.isEmpty()));
    }

    // ── Legacy import (Recipients page) ─────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void legacy_csv_import_skips_repeats_within_the_file_instead_of_failing() throws Exception {
        // Two spellings of one address: inserting both would break the unique email column.
        when(recipientRepository.findExistingEmails(List.of("ada@example.com", "grace@example.com")))
                .thenReturn(List.of("grace@example.com"));

        ImportResult result = importService.importCsv(csv("contacts.csv",
                ("email,name\nada@example.com,Ada\n ADA@Example.com\u00A0,Ada again\n"
                        + "grace@example.com,Grace\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));

        assertThat(result.totalRows()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(result.imported()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(result.skippedDuplicates()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(result.invalidRows()).isZero();
        verify(recipientRepository).saveAll(argThat((List<Recipient> list) ->
                list.size() == 1 && list.get(0).getEmail().equals("ada@example.com")));
    }

    // ── Template generation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void template_contains_canonical_headers_and_examples() throws IOException {
        // Exactly the columns of the campaign form's "Add emails manually" table:
        // TABLE_COLUMNS in frontend/src/lib/manualTable.ts (manualTable.test.ts asserts the same list).
        assertThat(RecipientImportService.TEMPLATE_HEADERS).containsExactly("Email", "Name", "Company");

        byte[] bytes = importService.buildExcelTemplate();
        assertThat(bytes).isNotEmpty();

        try (Workbook wb = new XSSFWorkbook(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))) {
            Sheet sheet = wb.getSheetAt(0);
            Row header = sheet.getRow(0);
            List<String> headers = new ArrayList<>();
            header.forEach(c -> headers.add(c.getStringCellValue()));

            assertThat(headers).containsExactly("Email", "Name", "Company");
            // 3 example rows, one value per column, all at example.com
            assertThat(sheet.getLastRowNum()).isEqualTo(3);
            for (int r = 1; r <= 3; r++) {
                Row row = sheet.getRow(r);
                assertThat(row.getLastCellNum()).isEqualTo((short) 3);
                assertThat(row.getCell(0).getStringCellValue()).endsWith("@example.com");
                assertThat(row.getCell(1).getStringCellValue()).isNotBlank();
                assertThat(row.getCell(2).getStringCellValue()).isNotBlank();
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void the_template_columns_are_the_frontend_table_columns() throws IOException {
        // The other side of the same check: the table in the campaign form lists the template's columns.
        Path source = Path.of("frontend", "src", "lib", "manualTable.ts");
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(source), "frontend sources are not checked out next to the backend");
        String ts = Files.readString(source, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Matcher m = Pattern.compile("export const TABLE_COLUMNS = \\[([^\\]]*)\\] as const;").matcher(ts);
        assertThat(m.find()).as("TABLE_COLUMNS in %s", source).isTrue();
        List<String> columns = new ArrayList<>();
        Matcher item = Pattern.compile("'([^']*)'").matcher(m.group(1));
        while (item.find()) columns.add(item.group(1));
        assertThat(columns).containsExactlyElementsOf(RecipientImportService.TEMPLATE_HEADERS);
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/recipient/RecipientListSortTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient;

import com.mailflow.recipient.controller.RecipientController;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.RecipientStatus;
import com.mailflow.recipient.service.RecipientImportService;
import com.mailflow.recipient.service.RecipientService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.isNull;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;

/**
 * The contact list is paged by the requested sort (created_at by default). Many
 * contacts share created_at, and PostgreSQL may return tied rows in a different order
 * for each page, so the list adds the id as a tie-breaker.
 */
class RecipientListSortTest {

    private final RecipientService service = mock(RecipientService.class);
    private final RecipientController controller =
            new RecipientController(service, mock(RecipientImportService.class));

    private Pageable requested(String sort, String dir) {
        controller.list("ada", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE, 2, 20, sort, dir);
        ArgumentCaptor<Pageable> pageable = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(Pageable.class);
        verify(service).findAll(eq("ada"), eq(RecipientStatus.ACTIVE), pageable.capture());
        return pageable.getValue();
    }

    @Test
    void ties_in_the_requested_sort_are_broken_by_id() {
        Pageable pageable = requested("createdAt", "desc");

        assertThat(pageable.getPageNumber()).isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(pageable.getPageSize()).isEqualTo(20);
        assertThat(pageable.getSort()).containsExactly(Sort.Order.desc("createdAt"), Sort.Order.desc("id"));
    }

    @Test
    void sorting_by_id_is_not_repeated() {
        assertThat(requested("id", "asc").getSort()).containsExactly(Sort.Order.asc("id"));
    }

    @Test
    void no_search_or_status_is_passed_through_as_null() {
        controller.list(null, null, 0, 20, "email", "asc");
        ArgumentCaptor<Pageable> pageable = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(Pageable.class);
        verify(service).findAll(isNull(), isNull(), pageable.capture());
        assertThat(pageable.getValue().getSort()).containsExactly(Sort.Order.asc("email"), Sort.Order.asc("id"));
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient;

import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.RecipientStatus;
import com.mailflow.recipient.repository.RecipientRepository;
import org.hibernate.Session;
import org.hibernate.SessionFactory;
import org.hibernate.boot.MetadataSources;
import org.hibernate.boot.registry.StandardServiceRegistry;
import org.hibernate.boot.registry.StandardServiceRegistryBuilder;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.List;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

/**
 * Runs the saved-contact search query (used by the campaign form's contact picker and
 * the Recipients page) through Hibernate against the real Recipient mapping, on an
 * in-memory H2 database with a hand-written table. PostgreSQL itself is not used.
 */
class RecipientSearchQueryTest {

    private static final String URL = "jdbc:h2:mem:recipient_search;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1";

    private static StandardServiceRegistry registry;
    private static SessionFactory sessionFactory;
    private static String searchQuery;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setUp() throws Exception {
        try (Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, "sa", "");
             Statement s = c.createStatement()) {
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE recipients (organization_id BIGINT, 
                        id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255),
                        first_name VARCHAR(100), last_name VARCHAR(100), company VARCHAR(255),
                        course VARCHAR(255), custom_fields JSON, status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
                        import_source VARCHAR(100), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        version BIGINT NOT NULL)""");
            s.execute("""
                    INSERT INTO recipients (id, email, name, first_name, last_name, company, status, deleted_at, version) VALUES
                        (1, 'ada@test.local',     'Ada Lovelace', 'Ada',       'Lovelace', 'Analytical Engines', 'ACTIVE', NULL, 0),
                        (2, 'grace@test.local',   'Grace Hopper', 'Alan',      'Turing',   'Navy',               'ACTIVE', NULL, 0),
                        (3, 'kj@test.local',      NULL,           'Katherine', 'Johnson',  NULL,                 'ACTIVE', NULL, 0),
                        (4, 'gone@test.local',    'Katherine Gone', 'Katherine', 'Gone',   NULL,                 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0),
                        (5, 'optout@test.local',  'Opt Out',      'Katherine', 'Out',      NULL,          'UNSUBSCRIBED', NULL, 0)""");
        }

        registry = new StandardServiceRegistryBuilder()
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.url", URL)
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.username", "sa")
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.password", "")
                .applySetting("hibernate.hbm2ddl.auto", "none")
                .applySetting("hibernate.tenant_identifier_resolver", new com.mailflow.tenant.TenantIdentifierResolver())
                .build();
        sessionFactory = new MetadataSources(registry)
                .addAnnotatedClass(Recipient.class)
                .buildMetadata()
                .buildSessionFactory();
        searchQuery = RecipientRepository.class
                .getMethod("findAllActive", String.class, RecipientStatus.class, Pageable.class)
                .getAnnotation(Query.class).value();
    }

    @AfterAll
    static void tearDown() {
        if (sessionFactory != null) sessionFactory.close();
        if (registry != null) StandardServiceRegistryBuilder.destroy(registry);
    }

    private static List<Long> search(String text, RecipientStatus status) {
        try (Session session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            return session.createQuery(searchQuery, Recipient.class)
                    .setParameter("search", text)
                    .setParameter("status", status)
                    .getResultList().stream()
                    .map(Recipient::getId)
                    .sorted()
                    .toList();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void search_matches_name_email_and_company() {
        assertThat(search("hopper", null)).containsExactly(2L);
        assertThat(search("ADA@TEST", null)).containsExactly(1L);
        assertThat(search("navy", null)).containsExactly(2L);
        assertThat(search("engines", null)).containsExactly(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void search_matches_first_and_last_name_even_when_the_name_differs_or_is_empty() {
        // The picker shows "first last" when there is no name, and templates personalise
        // with the first name, so both must be searchable.
        assertThat(search("alan", null)).containsExactly(2L);
        assertThat(search("turing", null)).containsExactly(2L);
        assertThat(search("johnson", null)).containsExactly(3L);
        assertThat(search("katherine johnson", null)).containsExactly(3L);
        assertThat(search("alan turing", null)).containsExactly(2L);
    }

    @Test
    void search_skips_deleted_contacts_and_applies_the_status_filter() {
        assertThat(search("katherine", null)).containsExactly(3L, 5L);
        assertThat(search("katherine", RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)).containsExactly(3L);
        assertThat(search(null, null)).containsExactly(1L, 2L, 3L, 5L);
        assertThat(search(null, RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)).containsExactly(1L, 2L, 3L);
        assertThat(search("nobody", null)).isEmpty();
    }
}
````

````java
package com.mailflow.recipient;

import com.mailflow.common.exception.ConflictException;
import com.mailflow.common.exception.ValidationException;
import com.mailflow.email.repository.UnsubscribeRepository;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.RecipientRequest;
import com.mailflow.recipient.dto.RecipientResponse;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.RecipientStatus;
import com.mailflow.recipient.repository.RecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.recipient.service.RecipientService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class RecipientServiceTest {

    @org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
    void signInTestOrganization() {
        com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.signIn();
    }

    @org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach
    void signOutTestOrganization() {
        com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.signOut();
    }

    @Mock private RecipientRepository recipientRepository;
    @Mock private UnsubscribeRepository unsubscribeRepository;
    @InjectMocks private RecipientService recipientService;

    private Recipient sampleRecipient;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        sampleRecipient = Recipient.builder()
                .id(1L)
                .email("test@example.com")
                .name("Test User")
                .course("Computer Science")
                .status(RecipientStatus.ACTIVE)
                .createdAt(Instant.now())
                .updatedAt(Instant.now())
                .customFields(Map.of("code", "ABC123"))
                .build();
    }

    @Test
    void creates_recipient_successfully() {
        when(recipientRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull("test@example.com")).thenReturn(false);
        when(recipientRepository.save(any(Recipient.class))).thenReturn(sampleRecipient);

        RecipientRequest request = new RecipientRequest(
            "test@example.com", "Test User", null, null, null, "Computer Science", null);

        RecipientResponse response = recipientService.create(request);

        assertThat(response.email()).isEqualTo("test@example.com");
        assertThat(response.name()).isEqualTo("Test User");
        verify(recipientRepository).save(any(Recipient.class));
    }

    @Test
    void throws_conflict_when_email_already_exists() {
        when(recipientRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull("test@example.com")).thenReturn(true);

        RecipientRequest request = new RecipientRequest(
            "test@example.com", "Test User", null, null, null, null, null);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> recipientService.create(request))
            .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class)
            .hasMessageContaining("already exists");
    }

    @Test
    void throws_validation_error_for_invalid_email() {
        RecipientRequest request = new RecipientRequest(
            "not-an-email", "Test User", null, null, null, null, null);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> recipientService.create(request))
            .isInstanceOf(ValidationException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void finds_recipient_by_id() {
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(sampleRecipient));
        RecipientResponse response = recipientService.findById(1L);
        assertThat(response.id()).isEqualTo(1L);
        assertThat(response.email()).isEqualTo("test@example.com");
    }

    @Test
    void soft_deletes_recipient() {
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(sampleRecipient));
        when(recipientRepository.save(any(Recipient.class))).thenReturn(sampleRecipient);

        recipientService.delete(1L);

        verify(recipientRepository).save(argThat(r -> r.getDeletedAt() != null));
    }

    @Test
    void lookup_finds_saved_contacts_by_id_and_email_without_writing() {
        Recipient byEmail = Recipient.builder()
                .id(2L).email("grace@example.com").status(RecipientStatus.UNSUBSCRIBED).build();
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdInAndDeletedAtIsNull(java.util.Set.of(1L, 99L)))
                .thenReturn(java.util.List.of(sampleRecipient));
        // Emails are normalised (trim + lower-case); invalid ones are ignored.
        when(recipientRepository.findByEmailIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, java.util.List.of("grace@example.com", "old@example.com")))
                .thenReturn(java.util.List.of(byEmail));
        when(recipientRepository.findDeletedEmails(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, java.util.List.of("grace@example.com", "old@example.com")))
                .thenReturn(java.util.List.of("old@example.com"));
        when(unsubscribeRepository.findEmailsIn(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, java.util.List.of("grace@example.com", "old@example.com")))
                .thenReturn(java.util.List.of("grace@example.com"));

        var response = recipientService.lookup(new com.mailflow.recipient.dto.RecipientLookupRequest(
                java.util.List.of(1L, 99L),
                // Normalised with the shared rule, invisible characters included.
                java.util.List.of(" Grace@Example.com\u00A0", "\u200Bold@example.com\uFEFF", "not-an-email")));

        assertThat(response.recipients()).extracting(RecipientResponse::id).containsExactly(1L, 2L);
        assertThat(response.recipients().get(1).status()).isEqualTo(RecipientStatus.UNSUBSCRIBED);
        assertThat(response.deletedEmails()).containsExactly("old@example.com");
        assertThat(response.unsubscribedEmails()).containsExactly("grace@example.com");
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).save(any());
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
        verify(unsubscribeRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void create_normalises_the_email_before_checking_and_storing_it() {
        when(recipientRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull("ada@test.local")).thenReturn(false);
        when(recipientRepository.save(any(Recipient.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        RecipientResponse response = recipientService.create(new RecipientRequest(
                "\uFEFF Ada@Test.Local\u00A0", "Ada", null, null, null, null, null));

        assertThat(response.email()).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        verify(recipientRepository).existsByEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull("ada@test.local");
        verify(recipientRepository).save(argThat(r -> r.getEmail().equals("ada@test.local")));
    }

    @Test
    void the_request_normalises_the_email_before_bean_validation() {
        jakarta.validation.Validator validator =
                jakarta.validation.Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory().getValidator();
        RecipientRequest padded = new RecipientRequest(" ada@test.local\u200B ", null, null, null, null, null, null);

        assertThat(padded.email()).isEqualTo("ada@test.local");
        assertThat(validator.validate(padded)).isEmpty();
        assertThat(new RecipientRequest(null, null, null, null, null, null, null).email()).isNull();
    }

    @Test
    void update_compares_and_stores_the_normalised_email() {
        when(recipientRepository.findByIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(sampleRecipient));
        when(recipientRepository.save(any(Recipient.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        // Same address, other spelling: no "already in use" check against itself.
        recipientService.update(1L, new RecipientRequest(
                "\u2060TEST@example.com ", "Test User", null, null, null, null, null));
        assertThat(sampleRecipient.getEmail()).isEqualTo("test@example.com");
        verify(recipientRepository, never()).existsByEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull(any());

        // A different address is checked and stored normalised.
        when(recipientRepository.existsByEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull("new@example.com")).thenReturn(false);
        recipientService.update(1L, new RecipientRequest(
                " New@Example.com\u00A0", "Test User", null, null, null, null, null));
        assertThat(sampleRecipient.getEmail()).isEqualTo("new@example.com");
        verify(recipientRepository).existsByEmailIgnoreCaseAndDeletedAtIsNull("new@example.com");
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/security/ProductionSafetyCheckTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.security;

import com.mailflow.config.MailFlowProperties;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

class ProductionSafetyCheckTest {

    private static ProductionSafetyCheck check(String secret, boolean demoAccounts, String frontendUrl) {
        MailFlowProperties props = new MailFlowProperties();
        props.getSecurity().getJwt().setSecret(secret);
        props.getSecurity().setDemoAccountsEnabled(demoAccounts);
        ProductionSafetyCheck check = new ProductionSafetyCheck(props);
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(check, "frontendUrl", frontendUrl);
        return check;
    }

    @Test
    void safe_settings_pass() {
        assertThatCode(() -> check("q9V2sX7mN4pL8rT1wY6zB3cF5hJ0kD2gA9eR7uI4oP1=", false, "https://mailflow.vercel.app")
                .afterPropertiesSet()).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void the_default_secret_demo_accounts_and_a_missing_frontend_url_are_each_named() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> check(ProductionSafetyCheck.DEFAULT_SECRET, true, "").afterPropertiesSet())
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class)
                .satisfies(e -> assertThat(e.getMessage())
                        .contains("JWT_SECRET").contains("DEMO_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED").contains("FRONTEND_URL"));
    }

    @Test
    void the_placeholder_and_short_secrets_are_refused() {
        for (String secret : new String[] {"your-very-long-and-secure-jwt-secret-at-least-256-bits", "short"}) {
            assertThatThrownBy(() -> check(secret, false, "https://x.vercel.app").afterPropertiesSet())
                    .hasMessageContaining("JWT_SECRET");
        }
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/template/TemplateContentRenderTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.template;

import com.mailflow.batch.CampaignItemProcessor;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignRecipient;
import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.CampaignStatus;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRecipientRepository;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.config.FreemarkerConfig;
import com.mailflow.email.UnsubscribeService;
import com.mailflow.queue.EmailMessage;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import com.mailflow.template.controller.TemplateController;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateContentRenderRequest;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateRenderResponse;
import com.mailflow.template.entity.EmailTemplate;
import com.mailflow.template.repository.EmailTemplateRepository;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateEngineService;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateService;
import freemarker.cache.StringTemplateLoader;
import jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolation;
import jakarta.validation.Validation;
import jakarta.validation.Validator;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.aop.framework.ProxyFactory;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.authorization.method.AuthorizationManagerBeforeMethodInterceptor;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.times;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verifyNoInteractions;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

/**
 * POST /api/templates/render previews unsaved template content (the Templates page
 * editor). It must render exactly like a real send, save nothing, bound the request,
 * and be limited to admins and campaign managers.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class TemplateContentRenderTest {

    private static final String SUBJECT = "Hi {{FirstName}}, news for {{Company}}";
    private static final String HTML =
            "<p>{{Name}} ({{Email}}) works on {{Team}} as {{Role}}.</p><p>Phone: {{Phone}}</p>";
    private static final String PLAIN = "Dear {{firstName}} {{LastName}}, team {{Team}}";

    @Mock private EmailTemplateRepository templateRepository;
    @Mock private UnsubscribeService unsubscribeService;
    @Mock private CampaignRecipientRepository campaignRecipientRepository;
    @Mock private CampaignRepository campaignRepository;
    @Mock private TemplateService mockedTemplateService;

    private TemplateEngineService engine;
    private TemplateService templateService;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        StringTemplateLoader loader = new StringTemplateLoader();
        // The production FreeMarker configuration, built without a Spring context.
        engine = new TemplateEngineService(new FreemarkerConfig().mailflowFreemarkerConfiguration(loader), loader);
        templateService = new TemplateService(templateRepository, engine);
    }

    @AfterEach
    void clearSecurityContext() {
        SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
    }

    private static TemplateContentRenderRequest.Sample ada() {
        return new TemplateContentRenderRequest.Sample(
                "ada@demo.local", "Ada Lovelace", "Ada", "Lovelace", "Analytical Engines", null,
                Map.of("role", "Engineer", "Team", "Platform"));
    }

    @Test
    void renders_unsaved_content_exactly_like_a_real_send_and_saves_nothing() {
        TemplateRenderResponse preview = templateService.renderContent(
                new TemplateContentRenderRequest(SUBJECT, HTML, PLAIN, ada(), null));

        assertThat(preview.subject()).isEqualTo("Hi Ada, news for Analytical Engines");
        assertThat(preview.htmlBody())
                .isEqualTo("<p>Ada Lovelace (ada@demo.local) works on Platform as Engineer.</p><p>Phone: </p>");
        assertThat(preview.plainBody()).isEqualTo("Dear Ada Lovelace, team Platform");
        // {{Phone}} has no value: it renders blank (never as a raw placeholder) and is reported.
        assertThat(preview.emptyVariables()).containsExactly("Phone");

        // The batch processor, given the same content and the same person as a saved
        // contact, produces exactly the same subject and bodies.
        Recipient contact = Recipient.builder()
                .id(7L).email("ada@demo.local").name("Ada Lovelace").firstName("Ada").lastName("Lovelace")
                .company("Analytical Engines")
                .customFields(new HashMap<>(Map.of("role", "Engineer", "Team", "Platform")))
                .build();
        Campaign campaign = Campaign.builder().organizationId(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG)
                .id(3L).subject(SUBJECT).senderEmail("noreply@mailflow.local")
                .template(EmailTemplate.builder().id(9L).name("Draft").subject(SUBJECT)
                        .htmlBody(HTML).plainBody(PLAIN).build())
                .build();
        CampaignRecipient row = CampaignRecipient.builder()
                .id(1L).campaign(campaign).recipient(contact)
                .idempotencyKey(CampaignRecipient.buildIdempotencyKey(3L, 7L))
                .deliveryStatus(CampaignRecipient.DeliveryStatus.PENDING)
                .retryCount(0)
                .build();
        when(unsubscribeService.isUnsubscribed(com.mailflow.tenant.TestTenant.ORG, "ada@demo.local")).thenReturn(false);
        // The processor only renders while the campaign is RUNNING.
        when(campaignRepository.findStatusById(3L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(CampaignStatus.RUNNING));

        EmailMessage sent = new CampaignItemProcessor(
                engine, unsubscribeService, campaignRecipientRepository, campaignRepository)
                .process(row);

        assertThat(sent).isNotNull();
        assertThat(sent.subject()).isEqualTo(preview.subject());
        assertThat(sent.htmlBody()).isEqualTo(preview.htmlBody());
        assertThat(sent.plainBody()).isEqualTo(preview.plainBody());

        // No template lookup and no save: the preview never touches the database.
        verifyNoInteractions(templateRepository);
    }

    @Test
    void missing_parts_render_as_empty_strings() {
        TemplateRenderResponse preview = templateService.renderContent(new TemplateContentRenderRequest(
                null, null, "Hello {{Name}}",
                new TemplateContentRenderRequest.Sample(null, null, null, null, null, null, null), null));

        assertThat(preview.subject()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(preview.htmlBody()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(preview.plainBody()).isEqualTo("Hello ");
        assertThat(preview.emptyVariables()).containsExactly("Name");
        verifyNoInteractions(templateRepository);
    }

    @Test
    void request_size_is_limited() {
        Validator validator = Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory().getValidator();

        Map<String, String> fiftyFields = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        // 50 distinct 40-character keys ("k" plus a zero-padded number), each with a 1,000-character value.
        for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) fiftyFields.put(String.format("k%039d", i), "v".repeat(1000));
        TemplateContentRenderRequest atLimits = new TemplateContentRenderRequest(
                "s".repeat(1000), "h".repeat(500_000), "p".repeat(500_000),
                new TemplateContentRenderRequest.Sample(
                        "e".repeat(255), "n".repeat(255), "f".repeat(255), "l".repeat(255),
                        "c".repeat(255), "o".repeat(255), fiftyFields),
                "b".repeat(100_000));
        assertThat(fiftyFields).hasSize(50).allSatisfy((k, v) -> assertThat(k).hasSize(40));
        assertThat(validator.validate(atLimits)).isEmpty();

        Map<String, String> tooMany = new LinkedHashMap<>(Map.of("Team", "Platform"));
        for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) tooMany.put("k" + i, "v");
        TemplateContentRenderRequest overLimits = new TemplateContentRenderRequest(
                "s".repeat(1001), "h".repeat(500_001), "p".repeat(500_001),
                new TemplateContentRenderRequest.Sample(
                        "e".repeat(256), null, null, null, "c".repeat(256), null, tooMany),
                "b".repeat(100_001));
        assertThat(paths(validator.validate(overLimits))).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(
                "subject", "htmlBody", "plainBody", "recipient.email", "recipient.company", "recipient.fields",
                "customBody");

        // Keys and values of custom fields are bounded too.
        TemplateContentRenderRequest longKeyAndValue = new TemplateContentRenderRequest(
                "Hi", "<p>x</p>", null,
                new TemplateContentRenderRequest.Sample(null, null, null, null, null, null,
                        Map.of("k".repeat(41), "v", "Team", "v".repeat(1001))), null);
        assertThat(validator.validate(longKeyAndValue)).hasSize(2)
                .allSatisfy(v -> assertThat(v.getPropertyPath().toString()).startsWith("recipient.fields"));

        // A sample recipient is required.
        assertThat(paths(validator.validate(new TemplateContentRenderRequest("Hi", "<p>x</p>", null, null, null))))
                .containsExactly("recipient");
    }

    @Test
    void only_admins_and_campaign_managers_may_render() throws Exception {
        TemplateContentRenderRequest request = new TemplateContentRenderRequest("Hi", "<p>x</p>", null, ada(), null);
        when(mockedTemplateService.renderContent(request))
                .thenReturn(new TemplateRenderResponse("Hi", "<p>x</p>", "", List.of()));

        // The controller behind Spring Security's real @PreAuthorize interceptor.
        ProxyFactory factory = new ProxyFactory(new TemplateController(mockedTemplateService));
        factory.setProxyTargetClass(true);
        factory.addAdvisor(AuthorizationManagerBeforeMethodInterceptor.preAuthorize());
        TemplateController controller = (TemplateController) factory.getProxy();

        authenticateAs("ROLE_VIEWER");
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> controller.renderContent(request)).isInstanceOf(AccessDeniedException.class);

        authenticateAs("ROLE_CAMPAIGN_MANAGER");
        assertThat(controller.renderContent(request).getStatusCode().value()).isEqualTo(200);

        authenticateAs("ROLE_ADMIN");
        assertThat(controller.renderContent(request).getBody().subject()).isEqualTo("Hi");

        verify(mockedTemplateService, times(2)).renderContent(request);

        // Mapped at POST /api/templates/render. SecurityConfig also limits every non-GET
        // request under /api/templates/** to ADMIN and CAMPAIGN_MANAGER.
        assertThat(TemplateController.class.getAnnotation(RequestMapping.class).value())
                .containsExactly("/api/templates");
        assertThat(TemplateController.class
                .getMethod("renderContent", TemplateContentRenderRequest.class)
                .getAnnotation(PostMapping.class).value())
                .containsExactly("/render");
    }

    private static void authenticateAs(String authority) {
        SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.authenticated(
                "user@mailflow.local", null, List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority(authority))));
    }

    private static List<String> paths(Set<? extends ConstraintViolation<?>> violations) {
        return violations.stream().map(v -> v.getPropertyPath().toString()).toList();
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/template/TemplateEngineServiceTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.template;

import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateEngineService;
import freemarker.cache.StringTemplateLoader;
import freemarker.template.TemplateExceptionHandler;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

/**
 * Unit tests for the template engine (variable substitution and extraction).
 * Uses Freemarker's fully-qualified Configuration to avoid import ambiguity
 * with Spring's @Configuration annotation.
 */
class TemplateEngineServiceTest {

    private TemplateEngineService service;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        StringTemplateLoader loader = new StringTemplateLoader();
        freemarker.template.Configuration config =
                new freemarker.template.Configuration(
                        freemarker.template.Configuration.VERSION_2_3_32);
        config.setTemplateLoader(loader);
        config.setDefaultEncoding("UTF-8");
        config.setTemplateExceptionHandler(TemplateExceptionHandler.RETHROW_HANDLER);
        config.setNewBuiltinClassResolver(freemarker.core.TemplateClassResolver.SAFER_RESOLVER);

        service = new TemplateEngineService(config, loader);
    }

    @Test
    void renders_simple_variable() {
        String result = service.render("Hello {{name}}!", Map.of("name", "Rahul"));
        assertThat(result).isEqualTo("Hello Rahul!");
    }

    @Test
    void renders_multiple_variables() {
        String template = "Hi {{name}}, your code for {{course}} is {{code}}.";
        Map<String, Object> vars = Map.of("name", "Priya", "course", "CS", "code", "ABC123");
        String result = service.render(template, vars);
        assertThat(result).isEqualTo("Hi Priya, your code for CS is ABC123.");
    }

    @Test
    void missing_variable_renders_empty_string() {
        // With (var)! syntax, missing variable renders as empty string, not an exception
        String result = service.render("Hello {{name}} from {{company}}!", Map.of("name", "Arjun"));
        assertThat(result).contains("Arjun");
        assertThat(result).doesNotContain("{{company}}");
        assertThat(result).isEqualTo("Hello Arjun from !");
    }

    @Test
    void extracts_variables_from_template() {
        String template = "Hi {{name}}, your course {{course}} code is {{code}}.";
        List<String> vars = service.extractVariables(template);
        assertThat(vars).containsExactlyInAnyOrder("name", "course", "code");
    }

    @Test
    void finds_missing_variables() {
        String template = "Hi {{name}}, your code is {{code}}.";
        Map<String, Object> provided = Map.of("name", "Test");
        List<String> missing = service.findMissingVariables(template, provided);
        assertThat(missing).containsExactly("code");
    }

    @Test
    void handles_null_template_gracefully() {
        String result = service.render(null, Map.of());
        assertThat(result).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void handles_empty_template() {
        String result = service.render("", Map.of());
        assertThat(result).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void renders_html_template() {
        String html = "<p>Dear <strong>{{name}}</strong>, welcome to {{course}}.</p>";
        String result = service.render(html, Map.of("name", "Dev", "course", "Java Advanced"));
        assertThat(result).contains("<strong>Dev</strong>");
        assertThat(result).contains("Java Advanced");
    }

    @Test
    void renders_all_standard_campaign_variables() {
        String template = "Hi {{name}}, your {{course}} code at {{company}} is {{code}}.";
        Map<String, Object> vars = Map.of(
                "name", "Raj", "course", "CS", "company", "TechCorp", "code", "XY99");
        String result = service.render(template, vars);
        assertThat(result).isEqualTo("Hi Raj, your CS code at TechCorp is XY99.");
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/template/TemplateRenderPreviewTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.template;

import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateRenderRequest;
import com.mailflow.template.dto.TemplateRenderResponse;
import com.mailflow.template.entity.EmailTemplate;
import com.mailflow.template.repository.EmailTemplateRepository;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateEngineService;
import com.mailflow.template.service.TemplateService;
import freemarker.cache.StringTemplateLoader;
import freemarker.template.TemplateExceptionHandler;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

/**
 * The personalised preview must resolve placeholders exactly like a real send:
 * same model (aliases, custom fields, empty defaults), campaign subject first.
 */
@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class TemplateRenderPreviewTest {

    @Mock private EmailTemplateRepository templateRepository;

    private TemplateService templateService;
    private EmailTemplate template;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        StringTemplateLoader loader = new StringTemplateLoader();
        freemarker.template.Configuration config =
                new freemarker.template.Configuration(freemarker.template.Configuration.VERSION_2_3_32);
        config.setTemplateLoader(loader);
        config.setDefaultEncoding("UTF-8");
        config.setTemplateExceptionHandler(TemplateExceptionHandler.RETHROW_HANDLER);
        config.setNewBuiltinClassResolver(freemarker.core.TemplateClassResolver.SAFER_RESOLVER);
        templateService = new TemplateService(templateRepository, new TemplateEngineService(config, loader));

        template = EmailTemplate.builder()
                .id(5L)
                .name("Welcome")
                .subject("Template subject for {{Name}}")
                .htmlBody("<p>Hi {{FirstName}} from {{Company}} ({{Role}}, {{Team}})</p>")
                .plainBody("Hi {{firstName}}, phone: {{Phone}}")
                .build();
        when(templateRepository.findByIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(5L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(template));
    }

    private TemplateRenderRequest.Sample ada() {
        return new TemplateRenderRequest.Sample(
                "ada@example.com", "Ada Lovelace", "Ada", "Lovelace", "Acme", null,
                Map.of("role", "Engineer", "Team", "Platform"));
    }

    @Test
    void renders_campaign_subject_and_body_for_one_recipient() {
        TemplateRenderResponse res = templateService.renderForRecipient(5L,
                new TemplateRenderRequest("Hello {{FirstName}}", ada()));

        // The campaign subject (what is actually sent) wins over the template subject.
        assertThat(res.subject()).isEqualTo("Hello Ada");
        // Capitalised aliases, known custom fields and arbitrary custom fields resolve.
        assertThat(res.htmlBody()).isEqualTo("<p>Hi Ada from Acme (Engineer, Platform)</p>");
        // A placeholder without data renders blank, never as a raw {{Phone}}, and is reported.
        assertThat(res.plainBody()).isEqualTo("Hi Ada, phone: ");
        assertThat(res.emptyVariables()).containsExactly("Phone");
        verify(templateRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void blank_subject_falls_back_to_the_template_subject() {
        TemplateRenderResponse res = templateService.renderForRecipient(5L,
                new TemplateRenderRequest("  ", ada()));

        assertThat(res.subject()).isEqualTo("Template subject for Ada Lovelace");
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/tenant/TenantIsolationTest.java

````java
package com.mailflow.tenant;

import com.mailflow.campaign.entity.Campaign;
import com.mailflow.campaign.repository.CampaignRepository;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.Recipient;
import com.mailflow.recipient.entity.RecipientStatus;
import org.hibernate.Session;
import org.hibernate.SessionFactory;
import org.hibernate.boot.MetadataSources;
import org.hibernate.boot.registry.StandardServiceRegistry;
import org.hibernate.boot.registry.StandardServiceRegistryBuilder;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.List;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

/**
 * Company isolation through Hibernate's tenant filter, with the real entity mappings
 * and {@link TenantIdentifierResolver} on an in-memory H2 database. Two companies each
 * own a contact and a campaign.
 */
class TenantIsolationTest {

    private static final String URL = "jdbc:h2:mem:tenant_isolation;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1";
    private static final long ORG_A = 1, ORG_B = 2;

    private static StandardServiceRegistry registry;
    private static SessionFactory sessionFactory;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setUp() throws Exception {
        try (Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, "sa", "");
             Statement s = c.createStatement()) {
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE recipients (
                        id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, organization_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255), first_name VARCHAR(100),
                        last_name VARCHAR(100), company VARCHAR(255), course VARCHAR(255),
                        custom_fields JSON, status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, import_source VARCHAR(100),
                        created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, version BIGINT NOT NULL,
                        UNIQUE (organization_id, email))""");
            s.execute("""
                    CREATE TABLE campaigns (
                        id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, organization_id BIGINT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                        description VARCHAR(1000), subject VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, custom_body VARCHAR(1000),
                        template_id BIGINT, sender_name VARCHAR(255), sender_email VARCHAR(255),
                        reply_to VARCHAR(255), status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, scheduled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
                        total_recipients BIGINT DEFAULT 0, sent_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0, failed_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
                        skipped_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0, bounced_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0, retry_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0, batch_job_id VARCHAR(255),
                        deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, deleted_by BIGINT, version BIGINT NOT NULL)""");
            s.execute("CREATE TABLE campaign_target_groups (campaign_id BIGINT, group_id BIGINT)");
            s.execute("CREATE TABLE campaign_target_recipients (campaign_id BIGINT, recipient_id BIGINT)");
            // The same address is a contact of both companies.
            s.execute("""
                    INSERT INTO recipients (id, organization_id, email, status, version) VALUES
                        (10, 1, 'shared@test.local', 'ACTIVE', 0),
                        (20, 2, 'shared@test.local', 'ACTIVE', 0)""");
            s.execute("ALTER TABLE recipients ALTER COLUMN id RESTART WITH 100");
            s.execute("""
                    INSERT INTO campaigns (id, organization_id, name, subject, status, version) VALUES
                        (11, 1, 'A launch', 'Hi', 'DRAFT', 0),
                        (21, 2, 'B launch', 'Hi', 'DRAFT', 0)""");
        }
        registry = new StandardServiceRegistryBuilder()
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.url", URL)
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.username", "sa")
                .applySetting("hibernate.connection.password", "")
                .applySetting("hibernate.hbm2ddl.auto", "none")
                .applySetting("hibernate.tenant_identifier_resolver", new TenantIdentifierResolver())
                .build();
        sessionFactory = new MetadataSources(registry)
                .addAnnotatedClasses(Recipient.class, Campaign.class,
                        com.mailflow.template.entity.EmailTemplate.class,
                        com.mailflow.auth.entity.User.class, com.mailflow.auth.entity.Role.class,
                        com.mailflow.organization.entity.Organization.class)
                .buildMetadata()
                .buildSessionFactory();
    }

    @AfterAll
    static void tearDown() {
        if (sessionFactory != null) sessionFactory.close();
        if (registry != null) StandardServiceRegistryBuilder.destroy(registry);
    }

    @AfterEach
    void signOut() {
        TestTenant.signOut();
    }

    @Test
    void a_company_lists_only_its_own_contacts_and_campaigns() {
        TestTenant.signIn(ORG_A);
        try (Session s = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            assertThat(s.createQuery("SELECT r FROM Recipient r", Recipient.class).getResultList())
                    .extracting(Recipient::getId).containsExactly(10L);
            assertThat(s.createQuery("SELECT c FROM Campaign c", Campaign.class).getResultList())
                    .extracting(Campaign::getId).containsExactly(11L);
        }
        TestTenant.signIn(ORG_B);
        try (Session s = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            assertThat(s.createQuery("SELECT r FROM Recipient r", Recipient.class).getResultList())
                    .extracting(Recipient::getId).containsExactly(20L);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void the_campaign_lookup_by_id_does_not_return_another_companys_campaign() throws Exception {
        String jpql = CampaignRepository.class.getMethod("findOneById", Long.class)
                .getAnnotation(Query.class).value();
        TestTenant.signIn(ORG_A);
        try (Session s = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            assertThat(s.createQuery(jpql, Campaign.class).setParameter("id", 11L).getResultList()).hasSize(1);
            assertThat(s.createQuery(jpql, Campaign.class).setParameter("id", 21L).getResultList()).isEmpty();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void a_new_row_belongs_to_the_signed_in_company() throws Exception {
        TestTenant.signIn(ORG_B);
        try (Session s = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            s.beginTransaction();
            Recipient r = Recipient.builder().email("new@test.local").status(RecipientStatus.ACTIVE).build();
            s.persist(r);
            s.getTransaction().commit();
            assertThat(r.getOrganizationId()).isEqualTo(ORG_B);
        }
        try (Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, "sa", "");
             Statement st = c.createStatement();
             ResultSet rs = st.executeQuery("SELECT organization_id FROM recipients WHERE email = 'new@test.local'")) {
            assertThat(rs.next()).isTrue();
            assertThat(rs.getLong(1)).isEqualTo(ORG_B);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void code_without_a_signed_in_user_sees_every_company_and_must_scope_itself() {
        // The batch job, consumer and scheduler run like this; their queries pass the
        // campaign's organization explicitly (see RecipientRepository.findByIdsIn).
        try (Session s = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            List<Long> ids = s.createQuery("SELECT r.id FROM Recipient r WHERE r.email = 'shared@test.local' ORDER BY r.id",
                    Long.class).getResultList();
            assertThat(ids).containsExactly(10L, 20L);
            assertThat(s.createQuery("SELECT r.id FROM Recipient r WHERE r.organizationId = :org AND r.email = 'shared@test.local'",
                    Long.class).setParameter("org", ORG_B).getResultList()).containsExactly(20L);
        }
    }
}
````

## src/test/java/com/mailflow/tenant/TestTenant.java

````java
package com.mailflow.tenant;

import com.mailflow.auth.entity.User;
import com.mailflow.organization.entity.Organization;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;

import java.util.List;

/** Signs a user of organization {@link #ORG} in for a unit test, as the JWT filter would. */
public final class TestTenant {

    public static final Long ORG = 1L;

    private TestTenant() {}

    public static User signIn() {
        return signIn(ORG);
    }

    public static User signIn(Long organizationId) {
        User user = User.builder()
                .id(100L + organizationId)
                .email("user" + organizationId + "@test.local")
                .firstName("Test").lastName("User")
                .enabled(true)
                .organization(Organization.builder().id(organizationId).name("Org " + organizationId).build())
                .build();
        SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(
                new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(user, null, List.of()));
        return user;
    }

    public static void signOut() {
        SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
    }
}
````
